original: ekadā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sanakādayastattvavivitsayā pitāmahaṃ papracchuḥ praṇipātapurassaram | aho pitaḥ nirantaraṃ vaikuṇṭhe yā līlāstā dhyāyamānā nirantaraṃ cidānandena saha saṃprekṣāmahe | vada yadi rucirāpadyate | cidānandarasaṃ brahma kiṃ vadanti? vyāpakatayā jagadvyāpya tiṣṭhati yattadbrahma vadantitarām | āpadyamāno'sti prakṛtiṃ puruṣaḥ |
analyzed: ekadā brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ sanaka ādayaḥ tattva vivitsayā pitāmaham papracchuḥ praṇipāta purassaram aho pitar nirantaram vaikuṇṭhe yāḥ līlāḥ tāḥ dhyāyamānāḥ nirantaram cidānandena saha saṃprekṣāmahe vada yadi ruciḥ āpadyate cidānanda rasam brahma kim vadanti vyāpaka tayā jagat vyāpya tiṣṭhati yat tat brahma vadantitarām āpadyamānaḥ asti prakṛtim puruṣaḥ

original: kasmātprakṛtiyogitā bhavati? jīvāḥ kīdṛgvidhāḥ? kasmātsamutpannā bhavanti? teṣāṃ lokā alokāḥ kiyatpramāṇāḥ? yān vadanti purāvidaḥ | pitāmaha uvāca | nārāyaṇamukhācchruto'yaṃ dharmaḥ | śṛṇuta sarvā yaiṣā sṛṣṭissamutpadyate | kṣarākṣarābhyāmadhikaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñito bhaktigamya ānandamayo lokaḥ saṃvirājate |
analyzed: kasmāt prakṛti yogitā bhavati jīvāḥ kīdṛgvidhāḥ kasmāt samutpannāḥ bhavanti teṣām lokāḥ alokāḥ kiyat pramāṇāḥ yān vadanti purāvidaḥ pitāmahaḥ uvāca nārāyaṇa mukhāt śrutaḥ yam dharmaḥ śṛṇuta sarvāḥ yā eṣā sṛṣṭiḥ samutpadyate kṣara akṣarābhyām adhikaḥ puruṣottama saṃjñitaḥ bhakti gamyaḥ ānanda mayaḥ lokaḥ saṃvirājate

original: tasya puruṣottamasya uttarakaṭākṣātsamutpannā jīvāḥ | teṣāṃ snehamārgo'yamāpadyate | dakṣiṇakaṭākṣāduppannāḥ karmajaḍā āsurā alpopāsakā bhavanti | tasmin rasikānandasvarūpātpārśvāt dve eva mūrtī prakaṭita | prathamā bhaktisundarī prakaṭitā | paścānmāyādāsī prakaṭitā | tayoḥ prathamā atyantavallabhā āsta |
analyzed: tasya puruṣottamasya uttara kaṭākṣāt samutpannāḥ jīvāḥ teṣām sneha mārgaḥ yam āpadyate dakṣiṇa kaṭākṣāt uppannāḥ karma jaḍāḥ āsurāḥ alpa upāsakāḥ bhavanti tasmin rasika ānanda sva rūpāt pārśvāt dve eva mūrtī prakaṭita prathamā bhaktisundarī prakaṭitā paścāt māyādāsī prakaṭitā tayoḥ prathamā atyanta vallabhā āsta

original: bhaktessakāśādutpannā jīvāḥ snehamārgīyā bhavanti | māyāyāḥ samutpannā āsurāḥ karmajaḍā anyadharmaratā eva bhavanti | yadā karmamārge ratirasatāṃ te āsurā bhavanti | sā bhaktistrividhaiva bhavati | ekā karmamiśritā devānāmṛṣīṇāmupāsakānāṃ bhavatitarām | śravaṇakīrtanasmaraṇavandanasevanopakaraṇadāsyabhāvenātmasamarpaṇam |
analyzed: bhakteḥ sakāśāt utpannāḥ jīvāḥ sneha mārgīyāḥ bhavanti māyāyāḥ samutpannāḥ āsurāḥ karma jaḍāḥ anya dharma ratāḥ eva bhavanti yadā karma mārge rati rasatām te āsurāḥ bhavanti sā bhaktiḥ trividhā eva bhavati ekā karma miśritā devānām ṛṣīṇām upāsakānām bhavatitarām śravaṇa kīrtana smaraṇa vandana sevana upakaraṇa dāsya bhāvena ātma samarpaṇam

original: te jīvā bhaktimārgīyāḥ evaite | sa evāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svaramaṇārthaṃ svasvarūpaṃ prakaṭitavān | tadya rasasaṃvalitamānandaraso'yaṃ purāvido vadanti | sarve ānandarasā yasmāt prakaṭitā bhavanti | ānandarūpeṣu puruṣo'yaṃ ramate | sa evāyaṃ puruṣaḥ svayameva samārādhanatatparo'bhūt | tasmāt svayameva samārādhanamakarot | ato loke vede śrīrādhā gīyate |
analyzed: te jīvāḥ bhakti mārgīyāḥ eva ete saḥ eva ayam puruṣaḥ sva ramaṇa artham sva svarūpam prakaṭitavān rasa saṃvalitam ānanda rasaḥ yam purāvidaḥ vadanti sarve ānanda rasāḥ yasmāt prakaṭitāḥ bhavanti ānanda rūpeṣu puruṣaḥ yam ramate saḥ eva ayam puruṣaḥ svayam eva samārādhana tatparaḥ bhūt tasmāt svayam eva samārādhanam akarot atas loke vede śrī rādhā gīyate

original: tatsvarūpātsṛṣṭiryā samutpannā sā rasikānandena susevyatāṃ prāptā āsīt | pramāṇaprameyādasmānmārgādatirikto'yaṃ mārgo rasātmakaḥ | ya etanmārge āsaktāste rasarūpiṇīṃ sṛṣṭimantarutpadyamānāḥ bhavanti | lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyo'yaṃ saṃvādaḥ | nirantaraṃ nārāyaṇo vaikuṇṭhe ramayā rahasyalīlāṃ saṅgāyamāno'bhavat |
analyzed: tad svarūpāt sṛṣṭiḥ yā samutpannā sā rasika ānandena susevya tām prāptā āsīt pramāṇa prameyāt asmāt mārgāt atiriktaḥ yam mārgaḥ rasa ātmakaḥ ye etad mārge āsaktāḥ te rasa rūpiṇīm sṛṣṭim antar utpadyamānāḥ bhavanti lakṣmī nārāyaṇīyaḥ yam saṃvādaḥ nirantaram nārāyaṇaḥ vaikuṇṭhe ramayā rahasya līlām saṅgāyamānaḥ bhavat

original: ramāramaṇo vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ dhyānāpanno'bhavat | tadā lakṣmīḥ rahasyupāsamānā tasya tāmavasthāṃ nirīkṣya praśrayāvanatā papraccha | kiṃ dhyāyasi? kiṃ japasi ? paraṃ kautūhalaṃ me manasi vartate | tvatta paraṃ ko devaḥ? ko loka ? yasya tvaṃ dhyāyase
analyzed: ramāramaṇaḥ vaikuṇṭhe nārāyaṇaḥ svayam dhyāna āpannaḥ bhavat tadā lakṣmīḥ rahasi upāsamānā tasya tām avasthām nirīkṣya praśraya avanatā papraccha kim dhyāyasi kim japasi param kautūhalam me manasi vartate param kaḥ devaḥ kaḥ loka yasya tvam dhyāyase

original: pratikṣaṇam | tava manaḥ kāṃ līlāmāpannaṃ dṛśyate? sa hovāca lakṣmīṃ prati | mahālīlāsthānaṃ kṣarākṣarābhyāmadhikaṃ puruṣottamādhiṣṭhānam | yatra saptāvaraṇāni tejomayāni | yatra brahmāṇḍātyutpadyante līyante | koṭiśa aṇḍakaṭāhāḥ utpadyante līyante |
analyzed: pratikṣaṇam tava manaḥ kām līlām āpannam dṛśyate sa ha uvāca lakṣmīm prati mahā līlā sthānam kṣara akṣarābhyām adhikam puruṣottama adhiṣṭhānam yatra sapta āvaraṇāni tejaḥ mayāni yatra brahmāṇḍa atyutpadyante līyante koṭiśas aṇḍa kaṭāhāḥ utpadyante līyante

original: yasya pratāpakalpā utpannā brahmaviṣṇurudrādayo devāśca dikpālāḥ koṭiśa utpadyamānā līyamānāśca bhavanti | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | aho kṣarākṣarābhyāmaghikasya rasikānandasya sthānaṃ vistaraśo brūhi | sa hovāca | ādau puruṣottamasya rasikānandasya anādisaṃsiddhā līlāḥ bhavanti | anādirayaṃ puruṣa eka evāsti |
analyzed: yasya pratāpa kalpāḥ utpannāḥ brahma viṣṇu rudra ādayaḥ devāḥ ca dikpālāḥ koṭiśas utpadyamānāḥ līyamānāḥ ca bhavanti sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam aho kṣara akṣarābhyām aghikasya rasika ānandasya sthānam vistaraśaḥ brūhi sa ha uvāca ādau puruṣottamasya rasika ānandasya anādi saṃsiddhāḥ līlāḥ bhavanti anādiḥ ayam puruṣaḥ ekaḥ eva asti

original: tadeva rūpaṃ dvidhā vidhāya samārādhanatatparo'bhūt | tasmāt tāṃ rādhāṃ rasikānandāṃ vedavido vadanti | tasmādānandamayo'yaṃ lokaḥ | yatrāyaṃ puruṣo ramate tatrāyaṃ raso vrajati | tasmālloke vede vrajalīlā gīyate | tanmadhye vanāni dvādaśa santi | teṣāṃ pṛthak nāmāni santi |
analyzed: tat eva rūpam dvidhā vidhāya samārādhana tatparaḥ bhūt tasmāt tām rādhām rasika ānandām veda vidaḥ vadanti tasmāt ānanda mayaḥ yam lokaḥ yatra ayam puruṣaḥ ramate tatra ayam rasaḥ vrajati tasmāt loke vede vraja līlā gīyate tad madhye vanāni dvādaśa santi teṣām pṛthak nāmāni santi

original: tālavanaṃ bṛhadvanaṃ kumudavanaṃ lohavanaṃ bakulavanaṃ bhāṇḍīravanaṃ mahāvanaṃ goṣṭhaṃ kāmyavanamariṣṭaṃ ca sadāśubhaṃ dadhivanaṃ vṛndāvanamiti | sadā ānandamayo'yaṃ loko vedavido yaṃ vadanti | yatra vṛndāvanaṃ sarvakāmasukhāvahaṃ bhavati | yatra vṛkṣā ādhidaivikā devā eva bhavanti | yatra sādhanavaṭabhāṇḍīravaṭau | yatra vaśīvaṭasaṃketavaṭau |
analyzed: tāla vanam bṛhat vanam kumuda vanam loha vanam bakula vanam bhāṇḍīra vanam mahā vanam goṣṭham kāmya vanam ariṣṭam ca sadā aśubham dadhi vanam vṛndāvanam iti sadā ānanda mayaḥ yam lokaḥ veda vidaḥ yam vadanti yatra vṛndāvanam sarva kāma sukha āvaham bhavati yatra vṛkṣāḥ ādhidaivikāḥ devāḥ eva bhavanti yatra sādhana vaṭa bhāṇḍīra vaṭau yatra vaśīvaṭa saṃketavaṭau

original: anye vṛkṣāḥ kadambādyā yatra rājante | yatrobhayataṭabaddhā yamunā ratnakhacitā āste | yasyāṃ kumudavanāni rājante .| yasyāṃ haṃsasārasayūthāni krīḍāparāṇi śobhāḍhyāni bhavanti | yasyāstaṭe koṭiśaḥ kuñjāśca nikuñjāśca rājante | tasmin maṇḍale govardhano'yaṃ giriḥ | ratnamayo'yaṃ giriḥ rājamāno bhavati | ayaṃ giriḥ śrīrādhikāyāḥ ramaṇasthānam |
analyzed: anye vṛkṣāḥ kadamba ādyāḥ yatra rājante yatra ubhaya taṭa baddhā yamunā ratna khacitā āste yasyām kumuda vanāni rājante yasyām haṃsa sārasa yūthāni krīḍā parāṇi śobhā āḍhyāni bhavanti yasyāḥ taṭe koṭiśas kuñjāḥ ca nikuñjāḥ ca rājante tasmin maṇḍale govardhanaḥ yam giriḥ ratna mayaḥ yam giriḥ rājamānaḥ bhavati ayam giriḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ ramaṇa sthānam

original: sa evāyaṃ girirvṛndāvane sadā rasikānandasya krīḍāsthānaṃ bhavati | tasmin vane paśupakṣigaṇā ādhidaivikīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ prāptāḥ sadā sānubhavā bhavanti | ādhidaivikī yā sṛṣṭiḥ sā sṛṣṭistasmin loke
analyzed: saḥ eva ayam giriḥ vṛndāvane sadā rasika ānandasya krīḍā sthānam bhavati tasmin vane paśu pakṣi gaṇāḥ ādhidaivikīm sṛṣṭim prāptāḥ sadā sa anubhavāḥ bhavanti ādhidaivikī yā sṛṣṭiḥ sā sṛṣṭiḥ tasmin loke

original: lokatāṃ prāpnoti | sā sṛṣṭirdvibhedā bhavati | ekā saṃsiddhā anyā sādhanasiddhā bhavati | yā saṃsiddhā sā tasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ svasvarūpāt samutpādyā bhavati | yā sādhanasiddhā sā bhajanamārge prapannā | bhaktāstāṃ līlāṃ tadbhāvena prāpnuvanti |
analyzed: loka tām prāpnoti sā sṛṣṭiḥ dvi bhedā bhavati ekā saṃsiddhā anyā sādhana siddhā bhavati yā saṃsiddhā sā tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ sva svarūpāt samutpādyā bhavati yā sādhana siddhā sā bhajana mārge prapannā bhaktāḥ tām līlām tad bhāvena prāpnuvanti

original: rasalīlāyāmupakaraṇāni rasalīlāyāmadhikaraṇe sakhyaścāturyaguṇayutāḥ sasakhīsamūhā yauvanasaṃpattipūrṇā anekakalākovidāḥ rasabhāvena pūrṇā bhavanti | yatra candanavṛkṣāṇāṃ śreṇayo rājamānā bhavanti | maṇividrumalatāgrathitāḥ suvarṇasugandhasaṃvalitā vṛkṣāsteṣāṃ puṣpāṇi saṃrājamānāni bhavanti | tatra sakhīyūthāni bhojyaṃ haste gṛhītvā tiṣṭhanti |
analyzed: rasa līlāyām upakaraṇāni rasa līlāyām adhikaraṇe sakhyaḥ cāturya guṇa yutāḥ sa sakhī samūhāḥ yauvana saṃpatti pūrṇāḥ aneka kalā kovidāḥ rasa bhāvena pūrṇāḥ bhavanti yatra candana vṛkṣāṇām śreṇayaḥ rājamānāḥ bhavanti maṇi vidruma latā grathitāḥ suvarṇa sugandha saṃvalitāḥ vṛkṣāḥ teṣām puṣpāṇi saṃrājamānāni bhavanti tatra sakhī yūthāni bhojyam haste gṛhītvā tiṣṭhanti

original: tāsu śreṇiṣu latāntarairgrathitāni dvārāṇi maṇilatāyutāni bhavanti | maṇimaṇḍalaṃ yatra tejomayaṃ maṇimaṇḍapena saha bhrājamānaṃ bhavati | latāgrathitā maṇistaṃbhāḥ śataśo rājamānā bhavanti | tasmin maṇḍape paritaḥ suvarṇabhittiṣu jaṭitāḥ maṇayastejomayāḥ saṃrājamānā bhavanti |
analyzed: tāsu śreṇiṣu latā antaraiḥ grathitāni dvārāṇi maṇi latā yutāni bhavanti maṇi maṇḍalam yatra tejaḥ mayam maṇi maṇḍapena saha bhrājamānam bhavati latā grathitāḥ maṇi staṃbhāḥ śataśas rājamānāḥ bhavanti tasmin maṇḍape paritas suvarṇa bhittiṣu jaṭitāḥ maṇayaḥ tejaḥ mayāḥ saṃrājamānāḥ bhavanti

original: tatrādhityakāsu candrakāntamaṇinā dyotitā jalamaṇayo jaladhārāśca bhavanti | tena jalena pūritāḥ sugandhamaṇipuṣkariṇyo rājamānā bhavanti | tatra kamalāni praphullāni śvetaraktapītāni manoharaśobhāṃ dadati | tatropasthitaparāgastadvanaṃ vāsayati | tatra haṃsayugmāni koṭiśo devavāṇyā nikuñjadevyā yaśo gāyanti |
analyzed: tatra adhityakāsu candrakānta maṇinā dyotitāḥ jala maṇayaḥ jala dhārāḥ ca bhavanti tena jalena pūritāḥ sugandha maṇi puṣkariṇyaḥ rājamānāḥ bhavanti tatra kamalāni praphullāni śveta rakta pītāni manohara śobhām dadati tatra upasthita parāgaḥ tat vanam vāsayati tatra haṃsa yugmāni koṭiśas deva vāṇyā nikuñja devyāḥ yaśaḥ gāyanti

original: yatra bhramarāḥ sānubhavā devavāṇyā nikuñjadevyā yaśo gāyanti | tatra puṣkariṇī parito daśa daśa mandirāṇi catuṣkoṇeṣu santi | ratnamayakuḍyeṣu kṛtrimāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sānubhavā iva dṛśyante | tatra madhye madhye vṛkṣā nikuñjatāṃ prāpnuvanti | sukomalaiḥ patraistejomayai rājante | teṣāṃ sugandhena unmadā bhramarāstasyāḥ śrīrādhikāyā yaśo gāyanti |
analyzed: yatra bhramarāḥ sānubhavāḥ deva vāṇyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ yaśaḥ gāyanti tatra puṣkariṇī paritas daśa daśa mandirāṇi catuṣkoṇeṣu santi ratna maya kuḍyeṣu kṛtrimāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sānubhavāḥ iva dṛśyante tatra madhye madhye vṛkṣāḥ nikuñja tām prāpnuvanti su komalaiḥ patraiḥ tejaḥ mayaiḥ rājante teṣām sugandhena unmadāḥ bhramarāḥ tasyāḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ yaśaḥ gāyanti

original: tatra kecit vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaiḥ śākhāpratiśākhāḥ namrā bhavanti | teṣu vṛkṣeṣu haritapītaśubhraśvetā dyotitāḥ puppagucchā bhavanti | teṣāmadhaḥśṛṅgāravatyādayaḥ sakhyaḥ puṣpāṇāṃ śayyā racayanti | tatra latāntaraiḥ
analyzed: tatra kecid vṛkṣāḥ puṣpaiḥ śākhā pratiśākhāḥ namrāḥ bhavanti teṣu vṛkṣeṣu harita pīta śubhra śvetāḥ dyotitāḥ puppa gucchāḥ bhavanti teṣām adhas śṛṅgāravatī ādayaḥ sakhyaḥ puṣpāṇām śayyāḥ racayanti tatra latā antaraiḥ

original: ācchāditā vṛkṣā nikuñjatāṃ prāpnuvanti | tatra maṇijaṭitāni ramaṇasthānāni koṭiśo rājante | yatra lalitā viśākhā subhagā kalāvatī manoramā candrakalāmohinī gatirativilāsinī mohinī śāstragītajñā guṇajñā bhogajñā bhogapradā kāmapradā kāmadā kelidā suratakalākovidā saṃbhogasukhadā gatatrapā niḥśaṅkaratidā sutarāṃ suratāntanidritā anyāḥ koṭiśaḥ sakhya
analyzed: ācchāditāḥ vṛkṣāḥ nikuñja tām prāpnuvanti tatra maṇi jaṭitāni ramaṇa sthānāni koṭiśas rājante yatra lalitā viśākhā subhagā kalāvatī manoramā candra kalā mohinī gatiḥ ati vilāsinī mohinī śāstra gīta jñā guṇa jñā bhoga jñā bhoga pradā kāma pradā kāma dā kelidā surata kalā kovidā saṃbhoga sukha dā gatatrapā niḥśaṅka rati dā sutarām surata anta nidritā anyāḥ koṭiśas sakhya saṃbhoga sukha dā gatatrapā niḥśaṅka rati dā sutar

original: saṃvirājamānā bhavanti | daśa mandirāṇi bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ saṃpūritāni bhavanti | yatra ghṛtapakvāni pakvānnānyanekaśo vividharasayuktāni santi | teṣu mandireṣu kaṭutiktakaṣāyamādhuryarasā bhogavatyā sakhyā kṛtāḥ saṃpūrṇāḥ pratikṣaṇaṃ nūtanā bhavanti |
analyzed: saṃvirājamānāḥ bhavanti daśa mandirāṇi bhakṣya bhojyaiḥ saṃpūritāni bhavanti yatra ghṛta pakvāni pakva annāni anekaśas vividha rasa yuktāni santi teṣu mandireṣu kaṭu tikta kaṣāya mādhurya rasāḥ bhogavatyā sakhyā kṛtāḥ saṃpūrṇāḥ pratikṣaṇam nūtanāḥ bhavanti

original: anne siddhānnabhogāpūpapāyasapakvānnabhāgāḥ śākavividhaṣaḍrasasaṃvalitā annapūrṇayā sakhyā saṃpāditāstayā nikuñjadevyā sevyamānā bhavanti | vastravatyā sakhyā saṃpāditānyanekaśo vastrāṇi samayocitāni manoramāṇi santi | bhūṣaṇabhūṣyā sakhyā racitāni bhūṣaṇāni tasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ prīṇanāya teṣu mandireṣu śayyābhojanaśṛṅgārāḥ koṭiśaḥ santi |
analyzed: anne siddha anna bhoga apūpa pāyasa pakva anna bhāgāḥ śāka vividha ṣaṣ rasa saṃvalitāḥ anna pūrṇayā sakhyā saṃpāditāḥ tayā nikuñja devyā sevyamānāḥ bhavanti vastravatyā sakhyā saṃpāditāni anekaśas vastrāṇi samaya ucitāni manoramāṇi santi bhūṣaṇa bhūṣyā sakhyā racitāni bhūṣaṇāni tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ prīṇanāya teṣu mandireṣu śayyā bhojana śṛṅgārāḥ koṭiśas santi

original: tatrānye śṛṅgārādibhogā bhogavatyā kṛtāsteṣu mandireṣu tasyāḥ sukhārthaṃ bhavanti | tatra catuḥśreṇīni daśadaśamandirāṇi santi | teṣu mandireṣu śayyābhojanaśṛṅgārā anekadhā racitā bhavanti | teṣu mandireṣu sakhīnāṃ samūhāḥ pṛthak pṛthak kāryeṣu saṃlagnā bhavanti |
analyzed: tatra anye śṛṅgāra ādi bhogāḥ bhogavatyā kṛtāḥ teṣu mandireṣu tasyāḥ sukha artham bhavanti tatra catur śreṇīni daśa daśa mandirāṇi santi teṣu mandireṣu śayyā bhojana śṛṅgārāḥ anekadhā racitāḥ bhavanti teṣu mandireṣu sakhīnām samūhāḥ pṛthak pṛthak kāryeṣu saṃlagnāḥ bhavanti

original: teṣāṃ madhye rāsamaṇḍalaṃ tejomayamānandamayaṃ tasyāḥ śrīrādhikāyāḥ sukhārthaṃ vṛndānāmnā sakhyā tayā saṃpāditaṃ bhavati | teṣu mandireṣu sakhīnāṃ ekā yogamāyā sakhī sarvāsāṃ sakhīnāṃ sarvatra ekabhāvaṃ karoti | tasmin sthāne sunādāḥ sakhyaḥ sunādena saptasvarāṇi śrāvayanti |
analyzed: teṣām madhye rāsa maṇḍalam tejaḥ mayam ānanda mayam tasyāḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ sukha artham vṛndā nāmnā sakhyā tayā saṃpāditam bhavati teṣu mandireṣu sakhīnām ekā yogamāyā sakhī sarvāsām sakhīnām sarvatra eka bhāvam karoti tasmin sthāne sunādāḥ sakhyaḥ sunādena sapta svarāṇi śrāvayanti

original: tatra brahmāṇḍe yā siddhayo'ṇimādayastatra sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāya tāṃ śrīrādhikāṃ sevamānā bhavanti | sumeruhemādrimalayādyāḥ parvatā anye ya nidhayo devānāṃ santi te nidhayastasyā
analyzed: tatra brahmāṇḍe yā siddha yoṇima ādayaḥ tatra sakhī rūpam vidhāya tām śrī rādhikām sevamānāḥ bhavanti sumeru hemādri malaya ādyāḥ parvatāḥ anye nidhayaḥ devānām santi te nidhayaḥ tasyāḥ

original: nikuñjadevyāḥ prīṇanāya sakhīnāṃ rūpāṇi vidhāya tanmaṇḍalaṃ sevante | tasminmaṇḍale śrīrapi sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāya ākāraṃ gopayantī sevamānā bhavati | nityalīlāyāṃ ṣaḍṛtavo'pi sakhīnāṃ rūpāṇi vidhāya sevamānā bhavanti | kāle kāle tāsu nikuñjaśreṇiṣu sañcāriṇīnāṃ nānābhogān dadati | meghā nānāsakhīnāṃ rūpāṇi kṛtvā jalasecanaṃ kurvanti |
analyzed: nikuñja devyāḥ prīṇanāya sakhīnām rūpāṇi vidhāya tat maṇḍalam sevante tasmin maṇḍale śrīḥ api sakhī rūpam vidhāya ākāram gopayantī sevamānā bhavati nitya līlāyām ṣaṣ ṛtavaḥ api sakhīnām rūpāṇi vidhāya sevamānāḥ bhavanti kāle kāle tāsu nikuñja śreṇiṣu sañcāriṇīnām nānā bhogān dadati meghāḥ nānā sakhīnām rūpāṇi kṛtvā jala secanam kurvanti

original: kāmadevo'pi sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāya tatsthānaṃ sevamāno bhavati | ahorātramapi svasvarūpeṇa ahani niśi ca sevate tanmaṇḍalam | tadicchayā kvaciddivā kvacinniśā kvacitprātaḥ kvacitsāyaṃ kvacinmadhyāhnaḥ kvacinniśīthe nānābhāvena kālekāle tanmaṇḍalaṃ sevate |
analyzed: kāmadevaḥ api sakhī rūpam vidhāya tat sthānam sevamānaḥ bhavati ahorātram api sva svarūpeṇa ahani niśi ca sevate tat maṇḍalam tad icchayā kvacid divā kvacid niśā kvacid prātar kvacid sāyam kvacid madhyāhnaḥ kvacid niśīthe nānābhāvena kāle kāle tat maṇḍalam sevate

original: nānāmaṇaya oṣadhayo vanaspatayo vṛkṣā ye pṛthivyāṃ santi te ādhidaivikīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ prāptāḥ sevamānā bhavanti | sindhavaḥ svarūpeṇa nidhīn gṛhītvā tanmaṇḍalaṃ sevamānā bhavanti | sumeruhemādrimalayādyāḥ parvatāḥ tatsthānaṃ sevamānā bhavanti | sakhīrūpeṇātyanta maṇijyotsnābhiryatra tatra anye ca brahmāṇḍavartinastatsthānaṃ dīpayanto bhavanti |
analyzed: nānā maṇayaḥ oṣadhayaḥ vanaspatayaḥ vṛkṣāḥ ye pṛthivyām santi te ādhidaivikīm sṛṣṭim prāptāḥ sevamānāḥ bhavanti sindhavaḥ sva rūpeṇa nidhīn gṛhītvā tad maṇḍalam sevamānāḥ bhavanti sumeru hemādri malaya ādyāḥ parvatāḥ tad sthānam sevamānāḥ bhavanti sakhī rūpeṇa atyanta maṇi jyotsnābhiḥ yatra tatra anye ca brahmāṇḍa vartinaḥ tat sthānam dīpayantaḥ bhavanti

original: pṛthivyāṃ yatkiñcidvastumātraṃ tasyādhidaivikaṃ rūpaṃ tatraivāsti | tasmātsarvaṃ samutpannaṃ bhavati | brahmāṇḍe ye devāste ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tatsthānaṃ sevamānā bhavanti | tasmātte sarve samutpannā brahmāṇḍe bhavanti | vedāḥ svaṛcābhistasmiṃsthāne tasyā nikuñjadevyā yaśo gāyanti | kāmadughāḥ svayūthenādhidaivikaṃ rūpaṃ vidhāya saṃsevante |
analyzed: pṛthivyām yat kiñcid vastu mātram tasya ādhidaivikam rūpam tatra eva asti tasmāt sarvam samutpannam bhavati brahmāṇḍe ye devāḥ te ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tat sthānam sevamānāḥ bhavanti tasmāt te sarve samutpannāḥ brahmāṇḍe bhavanti vedāḥ sva ṛcābhiḥ tasmin sthāne tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ yaśaḥ gāyanti kāmadughāḥ sva yūthena ādhidaivikam rūpam vidhāya saṃsevante

original: dadhidugdhatakranavanītaghṛtādyān rasān gṛhītvā sevamānā bhavanti | tatra rāsamaṇḍalametairguṇairanyairvividhaiḥ saṃpūritaṃ rasikānandena saha śrīrādhikāṃ sevamānaṃ bhavati | yasya rāsamaṇḍalasya paritaḥ sthānāni dvādaśa saṃśobhamānāni bhavanti | ekaṃ majjanasthānam |
analyzed: dadhi dugdha takra navanīta ghṛta ādyān rasān gṛhītvā sevamānāḥ bhavanti tatra rāsa maṇḍalam etaiḥ guṇaiḥ anyaiḥ vividhaiḥ saṃpūritam rasika ānandena saha śrī rādhikām sevamānam bhavati yasya rāsa maṇḍalasya paritas sthānāni dvādaśa saṃśobhamānāni bhavanti ekam majjana sthānam

original: yatroṣṇodakapuṣkariṇyo jalaiḥ saṃpūrṇā bhavanti tatra majjanavatyādayaḥ sakhyo majjanārthaṃ sevyamānā bhavanti | tatrānyāḥ puṣkariṇyaḥ śītodakapūrṇā bhavanti | tatra nikuñjānāṃ śreṇayo ratnālavālaiścandrodbhavairjalaiḥ

original: sevyamānā bhavanti | tatrānyā puṣkariṇyaḥ śītodakapūrṇā bhavanti | candrakāntamaṇerutpannairjalaiḥ sevyamānā muktālatā muktāgucchaiḥ saṃpūritā bhavanti | maṇilatāsu jyotsnāyāṃ pratibimbitāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ parasparaṃ dṛṣṭibandhena nṛtyaṃ kurvanti | dvitīyaṃ śṛṅgārasthānam | yatra śṛṅgāravatyāsakhyā adhiśritam |
analyzed: sevyamānāḥ bhavanti tatra anyā puṣkariṇyaḥ śīta udaka pūrṇāḥ bhavanti candrakānta maṇeḥ utpannaiḥ jalaiḥ sevyamānāḥ muktā latāḥ muktā gucchaiḥ saṃpūritāḥ bhavanti maṇi latāsu jyotsnāyām pratibimbitāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ parasparam dṛṣṭi bandhena nṛtyam kurvanti dvitīyam śṛṅgāra sthānam yatra śṛṅgāravatyā asakhyā adhiśritam

original: tasmin sthāne adhiśritā raṅgavatyādaya sakhyo modante | tṛtīyaṃ mānasthānam | yatra mānavatyādaya sakhyo mānaṃ racayanti | yasmin mandāravṛkṣāḥ suvarṇalatāḥ sugandhā grathitā bhavanti | teṣu vṛkṣeṣu puṣpāṇi sugandhasaṃvalitāni bhavanti | latāntarairācchāditaṃ sthānaṃ sugandhasaṃvalitaṃ manoramaṃ tejasā dīpyamānaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: tasmin sthāne adhiśritāḥ raṅgavatī ādayaḥ sakhyaḥ modante tṛtīyam māna sthānam yatra mānavatī ādayaḥ sakhyaḥ mānam racayanti yasmin mandāra vṛkṣāḥ suvarṇa latāḥ sugandhāḥ grathitāḥ bhavanti teṣu vṛkṣeṣu puṣpāṇi sugandha saṃvalitāni bhavanti latā antaraiḥ ācchāditam sthānam sugandha saṃvalitam manoramam tejasā dīpyamānam bhavati

original: haritapītacchāyābhiḥ saṃyutaṃ tejasā dīpyamānaṃ bhavati | mandāranikuñjāḥ śrīrādhikāyā adhiṣṭhānam | yamunāyāstīre dhīrasamīre ekavaṭaścakāsti | tasya vaṭasya parito nikuñjānāṃ śreṇayo rājamānā bhavanti | dvādaśa nikuñjāḥ santi | sakhīnāṃ sañcārāḥ sūkṣmatarā latāntarairgrathitā bhavanti |
analyzed: harita pīta chāyābhiḥ saṃyutam tejasā dīpyamānam bhavati mandāra nikuñjāḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ adhiṣṭhānam yamunāyāḥ tīre dhīra samīre eka vaṭaḥ cakāsti tasya vaṭasya paritas nikuñjānām śreṇayaḥ rājamānāḥ bhavanti dvādaśa nikuñjāḥ santi sakhīnām sañcārāḥ sūkṣmatarāḥ latā antaraiḥ grathitāḥ bhavanti

original: tatra lali tādayaḥ sakhyo rasikānandena saha vacanaprativacanottaraṃ dadati | kuñjāntaraśreṇiṣu sakhīnāṃ madhyasañcāro'sti | rasikānandaḥ puruṣottamaḥ svayameva praṇipātaṃ karoti | svāminī manoramā nikuñje svayamevātimānāturatayā manobhāvāpannā bhavati | svabhāvasaṃsiddhāḥ sakhyo bhāvāpannā bhavanti |
analyzed: tatra lali ta ādayaḥ sakhyaḥ rasika ānandena saha vacana prativacana uttaram dadati kuñja antara śreṇiṣu sakhīnām madhya sañcāraḥ usti rasika ānandaḥ puruṣottamaḥ svayam eva praṇipātam karoti svāminī manoramā nikuñje svayam eva ati māna ātura tayā manaḥ bhāva āpannā bhavati svabhāva saṃsiddhāḥ sakhyaḥ bhāva āpannāḥ bhavanti

original: atirasalaṃpaṭo rasikānandaḥ sarvāsāṃ sakhīnāṃ praṇipātaṃ karoti | atyantamagnāḥ sakhyastatsukhaṃ nirīkṣya suratānande magnā bhavanti | caturthaṃ bhogasthānam | yatra subhojyā sakhyā sevitam | yatra khādyapeyalehyacoṣyarasā anekasvāduyutāḥ bhavanti |
analyzed: ati rasa laṃpaṭaḥ rasika ānandaḥ sarvāsām sakhīnām praṇipātam karoti atyanta magnāḥ sakhyaḥ tad sukham nirīkṣya surata ānande magnāḥ bhavanti caturtham bhoga sthānam yatra su bhojyā sakhyā sevitam yatra khādya peya lehya coṣya rasāḥ aneka svādu yutāḥ bhavanti

original: annapūrṇayā sakhyā pācitānannarasānatyuṣṇān sadyaḥpācitāniva śrīrādhikayā saha rasikānandaḥ sevate | agururasāṃstailarasān puṣparasān nānāsugandharasān śrīrādhikayā saha rasikānandaḥ saṃsevamāno bhavati | anye tāmbūlādayo lavaṅgakarpūrādaya elājātīphalapūgaphalanālike
analyzed: anna pūrṇayā sakhyā pācitān anna rasān ati uṣṇān sadyas pācitān iva śrī rādhikayā saha rasika ānandaḥ sevate aguru rasān taila rasān puṣpa rasān nānā sugandha rasān śrī rādhikayā saha rasika ānandaḥ saṃsevamānaḥ bhavati anye tāmbūla ādayaḥ lavaṅga karpūra ādayaḥ elā jātīphala pūga phala nālike

original: rapanasasahakārabhadrākṣekṣurasaiḥ śarkarādaya piṣṭarasapūrṇatayā nikuñjadevyā saṃsevyante | lalitā raṅgavatī bhogavatī premotkaṇṭhā suratānandā suratarasakovidā ceti sakhya śrīrādhikayā dattaṃ prasādaṃ bhuñjate | tatraikaṃ rasikānandaśṛṅgārasthānam | yatra pārijātakavṛkṣāḥ sadā puṣpaiḥ praphullitā namrā bhavanti |
analyzed: rapanasa sahakāra bhadrākṣa ikṣu rasaiḥ śarkarā ādayaḥ piṣṭa rasa pūrṇa tayā nikuñja devyā saṃsevyante lalitā raṅgavatī bhogavatī prema utkaṇṭhā surata ānandā surata rasa kovidā ca iti sakhya śrī rādhikayā dattam prasādam bhuñjate tatra ekam rasika ānanda śṛṅgāra sthānam yatra pārijātaka vṛkṣāḥ sadā puṣpaiḥ praphullitāḥ namrāḥ bhavanti

original: tatra sugandhasuvarṇalatābhi saṃvalitaṃ bhavati | sugandhamuktālatābhiḥ pārijātakavṛkṣā grathitanikuñjatāṃ prāpnuvanti | tatra eko bhramaro devavāṇyā cāturyeṇa mānasthāne rādhikāṃ prati dūtatvaṃ karoti | sa bhramaro rasikānandaṃ prati priyo bhavati | sa bhramara svacāturyeṇa śrīrādhikāyā mānāpakaraṇaṃ karoti |
analyzed: tatra sugandha suvarṇa latābhiḥ saṃvalitam bhavati sugandha muktā latābhiḥ pārijātaka vṛkṣāḥ grathita nikuñja tām prāpnuvanti tatra ekaḥ bhramaraḥ deva vāṇyā cāturyeṇa māna sthāne rādhikām prati dūta tvam karoti sa bhramaraḥ rasika ānandam prati priyaḥ bhavati sa bhramara sva cāturyeṇa śrī rādhikāyāḥ māna apakaraṇam karoti

original: sa bhramaro'tyantamanoharacāturyāsīmaguṇajñaḥ svabhāvasaṃsiddhaḥ sādhanasiddho bhavati | sa bhramaro rasikānandasya dūto bhavati | nirantaraṃ śrīrādhikāyāḥ mānalīlāyāṃ sahakārī bhavati | tasmādrasikānandasyātitarāṃ vallabho bhavati | te'tra bhramarā manoharaśabdena saṅgītarasaṃ gamayanti |
analyzed: sa bhramara utyanta manohara cāturya āsīma guṇa jñaḥ svabhāva saṃsiddhaḥ sādhana siddhaḥ bhavati sa bhramaraḥ rasika ānandasya dūtaḥ bhavati nirantaram śrī rādhikāyāḥ māna līlāyām sahakārī bhavati tasmāt rasika ānandasya atitarām vallabhaḥ bhavati bhramarāḥ manohara śabdena saṅgīta rasam gamayanti

original: tatraikaḥ śukaḥ sādhanasiddhaḥ śrīrādhikāyā mānasthāne mandāranikuñje nivasati | tena śukena bhramaracāturyaṃ nirīkṣya tasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ kṛpāṃ nirīkṣya atyāścaryaṃ prapede | sa bhramarastena śukena pṛṣṭaḥ aho ale tvaṃ kaḥ ? kena sādhanena tvayedaṃ rūpaṃ prāptam? kathaṃ śrīrasikānandasya śrīrādhikāyā dūtatvaṃ prāptaḥ? aliruvāca |
analyzed: tatra ekaḥ śukaḥ sādhana siddhaḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ māna sthāne mandāra nikuñje nivasati tena śukena bhramara cāturyam nirīkṣya tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ kṛpām nirīkṣya ati āścaryam prapede sa bhramaraḥ tena śukena pṛṣṭaḥ aho ale tvam kaḥ kena sādhanena tvayā idam rūpam prāptam katham śrī rasika ānandasya śrī rādhikāyāḥ dūta tvam prāptaḥ aliḥ uvāca

original: aho śuka tvaṃ pūrva ko'si? kena sādhanenedaṃ līlāsthānaṃ prāptam? śuka uvāca | ahaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇo'smi | viṣṇorupāsakakulotpanna ekātmabhāvena mama mano hariṃ bhajamānaṃ bhavati | ekasmin vāsare'smi brahmalokaṃ gataḥ | tatrānanyamārgīyā bhaktāḥ mayā dṛṣṭāḥ | rasamārgīyā bhaktā mayā dṛṣṭāḥ | teṣāṃ saṅgamena mayā nikuñjalīlā anubhūtā |
analyzed: aho śuka tvam pūrva kaḥ asi kena sādhanena idam līlā sthānam prāptam śukaḥ uvāca aham pūrvam brāhmaṇaḥ asmi viṣṇoḥ upāsaka kula utpannaḥ eka ātma bhāvena mama manaḥ harim bhajamānam bhavati ekasmin vāsare asmi brahma lokam gataḥ tatra ananya mārgīyāḥ bhaktāḥ mayā dṛṣṭāḥ rasa mārgīyāḥ bhaktāḥ mayā dṛṣṭāḥ teṣām saṅgamena mayā nikuñja līlā anubhūtā

original: tatrāriṣṭe śrīrādhākṛṣṇapuṣkariṇyudbhavāṃ mṛttikāṃ bhakṣayatā tatra nirantarakrīḍāsthalaṃ mayā śrutaṃ pūrvam | asyā mṛttikāyāḥ māhātmyaṃ mahālīlāyāḥ prāpteḥ kāraṇam | bhramaro vadati | tvayā kiṃ

original: sthāne bhogavatī nāmnā sakhī nānābhogān kalpayati | kaṭutiktamadhurakaṣāyāḥ susvādā bhogāḥ śrīrādhikāyā bhojyāpannā bhavanti | rativatī nāmnā sakhī nānāratisukhamutpādayati | ratikalākautukāni manojñāni bhavanti | suratānandā sakhī nānāsuratakalāṃ śrīrādhikāyai kalpayati | manojñā sakhī nānāmanobhāvaṃ dadāti |
analyzed: sthāne bhogavatī nāmnā sakhī nānā bhogān kalpayati kaṭu tikta madhura kaṣāyāḥ su svādāḥ bhogāḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ bhojya āpannāḥ bhavanti rativatī nāmnā sakhī nānā rati sukham utpādayati rati kalā kautukāni manojñāni bhavanti surata ānandā sakhī nānā surata kalām śrī rādhikāyai kalpayati manojñā sakhī nānā manobhāvam dadāti

original: sukhadā sakhī nānāsukhaṃ rasikānandaṃ prati rādhikārthe kalpayati | tāḥ sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sukhakelikalānubhāvena rāsalīlāṃ kurvanti | tasmin madhyamaṇḍale suracitā sakhī kasmiṃścitsamaye rāsalīlāṃ racayati | tatra madhye kāmena sevitaṃ tejomayamāsanaṃ kalpayitvā śrīrādhikayā saha rasikānandaṃ samāveśayati |
analyzed: sukha dā sakhī nānā sukham rasika ānandam prati rādhikā arthe kalpayati tāḥ sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ sukha keli kalā anubhāvena rāsa līlām kurvanti tasmin madhya maṇḍale su racitā sakhī kasmiṃścid samaye rāsa līlām racayati tatra madhye kāmena sevitam tejaḥ mayam āsanam kalpayitvā śrī rādhikayā saha rasika ānandam samāveśayati

original: tatra parita etāḥ sakhyaḥ krīḍākalāṃ darśayanti | kalāvatī guṇavatī puṣpavatī aṅgacapalā suratakalākovidā rasakalābhijñā rasabhāvajñā viparītasuratanṛtyakalākovidā etāścānyāḥ sakhyaḥ tasmin maṇḍale svān svān guṇān prakaṭīkṛtya rasikānandaṃ sevamānāḥ bhavanti | sādhanasiddhāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sakhya anekarūpaistābhyāṃ susevyamānāḥ bhavanti |
analyzed: tatra paritas etāḥ sakhyaḥ krīḍā kalām darśayanti kalāvatī guṇavatī puṣpavatī aṅga capalā surata kalā kovidāḥ rasa kalā abhijñāḥ rasa bhāva jñāḥ viparīta surata nṛtya kalā kovidāḥ etāḥ ca anyāḥ sakhyaḥ tasmin maṇḍale svān svān guṇān prakaṭīkṛtya rasika ānandam sevamānāḥ bhavanti sādhana siddhāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sakhyaḥ aneka rūpaiḥ tābhyām susevyamānāḥ bhavanti

original: yādṛśā bhaktāstādṛśaṃ sukhaṃ tādṛśo līlābhāvaśca bhavet | punaste ūcuḥ | mahāsthānaṃ kiyatpramāṇam? saṃsiddho'yaṃ rasaḥ | saṃsiddhaḥ kīdṛgvidhaḥ? te saṃsiddhā bhaktāḥ kīdṛgvidhāḥ? teṣāṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛgvidham? rasikaśiromaṇirānandātmakapuruṣottamaḥ śrīrādhāmānandaramaṇānandarūpāṃ tena rūpeṇa saha bubhuje |
analyzed: yādṛśāḥ bhaktāḥ tādṛśam sukham tādṛśaḥ līlā bhāvaḥ ca bhavet punar te ūcuḥ mahāsthānam kiyat pramāṇam saṃsiddhaḥ ayam rasaḥ saṃsiddhaḥ kīdṛgvidhaḥ te saṃsiddhāḥ bhaktāḥ kīdṛgvidhāḥ teṣām rūpam kīdṛgvidham rasika śiromaṇiḥ ānanda ātmaka puruṣottamaḥ śrī rādhām ānanda ramaṇa ānanda rūpām tena rūpeṇa saha bubhuje

original: nityānandarūpeṇa saha puruṣottamo nityānandarūpaḥ saṃkrīḍamāno bhavati | saḥ evaṃ rūpaṃ gopikāsvāvirbhāvena krīḍayiṣyati | pṛthagrūpeṇa krīḍamānā abhyeti | tadbhāve krīḍiṣyamāṇā gopyaḥ pṛthak saṃkrīḍamānā iva ekameva sthānamadhyāsate |
analyzed: nitya ānanda rūpeṇa saha puruṣottamaḥ nitya ānanda rūpaḥ saṃkrīḍamānaḥ bhavati saḥ evam rūpam gopikāsu āvirbhāvena krīḍayiṣyati pṛthak rūpeṇa krīḍamānāḥ abhyeti tad bhāve krīḍiṣyamāṇāḥ gopyaḥ pṛthak saṃkrīḍamānāḥ iva ekam eva sthānam adhyāsate

original: teṣāṃ sthānaṃ kiyatpramāṇam? kīdṛgvidhā bhaktāḥ? krīḍamānaṃ rūpaṃ tābhiḥ saṃpīyamānasauṣṭhavaṃ kim ? punaruvācedam | rahasyamatitarāṃ sauṣṭhavam | ṣaḍvidho'yaṃ rāsaḥ | teṣāmeva rāsalīlāyāmāpadyamānaṃ
analyzed: teṣām sthānam kiyat pramāṇam kīdṛgvidhāḥ bhaktāḥ krīḍamānam rūpam tābhiḥ saṃpīyamāna sauṣṭhavam kim punar uvāca idam rahasyam atitarām sauṣṭhavam ṣaḍvidhaḥ yam rāsaḥ teṣām eva rāsa līlāyām āpadyamānam

original: rūpam | rahasyasthānaṃ mahālīlāyāṃ śatayojanāyataṃ padmarāgajāmbūnadasuvarṇakhacitam | nīlamaṇinā paridhayaḥ śobhāḍhyā evāsan | madhyamadhye puṣyarāgamaṇīnāṃ sthānaṃ saṃbhrājate | teṣāmatitarāṃ maṇijyotsnāṃ rājamānāmabhyetya tasmāt paritaḥ śatakuñjavidrumalatāḥ suvarṇasugandhalatāgrathitāḥ susugandhāḍhyamātanvan |
analyzed: rūpam rahasya sthānam mahā līlāyām śata yojana āyatam padmarāga jāmbūnada suvarṇa khacitam nīla maṇinā paridhayaḥ śobhā āḍhyāḥ eva āsan madhya madhye puṣyarāga maṇīnām sthānam saṃbhrājate teṣām atitarām maṇi jyotsnām rājamānām abhyetya tasmāt paritas śata kuñja vidruma latāḥ suvarṇa sugandha latā grathitāḥ su sugandha āḍhyam ātanvan

original: teṣāmeva maṇīnāṃ śaktayo virājante | puṣpitavṛkṣalatā sugandharasābhyeti | tatsugandhāveśitāḥ sakhyo bhāvāpannā ramaṇarasaramaṇe rasaramaṇānande rase magnā bhaktāḥ premavatyādayo līlāyāṃ yogyatāmabhiyanti | ratikrīḍāyāmānandarasaḥ saṃbhavati | te sakhyastasmādutpannā bhavanti | śṛṅgārarasaṃ dṛṣṭigocaramupasaṃpadyante |
analyzed: teṣām eva maṇīnām śaktayaḥ virājante puṣpita vṛkṣa latā sugandha rasa abhyeti tad sugandha āveśitāḥ sakhyaḥ bhāva āpannāḥ ramaṇa rasa ramaṇe rasa ramaṇa ānande rase magnāḥ bhaktāḥ premavatī ādayaḥ līlāyām yogyatām abhiyanti rati krīḍāyām ānanda rasaḥ saṃbhavati te sakhyaḥ tasmāt utpannāḥ bhavanti śṛṅgāra rasam dṛṣṭi gocaram upasaṃpadyante

original: tasmāt ramaṇānandādutpannā ātmānandarūpiṇaḥ | yatra yatra tayā devyā svāveśena sukhaṃ susaṃsiddho'yaṃ rasaḥ | tāsāṃ gopīnāṃ gṛhaṃgṛhamāpadyamānaḥ pratirūpaṃ sukhaṃ saṃyojayati | tāsāmeva rasāveśena rāsasthānaṃ śatayojanāyataṃ padmarāgamaṇijaṭilanīlamaṇinā virājitaṃ jāṃbūnadamaṇinā suvarṇena jaṭitaṃ śataśo maṇikhacitam |
analyzed: tasmāt ramaṇānandāt utpannāḥ ātma ānanda rūpiṇaḥ yatra yatra tayā devyā sva āveśena sukham su saṃsiddhaḥ yam rasaḥ tāsām gopīnām gṛham gṛham āpadyamānaḥ pratirūpam sukham saṃyojayati tāsām eva rasa āveśena rāsasthānam śata yojana āyatam padmarāga maṇi jaṭila nīla maṇinā virājitam jāṃbūnada maṇinā suvarṇena jaṭitam śataśas maṇi khacitam

original: tasmiṃsthāne maṇistaṃbhāḥ śataśo virājamānāstasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ svāveśena anekaśo rūpāṇi kṛtvā ātmānaṃ vibhajya svarasabhogasukhaṃ saṃbhuñjate | yathāyathā rūpāṇi tathātathā rasikānandasya rūpāṇi sukhaṃ saṃbhokṣyante | teṣu teṣu rūpeṣu krīḍantyastāḥ nikuñjadevyāḥ svāmibhāvena vrajalīlāyāḥ sukhamāpadyante | sa eva rāsaḥ |
analyzed: tasmin sthāne maṇi staṃbhāḥ śataśas virājamānāḥ tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ sva āveśena anekaśas rūpāṇi kṛtvā ātmānam vibhajya sva rasa bhoga sukham saṃbhuñjate yathā yathā rūpāṇi tathā tathā rasika ānandasya rūpāṇi sukham saṃbhokṣyante teṣu teṣu rūpeṣu krīḍantyaḥ tāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ svāmi bhāvena vraja līlāyāḥ sukham āpadyante saḥ eva rāsaḥ

original: ānandādramaṇānando'yaṃ yojyate | candrāvalīcandrabhāgāsuśroṇīsubhagādyāḥ śataśo gopabhāryā vedaṛcaḥ | vedapuruṣā ime gopāstāsāṃ gopīnāṃ svāminyā ātmasvarūpeṇa svayameva ramaṇānandenāyojyanta | agninā prajvalitā rajjurdṛśyamānā agnirevābhāti | gokulo'yamagneḥ saṃyogādevābhāti |
analyzed: ānandāt ramaṇānandaḥ uyam yojyate candrāvalī candrabhāgā suśroṇī subhagā ādyāḥ śataśas gopa bhāryāḥ vedaṛcaḥ veda puruṣāḥ ime gopāḥ tāsām gopīnām svāminyāḥ ātma svarūpeṇa svayam eva ramaṇānandena ayojyanta agninā prajvalitā rajjuḥ dṛśyamānā agniḥ eva ābhāti gokulaḥ yam agneḥ saṃyogāt eva ābhāti

original: tā gopyastadbhāvena rasaṃ anubhavantyastasyā nikuñjadevyā bhāvamāpannā āsan | dvayo rāsayoridaṃ bhavati | tṛtīye rāse tu gṛhaṃ gṛhaṃ prati
analyzed: tāḥ gopyaḥ tad bhāvena rasam anubhavantyaḥ tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ bhāvam āpannāḥ āsan dvayoḥ rāsayoḥ idam bhavati tṛtīye rāse tu gṛham gṛham prati

original: svayaṃsvayameva rasikānandasvarūpe krīḍitā āsan | svānandāvirbhāvāya tāsāṃ yogyatāṃ nirūpayati | sukhamanubhavantya ātmabhāva evāsan |
analyzed: svayam svayam eva rasika ānanda svarūpe krīḍitāḥ āsan sva ānanda āvirbhāvāya tāsām yogyatām nirūpayati sukham anubhavantyaḥ ātma bhāve eva āsan

original: caturthe tu gorasavikrīḍā gopyaścandrāvalīprabhṛtayo'nekaśo dānalīlayā nikuñjadevyā svāveśena sukhamanubhūya tadvacanādabhīṣṭāni pratipadya yogyānīndriyāṇi parasparasukhaṃ bhuñjānāstasyā nikuñjadevyā rasikaśiromaṇinā saha sukhaṃ svayameva rūpeṇa anubhavanti | pañcamī mahālīlā svayameva vṛṣabhānugṛhe prakaṭitā |
analyzed: caturthe tu gorasa vikrīḍāḥ gopyaḥ candrāvalī prabhṛtayaḥ nekaśas dāna līlayā nikuñja devyā sva āveśena sukham anubhūya tad vacanāt abhīṣṭāni pratipadya yogyāni indriyāṇi paraspara sukham bhuñjānāḥ tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ rasika śiromaṇinā saha sukham svayam eva rūpeṇa anubhavanti pañcamī mahā līlā svayam eva vṛṣabhānu gṛhe prakaṭitā

original: tāṃ tayā saha puruṣottamarasikānando'yaṃ svayameva vrajalīlāyāṃ prakaṭitavān | saḥ eva sukhaṃ ramaṇānandarūpeṇa saṃbhokṣyamāṇo'bhavat | parasparabālalīlāsukhayugmarūpe ekameva rūpaṃ bhavati | evaṃ tasmin vṛṣabhānugṛhe sthānāni śataśaḥ padmarāgakuḍyāni gṛhāṇi taptasuvarṇaparidhīni virājamānāni bhavanti |
analyzed: tām tayā saha puruṣottama rasika ānandaḥ yam svayam eva vraja līlāyām prakaṭitavān saḥ eva sukham ramaṇa ānanda rūpeṇa saṃbhokṣyamāṇaḥ bhavat paraspara bāla līlā sukha yugma rūpe ekam eva rūpam bhavati evam tasmin vṛṣabhānu gṛhe sthānāni śataśas padmarāga kuḍyāni gṛhāṇi tapta suvarṇa paridhīni virājamānāni bhavanti

original: lalitāviśākhāśṛṅgāravatyādayaḥ svayameva prakaṭitā sakhyaḥ svayameva svarasaṃ prāptāḥ rasamānandātmakamanubhavanti | anyāśca śataśo gopībhāvaṃ prāptāstāṃ līlāṃ prāptā bhavanti | yaṃ yaṃ bhāvaṃ saṃyokṣyamāṇā gopī bhavettaṃ bhāvaṃ dvāri prāpya rāsalīlākṛte ujjahāra |
analyzed: lalitā viśākhā śṛṅgāravatī ādayaḥ svayam eva prakaṭitā sakhyaḥ svayam eva sva rasam prāptāḥ rasam ānanda ātmakam anubhavanti anyāḥ ca śataśas gopī bhāvam prāptāḥ tām līlām prāptāḥ bhavanti yam yam bhāvam saṃyokṣyamāṇā gopī bhavet tam bhāvam dvāri prāpya rāsa līlā kṛte ujjahāra

original: atyantabhāvalīlāyāṃ saṃyokṣyamāṇā gopī puṣkariṇyāṃ tāsāmaṅgarāgeṇa gopīcandanaṃ tāsāmevocchiṣṭaṃ bubhuje | bhaktānāṃ tadeva hitakāri bhaveta | tadaṅgarāgodbhūtatadāvirbhāvena mahālīlāyogyatāṃ pratipedire | punaḥ saṃśayaṃ papracchuḥ |
analyzed: atyanta bhāva līlāyām saṃyokṣyamāṇā gopī puṣkariṇyām tāsām aṅgarāgeṇa gopīcandanam tāsām eva ucchiṣṭam bubhuje bhaktānām tat eva hita kāri bhaveta tad aṅgarāga udbhūta tad āvirbhāvena mahā līlā yogyatām pratipedire punar saṃśayam papracchuḥ

original: aho dvārikāyāṃ rāsa kasmin samaye kṛtaḥ? tatra mahālīlāyāḥ sthānaṃ kutrāsti? yatra rasikānanda puruṣottamaḥ krīḍati | ke'tra bhaktāḥ? keṣāṃ sahāyena mahālīlāsthānaṃ prakaṭitam? śṛṇuta sakhyaḥ | mahānayaṃ gopyo rasaḥ | ye pratyayāpannā bhaktāste taṃ rasamanubhavanti vrajalīlāyām | trividhā gopyaḥ santi | ekā vedaṛcaḥ santi | eke agnikumārāḥ santi |
analyzed: aho dvārikāyām rāsa kasmin samaye kṛtaḥ tatra mahā līlāyāḥ sthānam kutra asti yatra rasika ānanda puruṣottamaḥ krīḍati bhaktāḥ keṣām sahāyena mahā līlā sthānam prakaṭitam śṛṇuta sakhyaḥ mahān ayam gopyaḥ rasaḥ ye pratyaya āpannāḥ bhaktāḥ te tam rasam anubhavanti vraja līlāyām trividhāḥ gopyaḥ santi ekā veda ṛcaḥ santi eke agni kumārāḥ santi

original: eke saṃsiddhāḥ śrīrādhikayā saha prakaṭitā bhavanti | aṣṭau yūthāni saṃsiddhānāṃ bhavanti | teṣāṃ dvādaśa yūthāni brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ
analyzed: eke saṃsiddhāḥ śrī rādhikayā saha prakaṭitāḥ bhavanti aṣṭau yūthāni saṃsiddhānām bhavanti teṣām dvādaśa yūthāni brahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ

original: agnikumārāḥ santi | dvādaśa yūthāni vedastrīṇāṃ santi | te sādhanasiddhāḥ ye bhaktāḥ śrīrādhikayā saha rasikānandopāsakā bhavanti | yāḥ saṃsiddhāstāsāṃ nityalīlāyāmanubhavaḥ | ye agnikumārāste vrajalīlāyāṃ śrīrādhikayā saha rasikānandamupāsamānāstāṃ līlāṃ prāptā bhavanti | yā vedarūpiṇyastāsāṃ virahabhāvena mahānanugraha kṛta |
analyzed: agni kumārāḥ santi dvādaśa yūthāni veda strīṇām santi te sādhana siddhāḥ ye bhaktāḥ śrī rādhikayā saha rasika ānanda upāsakāḥ bhavanti yāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ tāsām nitya līlāyām anubhavaḥ ye agni kumārāḥ te vraja līlāyām śrī rādhikayā saha rasika ānandam upāsamānāḥ tām līlām prāptāḥ bhavanti yāḥ veda rūpiṇyaḥ tāsām viraha bhāvena mahān anugraha kṛta

original: prathamaṃ mahālīlāyāḥ prāptiḥ paścādvirahaḥ | tā virahotkaṇṭhitā gopyo nānyasukhaṃ viduḥ | tāsāmarthe pañcayojanaparyantaṃ mahālīlāyāḥ sthānaṃ prakaṭīkṛtam | tāsāṃ manobhāvabubhutsayā ekaṃ svagaṇaṃ rahasyalīlāyogyaṃ preṣayāmāsa | dvārikālīlāyāṃ mahālīlā prakaṭitā | sa eva gaṇastāstatraiva nayati | rasikānandastāsāṃ svalīlāmāviṣkaroti |
analyzed: prathamam mahā līlāyāḥ prāptiḥ paścāt virahaḥ tāḥ viraha utkaṇṭhitāḥ gopyaḥ na anya sukham viduḥ tāsām arthe pañca yojana paryantam mahā līlāyāḥ sthānam prakaṭīkṛtam tāsām manobhāva bubhutsayā ekam sva gaṇam rahasya līlā yogyam preṣayāmāsa dvārikā līlāyām mahā līlā prakaṭitā saḥ eva gaṇaḥ tāḥ tatra eva nayati rasika ānandaḥ tāsām sva līlām āviṣkaroti

original: rukmiṇyādyāḥ paṭṭarājñyastāṃ līlāṃ śrutvā utkaṇṭhitāḥ babhūvu | tābhi prārthito rasikānando mahālīlāṃ darśayāmāsa | tadā rasikānandenoktāstāḥ paṭṭarājñyo bhavantyastallīlāyogyā na bhavanti | imāḥ līlā loke vedamaryādātiriktā | rasamārgopāsakā bhaktāḥ striyastāṃ līlāṃ jānanti | vayaṃ rājaputrya kathaṃ tasyāṃ līlāyāṃ yogyā na bhavema | bahuśa.
analyzed: rukmiṇī ādyāḥ paṭṭarājñyaḥ tām līlām śrutvā utkaṇṭhitāḥ babhūvu tābhiḥ prārthitaḥ rasika ānandaḥ mahā līlām darśayāmāsa tadā rasika ānandena uktāḥ tāḥ paṭṭarājñyaḥ bhavantyaḥ tad līlā yogyāḥ na bhavanti imāḥ līlāḥ loke veda maryādā atiriktāḥ rasa mārga upāsakāḥ bhaktāḥ striyaḥ tām līlām jānanti vayam rājaputrya katham tasyām līlāyām yogyāḥ na bhavema bahuśas

original: prārthito rasikānandastathetyuktvā punarāha | aho rājaputryo bhavatīnāṃ yadi mahālīlādarśanākāṅkṣā bhavati tarhi ahaṃ niśīthe ādhidevikīṃ rātriṃ prakaṭayiṣyāmi | tatrādhidaiviko'yaṃ candrastatrādhidaivikā bhaktāḥ līlopayogyā bhavanti | bhavatyastatraivāyāntu | iti kathitāstāḥ sarvāḥ vismayāpannā babhūvuḥ | aho atyantamāścaryo'yaṃ vilāsaḥ |
analyzed: prārthitaḥ rasika ānandaḥ tathā iti uktvā punar āha aho rāja putryaḥ bhavatīnām yadi mahā līlā darśana ākāṅkṣā bhavati tarhi aham niśīthe ādhidevikīm rātrim prakaṭayiṣyāmi tatra ādhidaivikaḥ yam candraḥ tatra ādhidaivikāḥ bhaktāḥ līlā upayogyāḥ bhavanti bhavatyaḥ tatra eva āyāntu iti kathitāḥ tāḥ sarvāḥ vismaya āpannāḥ babhūvuḥ aho atyantam āścaryaḥ yam vilāsaḥ

original: tatrāgatā suyogā sakhī rāsalīlāyāṃ yogaṃ cakāra | sakhī tatra rāsalīlāṃ racayati | tatra rasikānandaḥ puruṣottamo'timanohararūpeṇa tāsāṃ manāṃsi jahre | tāḥ sarvā gopyaḥ śrīrādhikāyāḥ kṛpāvaśena ramayāṃcakruḥ | tatra rasikānandena brahmarātriḥ prakaṭitā | tasyāṃ rātrau tāḥ sarvā manorathaśatai ramayāṃcakruḥ |
analyzed: tatra āgatā suyogā sakhī rāsa līlāyām yogam cakāra sakhī tatra rāsa līlām racayati tatra rasika ānandaḥ tāsām manāṃsi jahre tāḥ sarvāḥ gopyaḥ śrī rādhikāyāḥ kṛpā vaśena ramayāṃcakruḥ tatra rasika ānandena brahmarātriḥ prakaṭitā tasyām rātrau tāḥ sarvāḥ manoratha śataiḥ ramayāṃcakruḥ

original: krīḍānte brahmarātrirapāvṛttā babhūva | dvārikāyāṃ sthitā rājaputrya dvāre sthitān gurūnugrasenavasudevādyān dadṛśuḥ | rasikānandena mohitāstatra sthitā guravo dadṛśuḥ | tāsāṃ tā rātrayo rāsalīlāyā dhyānena vyatītāḥ | brahmarātrirapāpāvṛtteti prātastā sarvāstatraiva samāgatāḥ | tatra tatsthānaṃ dadṛśuḥ |
analyzed: krīḍā ante brahma rātriḥ apāvṛttā babhūva dvārikāyām sthitāḥ dvāre sthitān gurūn ugrasena vasudeva ādyān dadṛśuḥ rasika ānandena mohitāḥ tatra sthitāḥ guravaḥ dadṛśuḥ tāsām tāḥ rātrayaḥ rāsa līlāyāḥ dhyānena vyatītāḥ brahma rātriḥ apāpāvṛttā iti prātar tā sarvāḥ tatra eva samāgatāḥ tatra tad sthānam dadṛśuḥ

original: yatra maṇilatā muktālatā suvarṇalatāḥ puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalaiḥ saṃpūrṇā maṇistaṃbhairgrathitā nikuñjatāṃ prāpnuvanti | siddhayo mūrtimatyaḥ tatraiva sthitā dadṛśire | kāmadevo ratyā saha tatraiva dadṛśe | tatra sthitāḥ gopyo rasikānandena saṃyuktāstāsāṃ rājaputrīṇāṃ līlāṃ dṛṣṭvā nirgalitamānā babhūvuḥ | tāḥ praśrayāvanatā rasikānandaṃ papracchuḥ |
analyzed: yatra maṇi latāḥ muktā latā suvarṇa latāḥ puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalaiḥ saṃpūrṇāḥ maṇi staṃbhaiḥ grathitāḥ nikuñja tām prāpnuvanti siddhayaḥ mūrtimatyaḥ tatra eva sthitāḥ dadṛśire kāmadevaḥ ratyā saha tatra eva dadṛśe tatra sthitāḥ gopyaḥ rasika ānandena saṃyuktāḥ tāsām rāja putrīṇām līlām dṛṣṭvā nirgalita mānāḥ babhūvuḥ tāḥ praśraya avanatāḥ rasika ānandam papracchuḥ

original: aho rāsalīlāmasmākaṃ darśaya | tābhiḥ? prārthito rasikānandaḥ provāca | samayo'yaṃ vyatītaḥ | brahmarātristu gatā | mayā bhavatīnāṃ pūrvaṃ kathitamasti | bhavatyo rāsalīlāyāṃ yogyā na bhavanti | ye vedoktakarmamārgaratāste kadācidimāṃ līlāṃ na jānanti | tasmāt bhavatya imā līlāyogyā na bhavanti |
analyzed: aho rāsa līlām asmākam darśaya tābhiḥ prārthitaḥ rasika ānandaḥ provāca samayaḥ yam vyatītaḥ brahmarātriḥ tu gatā mayā bhavatīnām pūrvam kathitam asti bhavatyaḥ rāsa līlāyām yogyāḥ na bhavanti ye veda ukta karma mārga ratāḥ te kadācid imām līlām na jānanti tasmāt bhavatyaḥ imāḥ līlā yogyāḥ na bhavanti

original: brahmaloke sthitā rudraloke sthitā indraloke sthitā nāgaloke sthitāḥ striyastā apīmāṃ līlāṃ na jānanti | anye mama bhaktāḥ bahavaḥ santi | te'pīmāṃ līlāṃ na jānanti | tasmāt bhavatyo nirgalitamānā jātāḥ | tena bhāvenaitāsāṃ darśanaṃ na prāptāḥ | tāḥ rājaputryo rukmiṇyādyā rasikānandenoktā dṛṣṭvā prasannā babhūvuḥ | tāsāṃ nāmāni papracchuḥ |
analyzed: brahma loke sthitāḥ rudra loke sthitāḥ indra loke sthitāḥ nāga loke sthitāḥ striyaḥ tāḥ api imām līlām na jānanti anye mama bhaktāḥ bahavaḥ santi te api imām līlām na jānanti tasmāt bhavatyaḥ nirgalita mānāḥ jātāḥ tena bhāvena etāsām darśanam na prāptāḥ tāḥ rāja putryaḥ rukmiṇī ādyāḥ rasika ānandena uktāḥ dṛṣṭvā prasannāḥ babhūvuḥ tāsām nāmāni papracchuḥ

original: suyogajā sakhī tāsāṃ gopīnāṃ nāmāni kathayāmāsa | iyaṃ candrāvalī nāmnā tathā candrakalā vikhyātā | candrānanā rohiṇī manoramā mādhavī puṣpagandhā suratakalāvatī bhogavatī haṃsagamanā guṇavatī gānavatī suratakalākovidā suvihāravatī nṛtyakalābhijñā etā sakhyaḥ svayūthaistanmaṇḍalaṃ sevamānā bhavanti | tāḥ paṭṭarājñyastāḥ saṃpūjayāmāsuḥ |
analyzed: suyogajā sakhī tāsām gopīnām nāmāni kathayāmāsa iyam candrāvalī nāmnā tathā candrakalā vikhyātā candrānanā rohiṇī manoramā mādhavī puṣpagandhā surata kalāvatī bhogavatī haṃsagamanā guṇavatī gānavatī surata kalā kovidā suvihāravatī nṛtya kalā abhijñā etāḥ sakhyaḥ sva yūthaiḥ tat maṇḍalam sevamānāḥ bhavanti tāḥ paṭṭarājñyaḥ tāḥ saṃpūjayāmāsuḥ

original: nānāsugandhāṅgarāgeṇa vastrālaṅkārabhūṣaṇaistāsāṃ śṛṅgāramakurvan | tāsāmucchiṣṭajalena paṅkāṅgarāgeṇa gopīpuṣkariṇīti vikhyātā babhūva | yasyāmutpannā mṛttikā atipavitrā bhavati | tā gopyastadbhāvena mahālīlāyāṃ layaṃ prāptā babhūvuḥ | sā lakṣmīḥ praśrayāvanatā nārāyaṇaṃ papraccha |
analyzed: nānā sugandha aṅgarāgeṇa vastra alaṅkāra bhūṣaṇaiḥ tāsām śṛṅgāram akurvan tāsām ucchiṣṭa jalena paṅka aṅgarāgeṇa gopīpuṣkariṇī iti vikhyātā babhūva yasyām utpannā mṛttikā ati pavitrā bhavati tāḥ gopyaḥ tad bhāvena mahā līlāyām layam prāptāḥ babhūvuḥ sā lakṣmīḥ praśraya avanatā nārāyaṇam papraccha

original: te'gnikumārāḥ ṛṣayaḥ kutaḥ samutpannāḥ? tairidaṃ sthānaṃ kathaṃ prāptam? kena sādhanena te siddhā bhavanti? sa hovāca | pūrvaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ sanakādinā pṛṣṭaḥ | mahālīlāyāḥ sthānaṃ kathaya | yatra rasikānandaḥ śrīrādhikayā saha nityaṃ krīḍati | tatpraśnenāturo brahmā dhyānāpanno babhūva | sa samādhau mahālīlāṃ dadarśa |
analyzed: te agni kumārāḥ ṛṣayaḥ kutas samutpannāḥ taiḥ idam sthānam katham prāptam kena sādhanena te siddhāḥ bhavanti sa ha uvāca pūrvam brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ sanaka ādinā pṛṣṭaḥ mahālīlāyāḥ sthānam kathaya yatra rasika ānandaḥ śrī rādhikayā saha nityam krīḍati tad praśnena āturaḥ brahmā dhyāna āpannaḥ babhūva sa samādhau mahālīlām dadarśa

original: taddarśanena vikalendriyo babhūva | tata indriyebhyo retaḥ āpadyata | tato retaḥ agnau nyapatat | gārhapatyakuṇḍe nipatitaṃ retaḥ puruṣāyitaṃ babhūva | tataḥ samutpannāḥ puruṣā agnikumārā bhavanti | tataste ṛṣayo govardhanādrau śirasi tapa ātanvan | taddinamārabhyaite tu ṛṣayo vrajaṃ sevamānā babhūvuḥ |
analyzed: tad darśanena vikala indriyaḥ babhūva tatas indriyebhyaḥ retaḥ āpadyata tatas retaḥ agnau nyapatat gārhapatya kuṇḍe nipatitam retaḥ puruṣāyitam babhūva tatas samutpannāḥ puruṣāḥ agni kumārāḥ bhavanti tatas te ṛṣayaḥ govardhana adrau śirasi tapaḥ ātanvan tad dinam ārabhya ete tu ṛṣayaḥ vrajam sevamānāḥ babhūvuḥ

original: ekadā te ṛṣayo govardhanādrau śirasyekāṃ kanyāṃ dadṛśuḥ | śrīrādhikayānugṛhītāṃ sarvāṅgamanoharāṃ tatrāpsaraḥpuṣkariṇyāṃ majjamānā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā te praśrayeṇa namrā babhūvuḥ | sā kanyā tān pratyuvāca | bho ṛṣayaḥ kuta samāyātāḥ? kiṃ kuruta? ṛṣaya ūcuḥ | vayaṃ brahmaṇa putrā asmin vane nivasanto mahāvanavihāralīlādarśanakāṅkṣiṇo bhavāmaḥ |
analyzed: ekadā te ṛṣayaḥ govardhana adrau śirasi ekām kanyām dadṛśuḥ śrīrādhikayā anugṛhītām sarva aṅga manoharām tatra apsaraḥ puṣkariṇyām majjamānā tām dṛṣṭvā te praśrayeṇa namrāḥ babhūvuḥ sā kanyā tān pratyuvāca bho ṛṣayaḥ kutas samāyātāḥ kim kuruta ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ vayam brahmaṇa putrāḥ asmin vane nivasantaḥ mahā vana vihāra līlā darśana kāṅkṣiṇaḥ bhavāmaḥ

original: punaste'gnikumārā ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ | bho bhavatī kutaḥ samāyātā kiṃ kāryaṃ kurute? idaṃ rahasyam | yadi manasi kṛpāviṣṭā tarhi rahasyaṃ kathaya | sādhavo dīnavatsalā evāsate | tayā devyā anugṛhītānāṃ teṣāmatikṛpāśālī svabhāvo'yamāpadyate | sā punaruvācedaṃ svayameva karuṇayā | aho ahamapi pūrvaṃ mahārudrarājña putrī āsam |
analyzed: punar te agni kumārāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ūcuḥ bho bhavatī kutas samāyātā kim kāryam kurute idam rahasyam yadi manasi kṛpā āviṣṭā tarhi rahasyam kathaya sādhavaḥ dīna vatsalāḥ eva āsate tayā devyā anugṛhītānām teṣām ati kṛpā śālī svabhāvaḥ yam āpadyate sā punar uvāca idam svayam eva karuṇayā aho aham api pūrvam mahā rudra rājña putrī āsam

original: tasya gṛhe nirantaramata ita krīḍamānā gītagānairharerlīlāṃ manasyāsāditāsmi | tasya guruvibhāṇḍakamuniputrī rūpaśālinī nāmnā sā
analyzed: tasya gṛhe nirantaram atas ita krīḍamānā gīta gānaiḥ hareḥ līlām manasi āsāditā asmi tasya guru vibhāṇḍaka muni putrī rūpaśālinī nāmnā sā

original: nirantaraṃ tasyāṃ līlāyāṃ sadā dhyānānubhāvanā tayā devyānugṛhītā līlopayogyaiti | tadā śrāvitānāmadhunātanīṃ līlāṃ sopariṣṭāmabhyeti | te ūcuḥ | ko mantraḥ? ka upadeśaḥ? kiṃ dhyānaṃ tasyāḥ? upadiśa | yadi karuṇāvatī vada | śṛṇutedaṃ rahasyam | na kadācidvacanīyo'yaṃ rasaḥ sarva eva | dharmādharmaviraktā ye bhaktāsteṣāmapyavacanīyaḥ |
analyzed: nirantaram tasyām līlāyām sadā dhyāna anubhāvanā tayā devyā anugṛhītā līlā upayogyā eti tadā śrāvitānām adhunātanīm līlām sa upariṣṭām abhyeti te ūcuḥ kaḥ mantraḥ kaḥ upadeśaḥ kim dhyānam tasyāḥ upadiśa yadi karuṇāvatī vada śṛṇuta idam rahasyam na kadācid vacanīyaḥ ayam rasaḥ sarve eva dharma adharma viraktāḥ ye bhaktāḥ teṣām api avacanīyaḥ

original: rasarahasyavidyāmupāsamānaḥ sadyodarśanamāpadyate | oṃ klīṃ klīṃ rādhe saṃmohini kāmadātri kāmakelikalārūpiṇi namo namaste | idaṃ rahasyaṃ sarveṣāmapi durlabhataram | ānandarasikaśiromaṇimohanena rūpeṇa sadyolakṣaṃ japitvā dhyānāpanno bhavet |
analyzed: rasa rahasya vidyām upāsamānaḥ sadyodarśanam āpadyate om klīṃ klīṃ rādhe saṃmohini kāma dātri kāma keli kalā rūpiṇi namaḥ namaḥ te idam rahasyam sarveṣām api durlabhataram ānanda rasika śiromaṇi mohanena rūpeṇa sadyas lakṣam japitvā dhyāna āpannaḥ bhavet

original: saṃśṛṇuyāttāṃ sā navakiśorī taptahāṭakābharaṇā keśacchaṭācikkaṇasugandharasaplāvitasīmantasindūrasecitamaṇighaṭitasuvarṇabhūṣaṇairbhūṣitā ratnakarṇabhūṣaṇajvalitakuṇḍalābhyāmanyaiḥ śuṭyādyairbhūṣaṇaiḥ saṃyojitā kesaramṛgamadakarpūracandananānārekhāsaṃyojitalalāṭā maṇihīrakajātyatilakayojitā saṃśobhate |
analyzed: saṃśṛṇuyāt tām sā nava kiśorī tapta hāṭaka ābharaṇā keśa chaṭā cikkaṇa sugandha rasa plāvita sīmanta sindūra secita maṇi ghaṭita suvarṇa bhūṣaṇaiḥ bhūṣitā ratna karṇa bhūṣaṇa jvalita kuṇḍalābhyām anyaiḥ śuṭi ādyaiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ saṃyojitā kesara mṛgamada karpūra candana nānā rekhā saṃyojita lalāṭā maṇi hīraka jāti atilaka yojitā saṃśobhate

original: kāmakārmukabhrūlatāsaṃmohitarasikānandā tadbāṇamūrcchiteyaṃ sadā tadāveśayogyatāṃ prapadya dhyāyamānā bhavati | tāṃ prapadya sa viśvajayī bhavet | netrakṛpākaṭākṣairbhaktā nāmabhayadāyinī bhavati | khañjanamīnacāñcalyavaśīkṛto rasikānando bhavet | nāsācañcuratitarāṃ tejasā rājate | kapolau suvarṇasaṃpuṭau tejomayau bhātaḥ |
analyzed: kāma kārmuka bhrū latā saṃmohita rasika ānandā tad bāṇa mūrcchitā iyam sadā tad āveśa yogyatām prapadya dhyāyamānā bhavati tām prapadya sa viśva jayī bhavet netra kṛpā kaṭākṣaiḥ bhaktā nāma bhaya dāyinī bhavati khañjana mīna cāñcalya vaśīkṛtaḥ rasika ānandaḥ bhavet nāsā cañcuḥ atitarām tejasā rājate kapolau suvarṇa saṃpuṭau tejaḥ mayau bhātaḥ

original: śobhate nāsā ābharaṇaracitā | maṇimayamuktāphalairgumbhito bhavati bimbādharo vidrumakāntiḥ | dvijālī tārākārā bhavati | sā tejasā bhātitarām | jyotsnārājamānānanotkaṇṭhagrīvā rājante'titarāṃ kapolakaṇṭhādayaḥ | tiraskurvanti tasyā bāhuśobhāṃ keyūrakaṭakāni marakatagumbhitāni valayāni śataśaḥ tejomayāni |
analyzed: śobhate nāsā ābharaṇa racitā maṇi maya muktāphalaiḥ gumbhitaḥ bhavati bimba adharaḥ vidruma kāntiḥ dvijālī tāra ākārā bhavati sā tejasā bhātitarām jyotsnā rājamāna ānana utkaṇṭha grīvāḥ rājanta ititarām kapola kaṇṭha ādayaḥ tiraskurvanti tasyāḥ bāhu śobhām keyūra kaṭakāni marakata gumbhitāni valayāni śataśas tejaḥ mayāni

original: atitarāṃ laghu tārākānti tilakaṃ śobhāmatyeti | rājamānau hastau karatalābhyāṃ yāvakarasavibhāvitāṅgulībhyāṃ sūkṣmataramaṇighaṭikābhyāṃ bhavetām | suvarṇabhūṣaṇāni saṃrājamānāni surocante | tasyā vakṣojāvati
analyzed: atitarām laghu tārā kānti tilakam śobhām atyeti rājamānau hastau kara talābhyām yāvaka rasa vibhāvita aṅgulībhyām sūkṣmatara maṇi ghaṭikābhyām bhavetām suvarṇa bhūṣaṇāni saṃrājamānāni su rocante tasyāḥ vakṣojāvati

original: mṛgamadāgururacitāveva puruṣottamarasikānandaramaṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ saṃrājamānāveva bhavataḥ | muktāgumbhitahāravallīdvayau ca girī iva saṃrājamānau bhavataḥ | gambhīranābhihradasannidhāne navaromarājīyā śobhā hāṭakopaghaṭitanīlamaṇirājiriva rājate | kaṭimekhalā kṣudraghaṇṭikārājamānā maṇighaṭitahāṭakakhacitatārājālaśobhāmabhyeti |
analyzed: mṛgamada aguru racitau eva puruṣottama rasika ānanda ramaṇa adhiṣṭhānam saṃrājamānau eva bhavataḥ muktā gumbhita hāravallī dvayau ca girī iva saṃrājamānau bhavataḥ gambhīra nābhi hrada sannidhāne navaromarājīyā śobhā hāṭaka upaghaṭita nīla maṇi rājiḥ iva rājate kaṭi mekhalā kṣudra ghaṇṭikā rājamānā maṇi ghaṭita hāṭaka khacita tārā jāla śobhām abhyeti

original: sarājamānajaghanasthalavāsimohanagṛhaṃ saubhāgyāḍhyaṃ śaṃbaravairiṇo'dhiṣṭhānaṃ rasikānandaikakalasuratamamalāmbaraiḥ pariveṣṭitaṃ suvarṇatāra gumbhitaṃ śobhāyamānaṃ rājate | kadalīkāṇḍarucirāvūrū śobhāmabhītaḥ | caraṇakamalamañjarīśobhā rājamānā yāvakaraṅgarañjiteva śobhāmabhyeti | nakhacandratejasā rājamāno'yaṃ loko virājamabhyeti |

original: aho lakṣmi mama rūpāṇyanekaśo mamāvatārā anekaśaḥ | aṃśakalā āveśāḥ pūrṇāśāste'pīmāṃ līlāṃ na jānanti | anyāstavāṃśakalā utpannāstāḥ api līlāṃ na jānanti | anye ye śataśaḥ sahasraśaste'pi tasyā līlāyāḥ anantarā āpadyante | tasmāttattallīlopayogilīlāprāptirevāstām | na dharmo na karma na jñānam | na karma kevalam | eka eva tallīlāpāṭhaḥ |

original: ekaiva līlopasevā | kiśoranavanūtnavīyassadāvihārānandakalānidheḥ rasikānandaśiromaṇeḥ śrīrādhāśriyo'timohanasyopāsakā bhaktāsteṣāmupāsanam | tallīlāyogyatayā dharmopāsakā vaiṣṇavā vaikuṇṭhalīlāmanāśritāḥ sanakādayo nāradādayo'pi | jayantakumudajayavijayā anye ca ye teṣāṃ mama rūpāṇi rāsalīlāyogyā ye mamāvirbhāvāsteṣāṃ darśanaṃ na bhavatyeva |

original: anye karmopāsakāstāṃ līlāṃ svapne'pi na dadṛśuḥ | aho ananyabhaktiparā kāṣṭhā | aho madbhaktānāṃ paṅga

original: eva parā kāṣṭhā | tallīlākathā parā kāṣṭhā | tasyāṃ līlāyāṃ pratyayaḥ parā kāṣṭhā | anyakathādharmadānavratatīrthasādhanāni vimuktāni | yamaniyamaprāṇāyāmapratyāhārakalāsukhabhāvitā sāmānyabhaktirapi tyaktā | tallīlopāsakānāṃ ekaiva vrajalīlātāyata | ratau ramaṇānande ratirāsāṃ bhavati | avasthito'yaṃ rasaḥ | śuṣkavādināmanyāṃ līlāṃ na śṛṇuyāt |
analyzed: eva parā kāṣṭhā tad līlā kathā parā kāṣṭhā tasyām līlāyām pratyayaḥ parā kāṣṭhā anya kathā dharma dāna vrata tīrtha sādhanāni vimuktāni yama niyama prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra kalā sukha bhāvitā sāmānya bhaktiḥ api tyaktā tad līlā upāsakānām ekā eva vraja līlā atāyata ratau ramaṇa ānande ratiḥ āsām bhavati avasthitaḥ yam rasaḥ śuṣka vādinām anyām līlām na śṛṇuyāt

original: karmavedajanitāni karmopāsanāni ye kurvanti te karmajaḍā āsurāsteṣāṃ haṭhātsaṅgastyajyate | cittavṛttiṃ dūṣayati | yeṣāṃ saṅgaṃ nālapenna śṛṇuyāt te dharmavirodhinastāṃ līlāṃ na jānanti | tasmāttaddharmadṛḍhakāriṇo ye te sevyāḥ pūjyāḥ | te tāṃ līlāṃ dadati | ananyadharmān śṛṇuyāditi rasamārgiṇāṃ dharmaḥ |
analyzed: karma veda janitāni karma upāsanāni ye kurvanti te karma jaḍāḥ āsurāḥ teṣām haṭhāt saṅgaḥ tyajyate cittavṛttim dūṣayati yeṣām saṅgam na ālapet na śṛṇuyāt te dharma virodhinaḥ tām līlām na jānanti tasmāt tad dharma dṛḍha kāriṇaḥ ye te sevyāḥ pūjyāḥ te tām līlām dadati ananya dharmān śṛṇuyāt iti rasa mārgiṇām dharmaḥ

original: arasikā jīvāḥ karmajaḍā ye teṣāṃ sveṣṭaṃ na darśayet | sveṣṭasya vārtāmapi na śrāvayet | sakhāyo yeṣāṃ vidyāvirbhāvasteṣām | anyavidyārucirna bhavatyeva | yadananyadharme rucirāste'ruciranyatra bhavet | tasya sveṣṭe āvirbhavati ratiḥ | so'nyadiṣṭaṃ vismarati | gurukṛpayā jīvatvaṃ prapannānāmanugrahata anugrāhyānugrāhakabhāvena ratirāvirbhavati |
analyzed: arasikāḥ jīvāḥ karma jaḍāḥ ye teṣām sva iṣṭam na darśayet sva iṣṭasya vārtām api na śrāvayet sakhāyaḥ yeṣām vidyā āvirbhāvaḥ teṣām anya vidyā ruciḥ na bhavati eva yat ananya dharme ruciḥ āste ruciḥ anyatra bhavet tasya sva iṣṭe āvirbhavati ratiḥ saḥ nyat iṣṭam vismarati guru kṛpayā jīva tvam prapannānām anugrahataḥ anugrāhya anugrāhaka bhāvena ratiḥ āvirbhavati

original: atirateḥ snehaṃ vinā na prāptiḥ syāt | nārāyaṇaṃ prati lakṣmyā āvirbhūtayā tayā nikuñjadevyā yāni sukhānyanubhūyante teṣāṃ praśnaṃ punarabhivadati | ye sādhanasiddhāsteṣāṃ kutaḥ sthitiḥ | kayā saraṇyā tallokaprāptiḥ svaratirāste | kayā rasikānandena tasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ prāptirbhavet | ye gavāṃ gaṇāste'titarāṃ tasyā devyāḥ dṛṣṭigocarā evāsatām |
analyzed: atirateḥ sneham vinā na prāptiḥ syāt nārāyaṇam prati lakṣmyāḥ āvirbhūtayā tayā nikuñja devyāḥ yāni sukhāni anubhūyante teṣām praśnam punar abhivadati ye sādhana siddhāḥ teṣām kutas sthitiḥ kayā saraṇyā tad loka prāptiḥ sva ratiḥ āste kayā rasika ānandena tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ prāptiḥ bhavet ye gavām gaṇāḥ te ititarām tasyāḥ devyāḥ dṛṣṭi gocarāḥ eva asatām

original: puruṣo rasikānandaḥ svahastena teṣāṃ yathāsukhaṃ parimārjayan dadhidugdhanavanītādyān rasān svayameva bhuṅakte | ye vatsatarāsteṣāṃ svahastena pṛṣṭhabhāgān parimārjayati | teṣāṃ sthānaṃ kiyatpramāṇam | nandādayo gopā vṛṣabhānvādayaśca te gopāḥ sādhanasiddhā vā saṃsiddhā vā |
analyzed: puruṣaḥ rasika ānandaḥ sva hastena teṣām yathāsukham parimārjayan dadhi dugdha navanīta ādyān rasān svayam eva bhuṅakte ye vatsatarāḥ teṣām sva hastena pṛṣṭha bhāgān parimārjayati teṣām sthānam kiyat pramāṇam nanda ādayaḥ gopāḥ vṛṣabhānu ādayaḥ ca te gopāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ vā saṃsiddhāḥ vā

original: yaśodādyāḥ striyo mātṛbhāvaṃ prāptāstā anādisaṃsiddhā vā sādhanasaṃsidbhā vā | yāsāṃ

original: teṣāṃ vasunāmnā aṣṭau koṭayo vasavo devapravarā mama līlālokaṃ śrutvā talloke śrute utkaṇṭhamānā līlayāpeduriti śrutam | imaṃ mahimānamabhyetya vanalīlāsaktāḥ atitarāmāsatām | atilolupe citte tasyāṃ vrajalīlāyāṃ rādhā āsta | saṃsiddhanikuñjalīlāyāṃ mayopaviṣṭā maunenāpannabhāvā abhavan |

original: oṅkārāvirbhāvalīlārūpaśrīrādhārasikānandarūpaṃ pratipadya mano bhāvāpannaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ līlāṃ gāyamānā abhavan | te vasava ūcuḥ | oṃ śrīrādhārasikānandavinodābhyāṃ saṃyuktābhyāṃ namo namaḥ | nityakrīḍātmane namo namaḥ | kāmakelikautukātmane namo namaḥ | kelikautukātmane namo namaḥ | śṛṅgārarasavinodine namo namaḥ | dhātre krīḍāsaṃpādine namo namaḥ |

original: evaṃ stutastadā vasubhiḥ svānandāvirbhāvaṃ dadāvatiprīto rudro'yam | vasūnāṃ pravaro'yaṃ nando'bhavat | dharānāmnī strī yaśodāsta | bṛhadvasuśreṣṭhaḥ kīrtidevyā saha vṛṣabhānurabhavat | nikuñjadevyā rasikānandena saha yatrānando'bhavat |

original: nandopanandabhadrāśvakṛtavadugrabhaṅgodadhisāmantātirociṣmatkātyeyamatyanagharociṣmaduṣṇīṣaraśmivasusujayā anye ca śataśo vasavaḥ sādhanasiddhāḥ evāsata | teṣāṃ strīṣu śrīyaśodā sā ca satyā āsta | rasikānandaśiromaṇirvṛndāvaneśvaryā saha saṃkrīḍamāno'bhavat | atirūpalāvaṇyalavakasūkṣmasvarūpeṇainaṃ bhajamānāya nandarūpaṃ dattavān |

original: te gopā gopyaḥ | te parasparamekaprāṇā evāsata | te gopā ekaprāṇā ekarūpiṇa ṇkabhāvā abhavan | yeṣāṃ puruṣottama ānandaḥ | anyāśca gopyo nānābhajanabhāvamāviṣkṛtya bhajanānande bhajanaṃ kurvanti | atitarāṃ snehā'bhavat | sā lakṣmīrnārāyaṇamuvācedam | atyānando'yaṃ lokaḥ | yasmin loke kevalarasanidhirmohanena rūpeṇa krīḍāmakarot |

original: sā vṛndāvaneśvarī koṭyānandarūpā yatra bālakelikrīḍāṃ vyadadhāt | teṣāṃ sthānāni kīdṛgvidhāni | gṛhāṇi kīdṛgvidhāni | vada sarvamānandāvirbhāvena | bhajanānandaḥ sukhaṃ śrīrādhārasikamohanamevaṃ
analyzed: sā vṛndāvana īśvarī koṭi ānanda rūpā yatra bāla keli krīḍām vyadadhāt teṣām sthānāni kīdṛgvidhāni gṛhāṇi kīdṛgvidhāni vada sarvam ānanda āvirbhāvena bhajana ānandaḥ sukham śrī rādhā rasika mohanam evam

original: krīḍāmātanot | sa hovāca lakṣmīm | nandasya gṛhaṃ sarvasamṛddhyānandāvadhi maṇimayamādhidaivikena rūpeṇa svaprakāśamakarot | padmarāgamayaḥ kuḍyaḥ | suvarṇajāmbūnadaprākārā vīthayo virājamānā bhavanti | yatra vṛṣabhānugṛhaṃ nandagṛhādyojanāyitam | tasmāt sthānāt dvādaśa śreṇayo'titarāṃ laghukomalamaṇaya evāsan |
analyzed: krīḍām ātanot sa ha uvāca lakṣmīm nandasya gṛham sarva samṛddhi ānanda avadhi maṇi mayam ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa sva prakāśam akarot padmarāga mayaḥ kuḍyaḥ suvarṇa jāmbūnada prākārāḥ vīthayaḥ virājamānāḥ bhavanti yatra vṛṣabhānu gṛham nanda gṛhāt yojanāyitam tasmāt sthānāt dvādaśa śreṇayā utitarām laghu komala maṇayaḥ eva āsan

original: tāsu śreṇiṣvanekaśo latāpratāninya evāsan | suvarṇayūthikāpravālairmaṇīnāraṅgaprarohairānandakrīḍāsthānamanuracitaṃ bhavati | tatredaṃ saṃketasthānam | aho lakṣmi kiṃ varṇyate caturyojanāyitam | nandavṛṣabhānorgṛhāt dvādaśa śreṇayo virājamānā saṅketasthalāduparitaḥ | teṣu sthāneṣu madhyasthitā anekaśo vividhalatāprāvārā abhiyanti |
analyzed: tāsu śreṇiṣu anekaśas latā pratāninyaḥ eva āsan suvarṇa yūthikā pravālaiḥ maṇī nāraṅga prarohaiḥ ānanda krīḍā sthānam anuracitam bhavati tatra idam saṃketa sthānam aho lakṣmi kim varṇyate catur yojanāyitam nanda vṛṣabhānoḥ gṛhāt dvādaśa śreṇayaḥ virājamānā saṅketa sthalāt uparitas teṣu sthāneṣu madhya sthitāḥ anekaśas vividha latā prāvārāḥ abhiyanti

original: muktālatāgrathitā maṇīnāṃ tejasā pradyotitā abhyetyatitarām | sahasranikuñjā kadambalatā sugandhasaṃvalitātitarāṃ vistīrṇābhyeti subhagā kadambamañjarī | haritapītanīktyetaśubhrāḥ kadambāśca parāgoddhṛtaparidhayaḥ suvāsitā āsan | tadgandhalolupabhramarāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sādhanasiddhā anekaśaḥ komalakalaṃ yaśo gāyamānāḥ santi |
analyzed: muktā latā grathitā maṇīnām tejasā pradyotitā abhyeti atitarām sahasra nikuñjā kadamba latā sugandha saṃvalitā atitarām vistīrṇā abhyeti subhagā kadambamañjarī kadambāḥ ca parāga uddhṛta paridhayaḥ su vāsitāḥ āsan tad gandha lolupa bhramarāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ anekaśas komala kalam yaśaḥ gāyamānāḥ santi

original: kokilapikaśukāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sādhanasiddhā anekakomalakalaṃ gāyamānāḥ santi | rūpalāvaṇyayutāḥ haṃsamayūrādayo'nekaśo rucirā bhavanti | te tasmin sthāne rasikānande'timohanarūpe nityaṃ saṃkrīḍamānā bhavanti | vṛndāvaneśvarīnityakrīḍāpradhānaṃ bhavati rāsasakhīnāṃ samūhena daśasahasrāṇāṃ sametānāṃ vṛṣabhānorgṛham |
analyzed: kokila pika śukāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ aneka komala kalam gāyamānāḥ santi rūpa lāvaṇya yutāḥ haṃsa mayūra ādayaḥ anekaśas rucirāḥ bhavanti te tasmin sthāne rasika ānanda iti mohana rūpe nityam saṃkrīḍamānāḥ bhavanti vṛndāvana īśvarī nitya krīḍā pradhānam bhavati rāsa sakhīnām samūhena daśa sahasrāṇām sametānām vṛṣabhānoḥ gṛham

original: vṛṣabhānupuraṃ pūrṇānandayutaṃ premānandayutaṃ sukhasantatiyutam | sarvāḥ samṛddhayo dvāre tiṣṭhanti | aṣṭamahāsiddhayo dvāre dvāre tiṣṭhanti | atitarāṃ sukhasaṃpattiḥ svarūpeṇa susevate | ye ye vidyāsadharmāṇaḥ subhagāḥ suratakalākāmanidrālajjāpremasuratotkaṇṭhādayaste virājamānā bhavanti |
analyzed: vṛṣabhānu puram pūrṇa ānanda yutam prema ānanda yutam sukha santati yutam sarvāḥ samṛddhayaḥ dvāre tiṣṭhanti aṣṭa mahāsiddhayaḥ dvāre dvāre tiṣṭhanti atitarām sukha saṃpattiḥ sva rūpeṇa susevate ye ye vidyā sadharmāṇaḥ subhagāḥ surata kalā kāma nidrā lajjā prema surata utkaṇṭhā ādayaḥ te virājamānāḥ bhavanti

original: adhitatsthānaṃ nikuñje madhye sugandhaśītalā maṇayo grīṣmādiṣu ṛtuṣu sevyarūpāḥ kvacit sugandhapārijātāḥ
analyzed: adhi tad sthānam nikuñje madhye sugandha śītalāḥ maṇayaḥ grīṣma ādiṣu ṛtuṣu sevya rūpāḥ kvacid sugandha pārijātāḥ

original: kecidvṛkṣāścampakāḥ sadāpuṣpitāḥ sadā sukomalaiḥ patraivirājante sugandhāḥ | kecidvṛkṣāḥ pakvaphalasugandharasayuktā virājamānā āsate | kecillatāprakīrṇāḥ atitarāṃ sugandhayutāḥ | āmodagandhalubdhā bhramarā mudā gāyanti | kāścidgopyastatra majjantya āsate | kāścidgopyastasyāṃ vastrālaṃkaraṇairbhūṣayāṃcakruḥ |
analyzed: kecid vṛkṣāḥ campakāḥ sadā puṣpitāḥ sadā su komalaiḥ patraiḥ virājante sugandhāḥ kecid vṛkṣāḥ pakva phala sugandha rasa yuktāḥ virājamānāḥ āsate kecid latā prakīrṇāḥ atitarām sugandha yutāḥ āmoda gandha lubdhāḥ bhramarāḥ mudā gāyanti kāścid gopyaḥ tatra majjantyaḥ āsate kāścid gopyaḥ tasyām vastra alaṃkaraṇaiḥ bhūṣayāṃcakruḥ

original: kāścidgopyaḥ premāsaktā rādhārasikānandābhyāṃ bhojanaṃ cakruḥ | kāścidgopyo dolāṃ tābhyāṃ saha dolayitvā gāyamānā āsan | mudā kāścidgopyastaccitraśālāyāṃ svāni svāni rūpāṇi paśyanti hṛṣyanti rātrau divānavaratam | gopyo bhāvāśritāstadbālalīlāṃ gāyamānā bhajanaṃ cakruḥ | atyāsaktāḥ premabhajanarūpā ānandaṃ vindante |
analyzed: kāścid gopyaḥ prema āsaktāḥ rādhā rasika ānandābhyām bhojanam cakruḥ kāścid gopyaḥ dolām tābhyām saha dolayitvā gāyamānāḥ āsan mudā kāścid gopyaḥ tad citraśālāyām svāni svāni rūpāṇi paśyanti hṛṣyanti rātrau divā anavaratam gopyaḥ bhāva āśritāḥ tad bāla līlām gāyamānāḥ bhajanam cakruḥ ati āsaktāḥ prema bhajana rūpāḥ ānandam vindante

original: tato gopāstathā rasikānande magnā atyantapremabhajanaṃ kurvate | ye premabhajane nimagnāste tāṃ līlāmāpadyanta | nityalīlābhajanānando'yaṃ raso'nirvacanīyaḥ | nandayaśodāvṛṣabhānusatyādayo ye bhaktāste bhajanānandaṃ nityamanubhavantyatitarām | bhūyo bhūyaḥ sukhasauṣṭhavamabhavat | evaṃ gopā gopyastanmayatāṃ prāpnuvanti |
analyzed: tatas gopāḥ tathā rasika ānande magnāḥ atyanta prema bhajanam kurvate ye prema bhajane nimagnāḥ te tām līlām āpadyanta nitya līlā bhajana ānandaḥ yam rasaḥ nirvacanīyaḥ nanda yaśodā vṛṣa bhānu satya ādayaḥ ye bhaktāḥ te bhajana ānandam nityam anubhavanti atitarām bhūyas bhūyas sukha sauṣṭhavam abhavat evam gopāḥ gopyaḥ tad maya tām prāpnuvanti

original: tāsāṃ mātṛbhāvaṃ prapannā gopyo bhajanānande bhajanameva kurvāṇā āsan | tāsāṃ gṛhā diṣṭyānādisukhasamṛddhisaṃpattayo bhavantyānandasukhasamṛddhisiddhayaḥ | nānābhajanayogyānyupakaraṇāni tadarthe saṃpāditāni bhavanti | gopagopikādīnāṃ samṛddhisukhaṃ tasya bhajanārthameva bhavati | atitarāṃ sukhārthameva yogyatāpadyate |
analyzed: tāsām mātṛ bhāvam prapannāḥ gopyaḥ bhajana ānande bhajanam eva kurvāṇāḥ āsan tāsām gṛhāḥ diṣṭyā anādi sukha samṛddhi saṃpattayaḥ bhavanti ānanda sukha samṛddhi siddhayaḥ nānā bhajana yogyāni upakaraṇāni tad arthe saṃpāditāni bhavanti gopa gopikā ādīnām samṛddhi sukham tasya bhajana artham eva bhavati atitarām sukha artham eva yogyatā āpadyate

original: anantasukhasaṃpattitayā nikuñjadevyāḥ svāveśena sukhakoṭyānandaṃ prāpnuvanti | abhiyanti ca sukhasaṃyogyatām | pṛthivyāṃ bhārate kṣetre ānandamayo lokaḥ svasṛṣṭilīlārthaṃ svayameva prakaṭitaḥ | tasmin vrajaloke sarvā eva līlāḥ santi | ye gopā gopyaste ādhidaivikīṃ līlāmatitarāṃ saṃsiddhā anubhavanti | sā lakṣmīruvācedam |
analyzed: ananta sukha saṃpatti tayā nikuñja devyāḥ sva āveśena sukha koṭi ānandam prāpnuvanti abhiyanti ca sukha saṃyogya tām pṛthivyām bhārate kṣetre ānanda mayaḥ lokaḥ sva sṛṣṭi līlā artham svayam eva prakaṭitaḥ tasmin vraja loke sarvāḥ eva līlāḥ santi ye gopāḥ gopyaḥ te ādhidaivikīm līlām atitarām saṃsiddhāḥ anubhavanti sā lakṣmīḥ uvāca idam

original: rahasya iha vrajamaṇḍale yāni pṛthaksthānāni tāni brūhi | ekaviṃśatiyojanā bhūmirānandamayyevāsti |
analyzed: rahasye iha vraja maṇḍale yāni pṛthak sthānāni tāni brūhi ekaviṃśati yojanā bhūmiḥ ānanda mayī eva asti

original: yamunāyā dakṣiṇakūlato mahāsthānaṃ pañcayojanāyataṃ vihārasthānamatitarāṃ sūkṣmaṃ nityavihārarahasyakelikalāvirbhāvabhāvitam | tasmin sthāne ye vṛkṣāḥ gṛhāṇi nikuñjā anyāni vihārasthānāni tānyādhidaivikānyāsan | yo vaṃśīvaṭo'yaṃ sākṣācchivo'yam | yo bhaṇḍīravaṭaḥ sa eva devendra āsīt | tatra sthitā ye pakṣiṇaste sādhanasiddhā āsan |
analyzed: yamunāyāḥ dakṣiṇa kūlataḥ mahā sthānam pañca yojana āyatam vihāra sthānam atitarām sūkṣmam nitya vihāra rahasya keli kalā āvirbhāva bhāvitam tasmin sthāne ye vṛkṣāḥ gṛhāṇi nikuñjāḥ anyāni vihāra sthānāni tāni ādhidaivikāni āsan yaḥ vaṃśīvaṭaḥ yam sākṣāt śivaḥ yam yaḥ bhaṇḍīravaṭaḥ saḥ eva deva indraḥ āsīt tatra sthitāḥ ye pakṣiṇaḥ te sādhana siddhāḥ āsan

original: te nirantaraṃ tābhyāmāsan | ye tatra manuṣyā ādhidaivikarūpā evāsan te vṛndāvaneśvarīsamanugṛhītāssadā tāṃ līlāṃ darśayanti tadanugrahataḥ | yāsāmajñātvā jñātvā vā yasmin kasmin bhāve bhāvo bhavettā bhāvena tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti | yatra kutrāpi sthito'pi tadvṛndāvanodbhavā mṛttikāṃ bhakṣayet | sa eva tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnoti |
analyzed: te nirantaram tābhyām āsan ye tatra manuṣyāḥ ādhidaivika rūpāḥ eva āsan te vṛndāvana īśvarī samanugṛhītāḥ sadā tām līlām darśayanti tad anugrahataḥ yāsām a jñātvā jñātvā vā yasmin kasmin bhāve bhāvaḥ bhavet tāḥ bhāvena tām līlām prāpnuvanti yatra kutra api sthitaḥ upi tad vṛndāvana udbhavā mṛttikām bhakṣayet saḥ eva tām līlām prāpnoti

original: tatsthānodbhavānāṃ vṛkṣāṇāṃ puṣpamālāṃ ye kaṇṭhe dhārayanti te sarvakṛtyaṃ vidhūya tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti | sadā tāṃ līlāṃ gāyamānāstāṃ līlāṃ prāptā eva santi | yai pratikṣaṇaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ smaryate te kṛtārthatāṃ prāpnuvantyatitarām | asyāmādhidaivikīṃ līlāṃ prāptāstāṃ līlāṃ gāyanti dhyāyanti |
analyzed: tad sthāna udbhavānām vṛkṣāṇām puṣpa mālām ye kaṇṭhe dhārayanti te sarva kṛtyam vidhūya tām līlām prāpnuvanti sadā tām līlām gāyamānāḥ tām līlām prāptāḥ eva santi yai pratikṣaṇam vṛndāvanam smaryate te kṛtārtha tām prāpnuvanti atitarām asyām ādhidaivikīm līlām prāptāḥ tām līlām gāyanti dhyāyanti

original: snehāsaktā ye tasmin sthale nivasanti te pūrvaṃ tatsṛṣṭyutpannā eva santi nānyatra | tasmin vṛndāvane govardhano'yaṃ parvataḥ pañcayojanāyataḥ | trīṇi yojanā nyacchidritasaptaśṛṅgāṇi nirastadhātumayāni | yatra nirantaraṃ śrīrādhārasikaḥ puruṣottamaḥ saṃkrīḍate | yasya gahvarāṇi sukomalāni sugandhajuṣṭāni virājamānāni bhavanti |
analyzed: sneha āsaktāḥ ye tasmin sthale nivasanti te pūrvam tad sṛṣṭi utpannāḥ eva santi na anyatra tasmin vṛndāvane parvataḥ pañca yojana āyataḥ trīṇi yojanā ni acchidrita sapta śṛṅgāṇi nirasta dhātu mayāni yatra nirantaram śrī rādhā rasikaḥ puruṣottamaḥ saṃkrīḍate yasya gahvarāṇi su komalāni sugandha juṣṭāni virājamānāni bhavanti

original: yasmin govardhane svayameva śrīrādhārasikaśiromaṇiḥ krīḍāṃ karoti | atitarāmānandamayo'yaṃ parvato yasmin parvate rudro rudrāṇyā saha pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyādau tapa ātanot | yena tapasā śivaḥ śivo'bhūt tatra rudraśivapuṣkariṇyāṃ ye majjanaṃ kurvanti te tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti | ye taṃ parvatamupasevamānā bhaveyusteṣāmanenaiva śarīreṇa līlāyogyatāsti |
analyzed: yasmin govardhane svayam eva śrī rādhā rasika śiromaṇiḥ krīḍām karoti atitarām ānanda mayaḥ yam parvataḥ yasmin parvate rudraḥ rudrāṇyā saha pūrvam sṛṣṭi ādau tapaḥ ātanot yena tapasā śivaḥ śivaḥ bhūt tatra rudra śiva puṣkariṇyām ye majjanam kurvanti te tām līlām prāpnuvanti ye tam parvatam upasevamānāḥ bhaveyuḥ teṣām anena eva śarīreṇa līlā yogya tā asti

original: anenaiva govardhanādrau kāmadughā yā tapa ātanot seyaṃ govindapuṣkariṇī |
analyzed: anena eva govardhana adrau kāmadughā yā tapaḥ ātanot sā iyam govindapuṣkariṇī

original: ye premamagnāstasyāṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ majjanti sevante te tāṃ kāle kāle tasyā darśanayogyatāmatipremānandaprāptimanubhavanti | yatra mānasasarovaraṃ vidhāya mayāpi tapa ātanyata | tattallokecchayā apsarasā urvaśyā tasmin govardhanādrau tapa ātanyata |
analyzed: ye prema magnāḥ tasyām puṣkariṇyām majjanti sevante te tām kāle kāle tasyāḥ darśana yogya tām ati prema ānanda prāptim anubhavanti yatra mānasa sarovaram vidhāya mayā api tapaḥ ātanyata tat tat loka icchayā apsarasā urvaśyā tasmin govardhana adrau tapaḥ ātanyata

original: sānubhavo'yaṃ loko yatra yatra paritaḥ śilāḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇanāmāñcitāstatra tā śilāḥ śrīvṛndāvaneśvaryadhivasati | ānandamayena saha ye bhaktāstasya parikramaṃ kurvanti te tallīlādarśanayogyatāṃ prāpnuvanti | indraparājayamahotsave ahamapi brahmādinā saha tasmin sthāne darśanārthaṃ gamiṣyāmi | atitarāṃ śrīrādhārasikasya krīḍāsthānaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: sa anubhavaḥ yam lokaḥ yatra yatra paritas śilāḥ śrī rādhā kṛṣṇa nāma añcitāḥ tatra tāḥ śilāḥ śrī vṛndāvana īśvarī adhivasati ānanda mayena saha ye bhaktāḥ tasya parikramam kurvanti te tad līlā darśana yogya tām prāpnuvanti indra parājaya mahā utsave aham api brahma ādinā saha tasmin sthāne darśana artham gamiṣyāmi atitarām śrī rādhā rasikasya krīḍā sthānam bhavati

original: sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | rahasyasthāne'smin parvate rudreṇa kasmin kāle tapaḥ ātanyata | tallīlāṃ vistaraśo brūhi | mama mano'tilolaṃ tasyāṃ kathāyām | sukhe kastṛptiṃ yāti | yena tapasā dhyānena tadbhāvo bhavedatitarām | aho ahaṃ taṃ lokaṃ śrotukāmā | vistareṇa brūhi |
analyzed: sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam rahasya sthāne asmin parvate rudreṇa kasmin kāle tapaḥ ātanyata tad līlām vistaraśaḥ brūhi mama manaḥ uti lolam tasyām kathāyām sukhe kaḥ tṛptim yāti yena tapasā dhyānena tad bhāvaḥ bhavet atitarām aho aham tam lokam śrotu kāmā vistareṇa brūhi

original: evaṃ prapannāṃ hṛdyādhāya svayameva nārāyaṇa abhivadatyatitarāmānandamayena cetasā | sa hovāca | śṛṇu lakṣmi asya lokasya hanta māhātmyam | ahaṃ vaktumaśaktaśca | yasya śrīrādhikā rasikānandasya vihārasthasya darśanālāpakathānubhava atitarāṃ sadyaḥ sarūpe ramaṇānande snehādhikyaṃ prāpayanti | tathaiva te dhanyāste kṛtārthāḥ |
analyzed: evam prapannām hṛdi ādhāya svayam eva nārāyaṇa abhivadati atitarām ānanda mayena cetasā sa ha uvāca śṛṇu lakṣmi asya lokasya hanta māhātmyam aham vaktum aśaktaḥ ca yasya śrī rādhikā rasika ānandasya vihāra sthasya darśana ālāpa kathā anubhava atitarām sadyas sarūpe ramaṇa ānande sneha ādhikyam prāpayanti tathā eva te dhanyāḥ te kṛtārthāḥ

original: te anyadharmarahitatvena premānande prītimāpadyante | atitarāmāsaktirbhavet | brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā anye jātyantarajāḥ śataśo jātyantarabhedāste prāpnuvanti | na varṇena na dharmeṇa yeṣāṃ līlāratirāste te tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti | anyabhāveneśvarāviṣṭacittā anyadeva prāpnuvanti | tadbhāve na kadācittameva prāpnuvanti |
analyzed: te anya dharma rahita tvena prema ānande prītim āpadyante atitarām āsaktiḥ bhavet brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyaḥ vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ vā anye jāti antara jāḥ śataśas jāti antara bhedāḥ te prāpnuvanti na varṇena na dharmeṇa yeṣām līlā ratiḥ āste te tām līlām prāpnuvanti anya bhāvena īśvara āviṣṭa cittāḥ anyat eva prāpnuvanti tad bhāve na kadācid tam eva prāpnuvanti

original: yeṣāṃ tallīlānubhavo na syāta teṣāmanekaśa sādhanāni vṛthā syuḥ | brahmavidyāsevino jñānina ātmavedanena tāṃ līlāṃ na prāpnuvanti | tasmāttallīlādarśanayogyā bhaktāḥ svabhāvena tasyāḥ śrīrādhi

original: kāyā anugrahātsvātmabhāvā bhavanti | śiṣṭānuśiṣṭasveṣṭadhyānakathāsevānubhāvena teṣāmanubhavakathāyāmāsaktiḥ syāt | sā saṃyokṣyamāṇā ratirindriyārthe | ratisaṅgo bhāvāpanno bhavati | ye ratikalanayānugṛhyante te tāṃ līlāṃ prāptavanto bhavanti | sarvaṃ tyaktvā tallīlāyā anubhavino bhavanti |
analyzed: kāyāḥ anugrahāt sva ātma bhāvāḥ bhavanti śiṣṭa anuśiṣṭa sva iṣṭa dhyāna kathā sevā anubhāvena teṣām anubhava kathāyām āsaktiḥ syāt sā saṃyokṣyamāṇā ratiḥ indriyārthe rati saṅgaḥ bhāva āpannaḥ bhavati ye rati kalanayā anugṛhyante te tām līlām prāptavantaḥ bhavanti sarvam tyaktvā tad līlāyāḥ anubhavinaḥ bhavanti

original: anubhavasaṃbhavastadā bhavet yadā sādhavaḥ kṛpāṃ kurvanti ratirbhavati ca | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | tvayoktaṃ yaiṣā vrajavāsinī sṛṣṭiradbhutaṃ sthānaṃ prāptaiveti yasmin sthāne govardhano'yaṃ rājamāna āste | tasmin govardhane rudreṇa tapo rudrāṇyā sahākriyata | puṣkariṇīṃ vidhāya tapa ātanot |
analyzed: anubhava saṃbhavaḥ tadā bhavet yadā sādhavaḥ kṛpām kurvanti ratiḥ bhavati ca sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam tvayā uktam yā eṣā vraja vāsinī sṛṣṭiḥ adbhutam sthānam prāptā eva iti yasmin sthāne govardhanaḥ uyam rājamānaḥ āste tasmin govardhane rudreṇa tapaḥ rudrāṇyā saha akriyata puṣkariṇīm vidhāya tapaḥ ātanot

original: yathāyaṃ loko rudreṇa tapatā dṛṣṭaḥ stutaḥ kathito hṛdi dhyāta evāyaṃ lokaḥ sarveṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ saṃdṛśyate | suśobhano'yaṃ lokaḥ sarveṣāṃ lokamahālīlāyā āveśena teṣāṃ bhaktānāmanugrahaṃ prapadyamānā bhavet |
analyzed: yathā ayam lokaḥ rudreṇa tapatā dṛṣṭaḥ stutaḥ kathitaḥ hṛdi dhyātaḥ eva ayam lokaḥ sarveṣām bhaktānām saṃdṛśyate su śobhanā uyam lokaḥ sarveṣām loka mahā līlāyāḥ āveśena teṣām bhaktānām anugraham prapadyamānā bhavet

original: kathaṃ rudreṇa darśanaṃ prāptam? kena sādhanena śivaḥ siddho'bhavat? sa evaṃ govardhanādrau kiyatkālaṃ kiṃrūpaṃ tapo'tapyata? dṛṣṭavibhavo'yam | vistaraśo brūhi yadi kṛpābhāvo bhavet | sa hovāca | pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭyādāvekasmin samaye śivaḥ śivayā vaikuṇṭhe tallīlādarśanārthaṃ gatavān | tatra nānāsattvamayāni saṃkrīḍamānānyanekaśo rudreṇa dṛṣṭāni |
analyzed: katham rudreṇa darśanam prāptam kena sādhanena śivaḥ siddhaḥ bhavat saḥ evam govardhana adrau kiyatkālam kiṃrūpam tapaḥ atapyata dṛṣṭa vibhavaḥ yam vistaraśaḥ brūhi yadi kṛpā bhāvaḥ bhavet sa ha uvāca pūrvam sṛṣṭi ādau ekasmin samaye śivaḥ śivayā vaikuṇṭhe tad līlā darśana artham gatavān tatra nānā sattva mayāni saṃkrīḍamānāni anekaśas rudreṇa dṛṣṭāni

original: sarvā mayā krīḍitāḥ krīḍā dṛṣṭvā anubhūya atṛptendriyo'bhavat | mamāgre sthito rudro mama dhyānāvasthāṃ dṛṣṭvā atyāścaryavān aho sākṣānnārāyaṇo'yaṃ paraṃ brahma | rudrādayo yaṃ dhyāyanti | rudrādayo yāṃ vaikuṇṭhāśritāṃ līlāmabhilaṣanti | ādityādayo yaṃ dyotayanti | yasya kalāvatārān pṛthivyāṃ devā ṛṣayaḥ stuvanti |
analyzed: sarvāḥ mayā krīḍitāḥ krīḍāḥ dṛṣṭvā anubhūya atṛpta indriyaḥ bhavat mama agre sthitaḥ rudraḥ mama dhyāna avasthām dṛṣṭvā ati āścaryavān aho sākṣāt nārāyaṇaḥ yam param brahma rudra ādayaḥ yam dhyāyanti rudra ādayaḥ yām vaikuṇṭha āśritām līlām abhilaṣanti āditya ādayaḥ yam dyotayanti yasya kalā avatārān pṛthivyām devāḥ ṛṣayaḥ stuvanti

original: yaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ dhyāyantī tena ramā sadā krīḍate | yaṃ gatvā caturdhā muktayo dvāre tiṣṭhanti | taddhāma sarveṣāṃ devādīnāmapi durlabhataram | sa eva nārāyaṇaḥ kasya bhajanaṃ kurute | atyāścaryaṃ gato rudro baddhāñjaliḥ san nārāyaṇaṃ stauti | sa hovāca rudraḥ | namo'nantāya mahate vaikuṇṭhāya śrīmate
analyzed: yam nārāyaṇam dhyāyantī tena ramā sadā krīḍate yam gatvā caturdhā muktayaḥ dvāre tiṣṭhanti tat dhāma sarveṣām deva ādīnām api durlabhataram saḥ eva nārāyaṇaḥ kasya bhajanam kurute ati āścaryam gataḥ rudraḥ baddhāñjaliḥ san nārāyaṇam stauti sa ha uvāca rudraḥ namaḥ nantāya mahate vaikuṇṭhāya śrīmate

original: tejomayāya tubhyaṃ nityaṃ namo namaḥ | tavāṃśakalā yā nṛsiṃhādyāḥ rāmādyā anekaśo līlāmayāstā dhyāyamāno'haṃ śivatāṃ prāptaḥ | ahamadhunātyāścaryaṃ gatavānasmi | ahaṃ nirantaraṃ tava dhyānena vicarāmi pṛthivyām | tvaṃ kaṃ dhyāyasi? sarvaṃ varṇaya tava kṛpā yadi syāt |
analyzed: tejaḥ mayāya tubhyam nityam namaḥ namaḥ tava aṃśa kalāḥ yāḥ nṛsiṃha ādyāḥ rāma ādyāḥ anekaśas līlā mayāḥ tāḥ dhyāyamānaḥ aham śiva tām prāptaḥ aham adhunā ati āścaryam gatavān asmi aham nirantaram tava dhyānena vicarāmi pṛthivyām tvam kam dhyāyasi sarvam varṇaya tava kṛpā yadi syāt
