original: iti śivena saṃprārthito'haṃ tallokasthitiṃ kathayiṣyanśṛṇu tāta ahaṃ nityaṃ tallokaṃ dhyāyāmi | yatra nikuñjeśvaryā krīḍate rasikānando vanavihāre | yadrahasi krīḍāsthānam | yatra ānandamayakāmakelikautukaratirāsavinodakuñjāśca śataśo virājante | yatra govardhano'yaṃ giriḥ rājamāno bhavati |
analyzed: iti śivena saṃprārthitaḥ aham tad loka sthitim kathayiṣyan śṛṇu tāta aham nityam tad lokam dhyāyāmi yatra nikuñja īśvaryā krīḍate rasika ānandaḥ vana vihāre yat rahasi krīḍā sthānam yatra ānanda maya kāma keli kautuka rati rāsa vinoda kuñjāḥ ca śataśas virājante yatra govardhanaḥ yam giriḥ rājamānaḥ bhavati

original: yatra kadambakuñjaśreṇayo gahvarāṇi ratnāni dhātumayāni | yatra puṣkariṇyo'mṛtodaiḥ pūrṇā virājante | yatra maṇigaṇākarā jyotsnātitejorūpasaṃvalitaparasparavastupratibimbitā āsate | tasya lokasya daivataṃ śrīrādhikayā sahānandarasikaṃ puruṣaṃ dhyāyema | yasya kaṭākṣāt samutpannā lokānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāmutpattisthitilayān kurvanti |
analyzed: yatra kadamba kuñja śreṇayaḥ gahvarāṇi ratnāni dhātu mayāni yatra puṣkariṇyaḥ umṛta udaiḥ pūrṇāḥ virājante yatra maṇi gaṇa ākarāḥ jyotsnā ati tejaḥ rūpa saṃvalita paraspara vastu pratibimbitāḥ āsate tasya lokasya daivatam śrī rādhikayā saha ānanda rasikam puruṣam dhyāyema yasya kaṭākṣāt samutpannāḥ lokānām brahmāṇḍānām utpatti sthiti layān kurvanti

original: anekaśo vidyā avidyā devā. ścāsurāścānekaśaḥ sṛṣṭisthitilayān labhante | yatra brahmāṇḍāni koṭiśo virājamānāni rājante | tadatitarāṃ suśobhāyamānaṃ brahmeti purāvido vadanti | yatra gatvā dhāmni layaṃ yānti yogīndrāḥ | śṛṇu yadi te tasya lokasya draṣṭumicchā vartate tarhi tvaṃ vraja | vrajamaṇḍale govardhano girirāste |
analyzed: anekaśas vidyāḥ avidyāḥ devāḥ ca asurāḥ ca anekaśas sṛṣṭi sthiti layān labhante yatra brahmāṇḍāni koṭiśas virājamānāni rājante tat atitarām su śobhāyamānam brahma iti purāvidaḥ vadanti yatra gatvā dhāmni layam yānti yogi indrāḥ śṛṇu yadi te tasya lokasya draṣṭum icchā vartate tarhi tvam vraja vraja maṇḍale govardhanaḥ giriḥ āste

original: ratnadhātumayo'yaṃ parvataḥ | yatra rasikānando vṛndāvaneśvaryā saha krīḍamāno'bhavat | paritaḥ krīḍopayuktāni vanāni dvādaśa śobhāyamānāni sugandhalatauṣadhibhiḥ saṃlagnāni rājante | yamunāmṛtodakaiḥ krīḍāvihārasthalāni saṃrājante | yatra yamunā baddhobhayataṭīvirājamānā bhavati |
analyzed: ratna dhātu mayaḥ yam parvataḥ yatra rasika ānandaḥ vṛndāvana īśvaryā saha krīḍamānaḥ bhavat paritas krīḍā upayuktāni vanāni dvādaśa śobhāyamānāni sugandha latā oṣadhibhiḥ saṃlagnāni rājante yamunā amṛta udakaiḥ krīḍā vihāra sthalāni saṃrājante yatra yamunā baddha ubhaya taṭī virājamānā bhavati

original: atitarāṃ padmarāgapuṣparāgacandrakāntasūryakāntamaṇīnāṃ tejobhirvirājamānāni jalāni śobhante | yatra yamunāyā upari śataśo vānīrakuñjā virājante |
analyzed: atitarām padmarāga puṣparāga candrakānta sūryakānta maṇīnām tejobhiḥ virājamānāni jalāni śobhante yatra yamunāyāḥ upari śataśas vānīra kuñjāḥ virājante

original: jātiyūthikāmallikāsuvarṇayūthikāprakarasugandhasaṃvalite'smin parāgadhṛtonmadāḥ bhramarapikaśukasārasahaṃsaśreṇayaḥ śobhāyamānāḥ kalakaṇṭhairnikuñjadevyā yaśo'titarāṃ gāyamānā bhavanti | yatra vṛndāvanalīlāyā nikuñjadevyāḥ ramaṇalīlāsthānam | yasya smaraṇādeva rasāviṣṭacitto bhavet |
analyzed: jāti yūthikā mallikā suvarṇa yūthikā prakara sugandha saṃvalite smin parāga dhṛta unmadāḥ bhramara pika śuka sārasa haṃsa śreṇayaḥ śobhāyamānāḥ kalakaṇṭhaiḥ nikuñja devyāḥ yaśaḥ utitarām gāyamānāḥ bhavanti yatra vṛndāvana līlāyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ ramaṇa līlā sthānam yasya smaraṇāt eva rasa āviṣṭa cittaḥ bhavet

original: vṛndāvanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ iti pratikṣaṇaṃ ye vadanti te dehopādhiṃ tyaktvā tasya līlāratimanubhavanti | tanmamāpi nirantaraṃ brahmādīnāmapyadṛṣṭagocaram | sahasrayojanāt ye vṛndāvanaṃ saṃsmaranti vṛndāvanamiti pratikṣaṇaṃ vadanti te tallīlopayogyā eva bhavanti | yatra kutrāpi mṛto vṛndāvanopāsakastatsthalaṃ tīrtharūpaṃ bhavet |
analyzed: vṛndāvanam vṛndāvanam iti pratikṣaṇam ye vadanti te deha upādhim tyaktvā tasya līlā ratim anubhavanti tat mama api nirantaram brahma ādīnām api adṛṣṭa gocaram sahasra yojanāt ye vṛndāvanam saṃsmaranti vṛndāvanam iti pratikṣaṇam vadanti te tad līlā upayogyāḥ eva bhavanti yatra kutra api mṛtaḥ vṛndāvana upāsakaḥ tat sthalam tīrtha rūpam bhavet

original: ye vṛndāvanodbhavāstulasīkāṣṭhāṅkitamālāḥ kaṇṭhe dhārayanti te kṛtārthatāṃ prāpnuvanti | tasyāṃ latāḥ sarasā āsate | atitarāṃ prītiḥ bhavati | ye vṛndāvane vṛkṣāste ādhibhautikāḥ siddhāḥ | sādhanasiddhā itastato bhramantīrlatā oṣadhikrīḍāsthalāni kurvanti | tayā devyā vṛndāvaneśvaryā trayaḥ koṭayaḥ pulindagaṇā utpāditāḥ |
analyzed: ye vṛndāvana udbhavāḥ tulasī kāṣṭha aṅkita mālāḥ kaṇṭhe dhārayanti te kṛtārtha tām prāpnuvanti tasyām latāḥ sarasāḥ āsate atitarām prītiḥ bhavati ye vṛndāvane vṛkṣāḥ te ādhibhautikāḥ siddhāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ itas tatas bhramantīḥ latāḥ oṣadhi krīḍā sthalāni kurvanti tayā devyā vṛndāvana īśvaryā trayaḥ koṭayaḥ pulinda gaṇāḥ utpāditāḥ

original: teṣāṃ vṛndāvanavāsināṃ dehocchiṣṭāni malamūtrādīni dehodbhavāni kaphalālāmūtrāṇi te pulindagaṇā ūṣare utkṣipanti | teṣāṃ bhaktānāṃ divyadeha ādhidaivikaṃ evāste | atitarāṃ saubhāgyāḍhyo bhavati |
analyzed: teṣām vṛndāvana vāsinām deha ucchiṣṭāni mala mūtra ādīni deha udbhavāni kapha lālā mūtrāṇi te pulinda gaṇāḥ ūṣare utkṣipanti teṣām bhaktānām divya dehaḥ ādhidaivikam eva āste atitarām saubhāgya āḍhyaḥ bhavati

original: aho śiva vṛndāvanamāhātmyaṃ kena varṇyate? sevakā yatra kutrāpi yatkiñcit bhogārthe kurvanti tadbhogo rasikānandena saha nikuñjadevyā sarvaḥ saṃbhokṣyate | atitarāṃ sukhasaṃbhogasthānaṃ tat sthānaṃ mamāpi dhyeyaṃ bhavati | ahaṃ nirantaraṃ dhyānāpanno bhavāmi | tasmin vṛndāvane madhyasthānaṃ nirantaraṃ mama dhyeyam |
analyzed: aho śiva vṛndāvana māhātmyam kena varṇyate sevakāḥ yatra kutra api yat kiñcid bhoga arthe kurvanti tad bhogaḥ rasikānandena saha nikuñja devyā sarvaḥ saṃbhokṣyate atitarām sukha saṃbhoga sthānam tat sthānam mama api dhyeyam bhavati aham nirantaram dhyāna āpannaḥ bhavāmi tasmin vṛndāvane madhya sthānam nirantaram mama dhyeyam

original: tasya sthānasya dhyānenāhamānandasthānamānandāveśena bhavāmi | ānandadhyānādahaṃ tat pratipadye | aho śiva tvamapyānandasthānamatitarāṃ pratiyojya tadabhyehi | dhyānāpanno bhava | ratirasabhāvabhedadhyānāpanno bhava | tadvṛndāvaneśvarīrūpamaṅgapratyaṅgaṃ rasikānandena saha yo dhyāyati
analyzed: tasya sthānasya dhyānena aham ānanda sthānam ānanda āveśena bhavāmi ānanda dhyānāt aham tat pratipadye aho śiva tvam api ānanda sthānam atitarām pratiyojya tat abhyehi dhyāna āpannaḥ bhava rati rasa bhāva bheda dhyāna āpannaḥ bhava tat vṛndāvana īśvarī rūpam aṅga pratyaṅgam rasika ānandena saha yaḥ dhyāyati

original: sa eva krīḍāyāṃ manobhāvāpanno bhavati | punaḥ śiva uvāca | tvayoktāni dvādaśavanāni | teṣu vaneṣu pṛthak pṛthak vada sarvam | sa hovāca | śṛṇu śiva varṇanaṃ vanānāṃ yāni śrutvā vrajalīlāyāmatyantasukhinaḥ saṃbhavanti | mahāvane nandasyādhiṣṭhānam | gokule gavāmadhiṣṭhānam | yamunāyāṃ krīḍādhiṣṭhānam | vṛndāvane svāminyā līlādhiṣṭhānam |
analyzed: saḥ eva krīḍāyām manobhāva āpannaḥ bhavati punar śivaḥ uvāca tvayā uktāni dvādaśa vanāni teṣu vaneṣu pṛthak pṛthak vada sarvam sa ha uvāca śṛṇu śiva varṇanam vanānām yāni śrutvā vraja līlāyām atyanta sukhinaḥ saṃbhavanti mahā vane nandasya adhiṣṭhānam gokule gavām adhiṣṭhānam yamunāyām krīḍā adhiṣṭhānam vṛndāvane svāminyāḥ līlā adhiṣṭhānam

original: kāmavane mahālīlāsaṅketasyādhiṣṭhānam | bṛhadvane vṛṣabhānupura nandapurādhiṣṭhānam | lohavane pulindasyādhiṣṭhānam | tālavane upanandādyadhiṣṭhānam | dadhigrāme dadhyadhiṣṭhānam | govardhanādripṛṣṭhe dadhivikrayādhiṣṭhānam | govardhanādryadho dānaśreṇidānalīlādhiṣṭhānam | ayaṃ govardhanādriḥ ramaṇalīlādhiṣṭhānaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kāmavane mahā līlā saṅketasya adhiṣṭhānam bṛhadvane nandapura adhiṣṭhānam lohavane pulindasya adhiṣṭhānam tālavane upananda ādi adhiṣṭhānam dadhigrāme dadhi adhiṣṭhānam govardhana adri pṛṣṭhe dadhi vikraya adhiṣṭhānam govardhana adri adhas dāna śreṇi dāna līlā adhiṣṭhānam ayam govardhana adriḥ ramaṇa līlā adhiṣṭhānam bhavati

original: ariṣṭe gogaṇe kubjavaṭe vṛndāvane tathā | govardhanagirau ramye sṛṣṭiḥ sarvātmanā bhavet || bhoḥ śiva asmin sthāne śrīrādhārasikānandāveva rūpeṇa sadā ramaṇaṃ kuruto līlāsametau | atyadbhutā saṃsiddhā līlā sadā govardhanādrau | ānandamaye sthāne tapa ācara |
analyzed: ariṣṭe go gaṇe kubja vaṭe vṛndāvane tathā govardhana girau ramye sṛṣṭiḥ sarva ātmanā bhavet bhoḥ śiva asmin sthāne śrī rādhā rasika ānandau eva rūpeṇa sadā ramaṇam kurutaḥ līlā sametau atyadbhutā saṃsiddhā līlā sadā govardhana adrau ānanda maye sthāne tapaḥ ācara

original: ekasmādgṛhādantaḥsugandhatailāgururasakarpūramṛgamadakesararasāḥ śataśaḥ puṣpalatāpatratvakpayobhiḥ sugandhiteṣu raseṣu saṃpūritā bhavanti | majjanakriyopayogyāḥ sakhīnāṃ samūhāḥ majjanaṃ kārayanti | nānājalakelisukhasaṃpattirmajjanāvatī tanmajjane'titarāṃ saratirāste | jalasaṃpattyai atitarāṃ sujalakallolā sakhī upasevate |

original: tatra majjanavatī taraṅgiṇī jalakallolā preṅkhitavatī sevyamānā agādhajalā naukāvatī suplavanavatī jalābhijñā sulaharī hastapallavā etāścānyāḥ sakhyaḥ śrīrādhikayā saha jalakrīḍāṃ kurvanti | tatra jalakrīḍāvyājena rasikānando nānāsukhaṃ karoti | tatra jalakrīḍānte śṛṅgāravatī sakhī śṛṅgārasthānaṃ nayati | tatra puṣpavatī puṣpamaṇḍanaṃ racayati |

original: tāsu śreṇiṣu anekaśaḥ sakhyaḥ saṃśobhamānā bhavanti | prathamaśreṇyāṃ lalitāviśākhādayaḥ sakhyaḥ nānāvidhānyupakaraṇāni kurvanti | dvitīyaśreṇyāṃ premavatyādayaḥ sakhyaḥ rājamānā bhavanti | tṛtīyaśreṇyāṃ śṛṅgāravatyādayaḥ sakhyo nānālaṃkārasukharūpā anekaśaḥ śṛṅgāraṃ kurvanti |

original: ṣaḍguṇāḥ ṣaḍṛtavaḥ upasevamānā bhavanti | etasmin maṇḍale pūrvataḥ sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāya sūryaḥ sukomalaiḥ kiraṇairupasevamāna āste | tasya maṇḍalasyottarataścandraḥ upasevamāno bhavati | etasmin maṇḍale paścimato'gnirādhidaivikena rūpeṇa upasevamāno bhavati | grahāstāstārakā anyāni nakṣatrāṇyādhidaivikaṃ rūpaṃ vidhāya sadā upasevamānā bhavanti |

original: indro'pi sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāya devāṅganābhiḥ saha vimānāvalīṣūpaviśya sadopasevamāno bhavati | pitāmaho'pi sūkṣmarūpaṃ vidhāyāntarikṣe tallokadarśanākāṅkṣo bhavati nirantaram | anye dikpālāḥ saṃsiddhā nirantaramādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tanmaṇḍalamupasevamānāstanmaṇḍalalokānandamagnā bhavanti | tanmaṇḍalopāsakā bhaktā anyaṃ na bhajeran |
analyzed: indraḥ api sakhī rūpam vidhāya deva aṅganābhiḥ saha vimāna āvalīṣu upaviśya sadā upasevamānaḥ bhavati pitāmahaḥ upi sūkṣma rūpam vidhāya antarikṣe tad loka darśana ākāṅkṣaḥ bhavati nirantaram anye dikpālāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ nirantaram ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tat maṇḍalam upasevamānāḥ tad maṇḍala loka ānanda magnāḥ bhavanti tad maṇḍala upāsakāḥ bhaktāḥ anyam na bhajeran

original: anyadharmāsaktā idaṃ maṇḍalaṃ na jānanti | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam| ye maṇḍamupāsate te kiṃ karma kurvanto bhavanti? sa hovāca | te'nanyopāsakāḥ bhavanti | ananyabhajanasiddhā ātmabhāvā bhavanti | ātmabhāvā maṇḍalamupāsate | ātmānātmabhāvo bhavet | atitarāmātmānande magnā anyarasaṃ na bhāvayanti | ātmānande magnā abhaktānna spṛśanti | ātmānande
analyzed: anya dharma āsaktāḥ idam maṇḍalam na jānanti sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam ye maṇḍam upāsate te kim karma kurvantaḥ bhavanti sa ha uvāca tena anya upāsakāḥ bhavanti ananya bhajana siddhāḥ ātma bhāvāḥ bhavanti ātma bhāvāḥ maṇḍalam upāsate ātmā an ātma bhāvaḥ bhavet atitarām ātma ānande magnāḥ anya rasam na bhāvayanti ātma ānande magnāḥ abhaktān na spṛśanti ātma ānande

original: magnā ātmabhāvā bhavanti | nānyaṃ śṛṇvanti na namanti na gāyanti | te bhaktā ātmarasabhāvitā ātmano ratirasabhāvanayānandaṃ śṛṇvantyānandaṃ gāyanti | ānandayutā bhaktā atirasamagnā guṇān gṛṇanti | atirasamagnāstaducchiṣṭamupabhuñjate | anucchiṣṭaṃ kadācinna bhuñjate | tanmaṇḍalopāsakāḥ bhaktā abhaktān na spṛśanti |
analyzed: magnāḥ ātma bhāvāḥ bhavanti na anyam śṛṇvanti na namanti na gāyanti te bhaktāḥ ātma rasa bhāvitāḥ ātmanaḥ rati rasa bhāvanayā ānandam śṛṇvanti ānandam gāyanti ānanda yutāḥ bhaktāḥ ati rasa magnāḥ guṇān gṛṇanti ati rasa magnāḥ tat ucchiṣṭam upabhuñjate an ucchiṣṭam kadācid na bhuñjate tad maṇḍala upāsakāḥ bhaktāḥ abhaktān na spṛśanti

original: ye anyopāsakā bhaktā ānande'nāśritāḥ karmajaḍāḥ karmakāṇḍopāsakā eva te | agnyupāsakā ye brāhmaṇā brahmavarcasopāsakā eva te | teṣāṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ tanmaṇḍalopāsakaḥ pramādenāpi na kuryāt | ye anyadharmarahitā anyāsaktirahitāste tanmaṇḍalaṃ prāpnuvanti | anyadharmarahitā eva prāpnuvanti | anye ātmānaṃ na vidurātmanā | kiṃ bahunoktena dharmeṇa |
analyzed: ye anya upāsakāḥ bhaktāḥ ānandena āśritāḥ karma jaḍāḥ karmakāṇḍa upāsakāḥ eva te agni upāsakāḥ ye brāhmaṇāḥ brahmavarcasa upāsakāḥ eva te teṣām saṃbhāṣaṇam tad maṇḍala upāsakaḥ pramādena api na kuryāt ye anya dharma rahitāḥ anya āsakti rahitāḥ te tat maṇḍalam prāpnuvanti anya dharma rahitāḥ eva prāpnuvanti anye ātmānam na viduḥ ātmanā kim bahunā uktena dharmeṇa

original: ye brāhmaṇā anyavidyopāsakāḥ karmajaḍāḥ karmakāṇḍopāsakāḥ kālopāsakāḥ karmadharmadevapitrupāsakā eva bhavanti te | ye śaivāḥ śāktāḥ surāmāṃsaratāḥ kaulā jainā pātañjalā mīmāṃsakāḥ jaḍatāṃ prāptāścārvākā anyadharmadṛḍhāsaktā bhavanti | ye tāṃ vrajeśvarīṃ rasikānandena sahopāsate sadānandarasamanubhavanto bhavanti |
analyzed: ye brāhmaṇāḥ anya vidyā upāsakāḥ karma jaḍāḥ karmakāṇḍa upāsakāḥ kāla upāsakāḥ karma dharma deva pitṛ upāsakāḥ eva bhavanti te ye śaivāḥ śāktāḥ surā māṃsa ratāḥ kaulāḥ pātañjalāḥ mīmāṃsakāḥ jaḍa tām prāptāḥ cārvākāḥ anya dharma dṛḍha āsaktāḥ bhavanti ye tām vrajeśvarīm rasika ānandena saha upāsate sat ānanda rasam anubhavantaḥ bhavanti

original: ratikalākomalā guṇagaṇanāṃ kurvanti | tameva rasaṃ gāyanto bhavanti | atiratimāpadyamānā bhavanti | ye darbhaṃ haste gṛhṇanti te taṃ rasaṃ na prāpnuvanti | tilāñjaliṃ pitṝṇāṃ ye dadati te tanmaṇḍalaṃ na prāpnuvanti | devāścāsurāśca karmakāṇḍopāsakā eveti, devāḥ sadvidyopāsakā vaiṣṇavā eveti, guṇātītāste vṛndāvaneśvarīmupāsate |

original: aho nārāyaṇo'yaṃ sadā lakṣmīkānto'pi pratikalaṃ kasya dhyānāpanno bhavatitarām | paścāt yaṃ nārāyaṇo devyā saha dhyāyati sma | yasyāvatārakalāḥ kovidā sarve dhyātvā upajīvanti | yadyevaṃvidhā nārāyaṇaḥ sarvasukhasaṃpattipūrṇānandaḥ kasya dhyānamāpanna āsedivāniti | tathaivetyasyā manobhilāṣaṃ jñātvāhamuvācedam |
analyzed: aho nārāyaṇaḥ iyam sadā lakṣmī kāntaḥ api pratikalam kasya dhyāna āpannaḥ bhavatitarām paścāt yam nārāyaṇaḥ devyā saha dhyāyati sma yasya avatāra kalāḥ kovidā sarve dhyātvā upajīvanti yadi evaṃvidhā nārāyaṇaḥ sarva sukha saṃpatti pūrṇa ānandaḥ kasya dhyānam āpannaḥ āsedivān iti tathā eva iti asyāḥ manaḥ abhilāṣam jñātvā aham uvāca idam

original: aho kāmadughe tava manasi kimāgatamiti | sovācedam | namo'nantāya mahate kṛṣṇāyākuṇṭhamedhase | yogeśāya ca yogāya brahmaṇe'nantaśaktaye || tvayānugṛhītā bhaktā ātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ matvā ātmabhāvā bhavanti | gavāṃ yūthāni śataśo virājamānānyamṛtarasasaṃjñitā gāvo bhavanti | tasminnavasare vaneṣu tṛṇasaṃvalitā nikuñjā atirasapūrṇā jalāśayāḥ śataśaḥ
analyzed: aho kāmadughe tava manasi kim āgatam iti sā uvāca idam namaḥ anantāya mahate kṛṣṇāya akuṇṭha medhase yogeśāya ca yogāya brahmaṇe nanta śaktaye tvayā anugṛhītāḥ bhaktāḥ ātmānam tanmayam matvā ātma bhāvāḥ bhavanti gavām yūthāni śataśas virājamānāni amṛta rasa saṃjñitāḥ gāvaḥ bhavanti tasmin avasare vaneṣu tṛṇa saṃvalitāḥ nikuñjāḥ ati rasa pūrṇāḥ jalāśayāḥ śataśas

original: śobhamānā āsate | tasmin sthāne saṃbhāṣamāṇān tṛṇajalauṣadhayaḥ saṃbhāṣamāṇā bhavanti | atipuṣṭā gāvo goṣṭhyā āseduṣyaḥ sukhasaṃbhojyadugdharasaghṛtarasadadhirasanavanītarasādyān bhāvāpannā dāśuṣyo bhavanti | śubhraśvetakarburitā gāvo rasasaṃvalitā goṣṭhānyanekaśo rājamānānyabhiyanti | tā gopyo dadhimanthanaghoṣeṇa saha saṃgāyamānā bhavanti |
analyzed: śobhamānāḥ āsate tasmin sthāne saṃbhāṣamāṇān tṛṇa jala oṣadhayaḥ saṃbhāṣamāṇāḥ bhavanti atipuṣṭāḥ gāvaḥ goṣṭhyāḥ āseduṣyaḥ sukha saṃbhojya dugdha rasa ghṛta rasa dadhi rasa navanīta rasa ādyān bhāva āpannāḥ dāśuṣyaḥ bhavanti śubhra śveta karburitāḥ gāvaḥ rasa saṃvalitāḥ goṣṭhāni anekaśas rājamānāni abhiyanti tāḥ gopyaḥ dadhi manthana ghoṣeṇa saha saṃgāyamānāḥ bhavanti

original: tāsāṃ śṛṅgārasukhamāpadyamāno'bhavat | golokādāgatā kāmadughā nārāyaṇamukhācchrutamātre govardhanādrau śirasi mantraṃ japtvā tadbhāvenābhavat | sā vrajeśvarī rasikānandena pratyakṣabhāvamātene | sā prasannā satī tāṃ līlāṃ dattavatīti | nārāyaṇaḥ pratyuttaramuvāca |
analyzed: tāsām śṛṅgāra sukham āpadyamānaḥ bhavat golokāt āgatā kāmadughā nārāyaṇa mukhāt śruta mātre govardhana adrau śirasi mantram japtvā tad bhāvena abhavat sā vrajeśvarī rasika ānandena pratyakṣa bhāvam ātene sā prasannā satī tām līlām dattavatī iti nārāyaṇaḥ pratyuttaram uvāca

original: aho priye asya lokasya kathā śrūyamāṇā sarveṣāṃ niviśamānā hṛdi gataṃ kāmakrodhādikaṃ nāśayati | atiratibhaktirāpadyate rasikānandaratirāpadyate | varṇāśramasvadharmā bādhakā na bhavanti | kāmadughā govardhanādriśirasi govindapuṣkariṇyāṃ tapaścakāra | mahāmantramamuṃ jajāpa | śṛṇu tanmantradhyānam | oṃ namaḥ śrīrādhārasikānandābhyām |
analyzed: aho priye asya lokasya kathā śrūyamāṇā sarveṣām niviśamānā hṛdi gatam kāma krodha ādikam nāśayati ati rati bhaktiḥ āpadyate rasika ānanda ratiḥ āpadyate varṇa āśrama svadharmāḥ bādhakāḥ na bhavanti kāmadughā govardhana adri śirasi govinda puṣkariṇyām tapaḥ cakāra mahā mantram amum jajāpa śṛṇu tat mantra dhyānam om namaḥ śrī rādhā rasika ānandābhyām

original: mūlamantro'yam | dvādaśākṣarasaṃvalitamoṅkārabījasaṃvalitaṃ yo dhyāyet sa eva tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnoti | ata eva kṛtaṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ govindakuṇḍamiti nāmnā prasiddhaṃ kuñjam | pṛthivyāṃ tasminnadrau sā vanaphalatṛṇauṣadhīrbhakṣayāmāsa | sā kāmadughā tapaḥ ācarantī tasminnadrau paricakrāma | evaṃ śataṃ samāstapa ācaritavatī |
analyzed: mūlamantra ūyam dvādaśa akṣara saṃvalitam oṅkāra bīja saṃvalitam yaḥ dhyāyet saḥ eva tām līlām prāpnoti atas eva kṛtam puṣkariṇyām govindakuṇḍam iti nāmnā prasiddham kuñjam pṛthivyām tasmin adrau sā vana phala tṛṇa oṣadhīḥ bhakṣayāmāsa sā kāmadughā tapaḥ ācarantī tasmin adrau paricakrāma evam śatam samāḥ tapaḥ ācaritavatī

original: yatra govardhanādrau ratnadhātumayalatauṣadhaya sadā praphullitā phalitā rasasaṃvalitā atiśobhāyamānā bhavanti | yatra gahvarāṇi ratnahāṭakamayānyanekaśa śobhāya mānāni krīḍāsthānāni bhavanti | anekaraṅgavicitrā oṣadhayo nānāraṅgaiḥ racitā eva yatra phalapuṣpairbhāsitā bhavanti | yatra sā vrajeśvarī rasikānandena saha saṅkrīḍāmatitarāmātanoti |
analyzed: yatra govardhana adrau sadā praphullitā phalitāḥ rasa saṃvalitāḥ atiśobhāyamānāḥ bhavanti yatra gahvarāṇi ratna hāṭaka mayāni anekaśas śobhāya mānāni krīḍā sthānāni bhavanti aneka raṅga vicitrāḥ oṣadhayaḥ nānā raṅgaiḥ racitāḥ eva yatra phala puṣpaiḥ bhāsitāḥ bhavanti yatra sā vrajeśvarī rasika ānandena saha saṅkrīḍām atitarām ātanoti

original: yatra sakhīnāṃ vṛndāni vihāraparāṇi | tatra tasyāṃ puṣkariṇyāṃ sā vrajeśvarī svasvarūpaṃ darśayāmāsa | rasikānandarūpaṃ
analyzed: yatra sakhīnām vṛndāni vihāra parāṇi tatra tasyām puṣkariṇyām sā vrajeśvarī sva svarūpam darśayāmāsa rasika ānanda rūpam

original: rasarūpameva sākṣādevaṃvidhamatiguṇasaṃvalitamevāste | nūtano navajāyayā saha krīḍanaṃ darśayāmāsa | sā kāmadughā stotraṃ cakāra | namo rasātmane | namo jñānātmane | namaḥ sadāvanavihāriṇe | namaḥ svabhaktakarmasvabhāvaduḥkhanāśahetave | namaḥ prākaṭyadeharūpiṇe | namo yamunājalakallolavihārātmane | nama kāmakelikautukātmane | namaḥ kāmapriyāya |
analyzed: rasa rūpam eva sākṣāt evaṃvidha mati guṇa saṃvalitam eva āste nūtanaḥ nava jāyayā saha krīḍanam darśayāmāsa sā kāmadughā stotram cakāra namaḥ rasa ātmane namaḥ jñāna ātmane namaḥ sadā vana vihāriṇe namaḥ sva bhakta karma svabhāva duḥkha nāśa hetave namaḥ prākaṭya deha rūpiṇe namaḥ yamunā jala kallola vihāra ātmane nama kāma keli kautuka ātmane namaḥ kāmapriyāya

original: namaḥ kāmātmane | namaḥ kāmasaṃvalitadehadātre | nama ādikartre | nama ādiheturatidātre | namaḥ śrīrādhādhyānāpannadehātmane | namo rasātmane | namo rasalaṃpaṭaparipūrṇadehadātṛrūpiṇe | namo'nirvacanavihāriṇe | namo ratidātre | namo ratikelikalākautukātmane | namo bhaktiratidātre | namo jñānanirvāṇadātre | nama ānandasvarūpiṇe | namastaddraṣṭre |
analyzed: namaḥ kāma ātmane namaḥ kāma saṃvalita deha dātre namaḥ ādikartre namaḥ ādi hetu ratidātre namaḥ śrī rādhā dhyāna āpanna deha ātmane namaḥ rasa ātmane namaḥ rasa laṃpaṭa paripūrṇa deha dātṛ rūpiṇe namaḥ nirvacana vihāriṇe namaḥ rati dātre namaḥ rati keli kalā kautuka ātmane namaḥ bhakti rati dātre namaḥ jñāna nirvāṇa dātre namaḥ ānanda svarūpiṇe namaḥ tad draṣṭre

original: namastasya hetave | namaḥ kalarāsajñānavihārātmane | namo'guṇāya | namaḥ sṛṣṭirūpaguṇadāyine | namo guṇakelisuratānandasukhabhoktre | namo bhogadāyine | namo bhogātmane | nama ātmarūpiṇe | nama suratānandarūparasadātre | namo'nantacaritradāyine | namaḥ kramalīlātmane | namaḥ śrīrādhākṛṣṇarūpiṇe | namaḥ śrīkṛṣṇarādhārūpiṇe |
analyzed: namaḥ tasya hetave namaḥ kala rāsa jñāna vihāra ātmane namas guṇāya namaḥ sṛṣṭi rūpa guṇa dāyine namaḥ guṇa keli surata ānanda sukha bhoktre namaḥ bhoga dāyine namaḥ bhoga ātmane namaḥ ātma rūpiṇe nama surata ānanda rūpa rasa dātre namaḥ ananta caritra dāyine namaḥ krama līlā ātmane namaḥ śrī rādhā kṛṣṇa rūpiṇe namaḥ śrī kṛṣṇa rādhā rūpiṇe

original: namo'nekavihāradehadhāriṇe | namaḥ śatasahasrakoṭiśo lakṣakoṭivihārarūpiṇe | namo lalitāpratikṣaṇasukhadātre | namaḥ kuñjāntaraviśākhādyanekasakhīvihārātmane | nama ādyanādirūpasaṃsiddhabhaktirūpiṇe | namo dānadharmadātre | namaḥ sukharūpiṇe | namo vrajāvirbhāvabhāvitāya | namo'tyantadānarūpiṇe | namaḥ sadā vṛndāvanaśreṇivihāriṇe |
analyzed: namaḥ aneka vihāra deha dhāriṇe namaḥ śata sahasra koṭiśas lakṣa koṭi vihāra rūpiṇe namaḥ lalitā pratikṣaṇa sukha dātre namaḥ kuñja antara viśākha ādi aneka sakhī vihāra ātmane namaḥ ādi anādi rūpa saṃsiddha bhakti rūpiṇe namaḥ dāna dharma dātre namaḥ sukha rūpiṇe namaḥ vraja āvirbhāva bhāvitāya namaḥ utyanta dāna rūpiṇe namaḥ sadā vṛndāvana śreṇi vihāriṇe

original: nama ādidvādaśavanavihārātmane | namaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yāni rūpāṇi sundarāṇyanekaśastattava vijānīyāt | iti lakṣmīlajjādhṛtikāntyanekākārāya guṇaratidāyine namo namaḥ iti stutvā sthitāṃ kāmadughāṃ taddarśanamahotsavākulāṃ rasikānandastayā nikuñjadevyā sahovācedam | aho kā tvaṃ stutiṃ bruvāṇāsi | mama bhaktiriha loke durlabhā |
analyzed: namaḥ ādi dvādaśa vanavihāra ātmane namaḥ pṛthivyām yāni rūpāṇi sundarāṇi anekaśas tat tava vijānīyāt iti lakṣmī lajjā dhṛti kānti aneka ākārāya guṇa rati dāyine namaḥ namaḥ iti stutvā sthitām kāmadughām tad darśana mahā utsava ākulām rasika ānandaḥ tayā nikuñja devyā saha uvāca idam aho kā tvam stutim bruvāṇā asi mama bhaktiḥ iha loke durlabhā

original: durlabhataraṃ varaṃ varaya | tava manasi mama
analyzed: durlabhataram varam varaya tava manasi mama

original: darśanādadhikaṃ na kiñcidavaśiṣyate | tava stavena yo nityaṃ stauti samāhitaḥ sadābhīṣṭaṃ prāpnoti | punaruvācedaṃ kāmadughā yadi deyo varo nātha tava loke vasāmyaham | gorasadadhirasadugdharasanavanītarasaghṛtarasaphāṇṭarasairahaṃ seve | rasikānanda uvāca | anekaśa svāvirbhāvena loke mama vallabhā tvaṃ sadā vasa | ahaṃ tvāṃ rakṣiṣyāmi |
analyzed: darśanāt adhikam na kiñcid avaśiṣyate tava stavena yaḥ nityam stauti samāhitaḥ sadā abhīṣṭam prāpnoti punar uvāca idam kāmadughā yadi deyaḥ varaḥ nātha tava loke vasāmi aham gorasa dadhi rasa dugdha rasa navanīta rasa ghṛta rasa phāṇṭa rasaiḥ aham seve rasika ānandaḥ uvāca anekaśas sva āvirbhāvena loke mama vallabhā tvam sadā vasa aham tvām rakṣiṣyāmi

original: vanavihāre yathecchaṃ vihara | ye ananyāśrayā mama bhaktāsteṣāṃ na varṇāśramadharmā āntarālikā jāyante | teṣāṃ na karmāṇi āntarālikāni jāyante | teṣāṃ sādhanamāntarālikaṃ na jāyate | vratāni yajñāśchandāṃsi yogakṣemaphalāni cānanyāni dharmasādhanāni yatkiñcidapi kṛtyaṃ sarvamāntarālikaṃ na jāyate |
analyzed: vana vihāre yatheccham vihara ye ananya āśrayāḥ mama bhaktāḥ teṣām na varṇa āśrama dharmāḥ āntarālikāḥ jāyante teṣām na karmāṇi āntarālikāni jāyante teṣām sādhanam āntarālikam na jāyate vratāni yajñāḥ chandāṃsi yogakṣema phalāni ca ananyāni dharma sādhanāni yat kiñcid api kṛtyam sarvam āntarālikam na jāyate

original: ye brāhmaṇāḥ karmajñānasādhakāsteṣāṃ jyotiṣāgamakarmasādhakāsteṣāṃ ca saṅgo haṭhāt tyājya eveti vacanamasti | daśayojanaṃ vrajapariṇāhaḥ | tatra paśupakṣiṇo mṛgā gāvo'nye ye vṛkṣāḥ ananyaparā āsate | atirasamagnā gāyanti | tasminmaṇḍale devāḥ darśanakāṅkṣā eva bhavanti |
analyzed: ye brāhmaṇāḥ karma jñāna sādhakāḥ teṣām jyotiṣā āgama karma sādhakāḥ teṣām ca saṅgaḥ haṭhāt tyājyaḥ eva iti vacanam asti daśa yojanam vraja pariṇāhaḥ tatra paśu pakṣiṇaḥ mṛgāḥ gāvaḥ anye ye vṛkṣāḥ ananya parāḥ āsate ati rasa magnāḥ gāyanti tasmin maṇḍale devāḥ darśana kāṅkṣāḥ eva bhavanti

original: bhaktakriyāmāpadyamānā bhaktāstanmaṇḍalaṃ vanavihārasthānaṃ ye vrajavāsamicchanti te eva sarvadharmātiriktā bhavanti | karmātiriktā bhavanti | saṅgātiriktā bhavanti | vrajamaṇḍalopāsakāḥ bhavanti | aho lakṣmi sā sṛṣṭistu sṛṣṭyatiriktaivāste | tatsṛṣṭerutpadyamāno rasamārgamāśrito bhavati |
analyzed: bhakta kriyām āpadyamānāḥ bhaktāḥ tat maṇḍalam vana vihāra sthānam ye vraja vāsam icchanti te eva sarva dharma atiriktāḥ bhavanti karma atiriktāḥ bhavanti saṅga atiriktāḥ bhavanti vraja maṇḍala upāsakāḥ bhavanti aho lakṣmi sā sṛṣṭiḥ tu sṛṣṭi atiriktā eva āste tad sṛṣṭeḥ utpadyamānaḥ rasa mārgam āśritaḥ bhavati

original: manaḥ sotsāhaṃ yadyetasminmaṇḍale tadaṅgīkāraṃ prāpto'manomoho'titarāṃ pratisaṃyokṣyamāṇastaṃ rasamanubhavan bhāvāpanna āste | yadā yadā devāśca pitaraśca kālaśca vrajātisādhane yatante tāvatsahasraśākhādhyāyī bhavati | sarvayajñakarmakaro'pi tanmaṇḍalaṃ svapne'pi na jānāti |
analyzed: manaḥ sa utsāham yadi etasmin maṇḍale tad aṅgīkāram prāptaḥ manaḥ moha utitarām pratisaṃyokṣyamāṇaḥ tam rasam anubhavan bhāva āpannaḥ āste yadā yadā devāḥ ca pitaraḥ ca kālaḥ ca vraja ati sādhane yatante tāvat sahasra śākhā adhyāyī bhavati sarva yajña karma karaḥ api tat maṇḍalam svapne api na jānāti

original: jñānino ya brahmabodhakā yoginastapasvinaste svapne'pi tanmaṇḍalaṃ na jānanti | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | kaiścihnaistān bhaktān jānīmahe | sa hovāca | te sadā premamārgiṇo bhavantyeva | na nirviṇṇā nātisaktā gṛhādau viṣayādau
analyzed: jñāninaḥ brahma bodhakāḥ yoginaḥ tapasvinaḥ te svapne pi tat maṇḍalam na jānanti sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam kaiḥ cihnaiḥ tān bhaktān jānīmahe sa ha uvāca te sadā prema mārgiṇaḥ bhavanti eva na nirviṇṇāḥ na ati saktāḥ gṛha ādau viṣaya ādau

original: nātisaktā yadṛcchayā prāptavastumātramupasevamānā eva bhavanti | na nirvedo nāśramo na karma yadṛcchākathāsevā bhaktānāṃ prītirananyā bhaktirbhavati | evaṃvidhasaṃsārātiriktaḥ svabhāvasaṃsiddho bhavati | tatastāṃ līlāṃ prāptavanto bhavanti | evamupāsakāstasminmaṇḍale gatvātitarāṃ saṃyokṣyamāṇāḥ āpadyante | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam |
analyzed: na ati saktāḥ yadṛcchayā prāpta vastu mātram upasevamānāḥ eva bhavanti na nirvedaḥ na āśramaḥ na karma yadṛcchā kathā sevāḥ bhaktānām prītiḥ ananyā bhaktiḥ bhavati evaṃvidha saṃsāra atiriktaḥ svabhāva saṃsiddhaḥ bhavati tatas tām līlām prāptavantaḥ bhavanti evam upāsakāḥ tasmin maṇḍale gatvā atitarām saṃyokṣyamāṇāḥ āpadyante sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam

original: rasamārgīyā bhaktāstanmaṇḍalaṃ prāptavantaḥ | teṣāmekā daśā | teṣāṃ kā gatiḥ? sa hovāca | tanmaṇḍalodbhavāḥ bhaktā ātmaratiguṇā ratiguṇāḍhyā ananyamārgāḍhyāstāṃ līlāṃ prāptavantastannāmāṅkitavarṣmāṇastulasīkāṣṭhāṅkitadehā ātmanāmnā sukhālaṅkṛtaśarīrā rāsādilīlādhyānāvasthāyāmāpadyamānā yujyante |
analyzed: rasamārgīyāḥ bhaktāḥ tat maṇḍalam prāptavantaḥ teṣām ekā daśā teṣām kā gatiḥ sa ha uvāca tad maṇḍala udbhavāḥ bhaktāḥ ātma rati guṇāḥ rati guṇa āḍhyāḥ ananya mārga āḍhyāḥ tām līlām prāptavantaḥ tad nāma aṅkita varṣmāṇaḥ tulasī kāṣṭha aṅkita dehāḥ ātma nāmnā sukha alaṅkṛta śarīrāḥ rāsa ādi līlā dhyāna avasthāyām āpadyamānāḥ yujyante

original: kuñje nikuñje śreṇyāṃ śreṇyāṃ ratiyogyatābhāvamāpadyamānā bhavanti | tāmeva kathāṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ nūtanāmāsevamānā āsate | śvapaco vā brāhmaṇo vā varṇāntaro vā yo bhaktānāṃ saha saṅgamāpadyate sa eva tāṃ līlāṃ prāpto bhavati | ratimāsedivān yadi taducchiṣṭe kadācidannabuddhisteṣāmasti | taducchiṣṭe jale sadā tīrthabuddhiḥ bhavati |
analyzed: kuñje nikuñje śreṇyām śreṇyām rati yogyatā bhāvam āpadyamānāḥ bhavanti tām eva kathām pratikṣaṇam nūtanām āsevamānāḥ āsate śvapacaḥ vā brāhmaṇaḥ vā varṇa antaraḥ vā yaḥ bhaktānām saha saṅgam āpadyate saḥ eva tām līlām prāptaḥ bhavati ratim āsedivān yadi tad ucchiṣṭe kadācid anna buddhiḥ teṣām asti tad ucchiṣṭe jale sadā tīrtha buddhiḥ bhavati

original: tatra tatkathāyāṃ sākṣādbuddhirbhavati | ye maṇḍalamupāsamānāsteṣāṃ ko dharmaḥ? kiṃ karma? ko raso bhavatitarām? ye tanmaṇḍalamupāsamānā bhavanti teṣāṃ kiṃ tīrthavratayajñadharmāḥ santi? kiṃ bādhyamānaṃ bhavet? teṣāṃ mukhyaṃ mano bhavati | ye guṇāḍhyā rasarūpiṇa ānandarasanimagnāste guṇatadbhāgino bhavanti |
analyzed: tatra tad kathāyām sākṣāt buddhiḥ bhavati ye maṇḍalam upāsamānāḥ teṣām kaḥ dharmaḥ kim karma kaḥ rasaḥ bhavatitarām ye tat maṇḍalam upāsamānāḥ bhavanti teṣām kim tīrtha vrata yajña dharmāḥ santi kim bādhyamānam bhavet teṣām mukhyam manaḥ bhavati ye guṇa āḍhyāḥ rasa rūpiṇaḥ ānanda rasa nimagnāḥ te guṇa tad bhāginaḥ bhavanti

original: tanmātraprāptamārgo'yaṃ lokaḥ sadāṇḍajo bhavet | ātmānande magnāsu ye rātrau divā vrajadhyānāpannā bhavanti sadā teṣāṃ nityaṃ nikuñjadevyā anugraho bhavati | ye mahālīlāyāmatyāsaktāsteṣāṃ kadācitkāladharmabhayaṃ na bhavatyeveti sadyaḥ kṛtārthatotpadyamānā bhavati | avarṇo'pi savarṇatāṃ prāpnoti | ye na bhavanti te duṣṭagatayo bhavanti |
analyzed: tad mātra prāpta mārgaḥ yam lokaḥ sadā aṇḍajaḥ bhavet ātma ānande magnāsu ye rātrau divā vraja dhyāna āpannāḥ bhavanti sadā teṣām nityam nikuñja devyāḥ anugrahaḥ bhavati ye mahā līlāyām atyāsaktāḥ teṣām kadācid kāladharma bhayam na bhavati eva iti sadyas kṛtārtha tā utpadyamānā bhavati avarṇaḥ upi savarṇa tām prāpnoti ye na bhavanti te duṣṭa gatayaḥ bhavanti

original: ye vrajamaṇḍalopāsakāste vraje nivasanti | ye rāsamaṇḍalopāsakāste rāsalīlāṃ
analyzed: ye vraja maṇḍala upāsakāḥ te vraje nivasanti ye rāsa maṇḍala upāsakāḥ te rāsa līlām

original: prāpnuvanti | anantasukhaṃ saṃbhuñjate | yā yaśodādyā līlāmupāsamānā bhajane prapadyamānā bhajanānande saṃyokṣyamāṇā bhavanti | ye nandādayo'tyantasakhībhāvamupāsamānā atyantasaṅgaṃ prāptāste ramaṇānandasakhīsamūhaṃ prāptāḥ | te tāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti ye nikuñjadevīṃ dhyāyanti ramaṇānandamupāsate |
analyzed: prāpnuvanti ananta sukham saṃbhuñjate yāḥ yaśodā ādyāḥ līlām upāsamānāḥ bhajane prapadyamānāḥ bhajana ānande saṃyokṣyamāṇāḥ bhavanti ye nanda ādayaḥ utyanta sakhī bhāvam upāsamānāḥ atyanta saṅgam prāptāḥ te ramaṇānanda sakhī samūham prāptāḥ te tām līlām prāpnuvanti ye nikuñja devīm dhyāyanti ramaṇānandam upāsate

original: atyantaṃ suratānandaṃ prāptā ye saṃyokṣyamāṇā vrajamaṇḍalaṃ madhyasthānaṃ bhajanti te mahālīlāṃ prāpya saṃbhogasukhaṃ saṃprāpnuvanti | sa āha lakṣmīm | śrutaparakāṣṭhā ye sakhībhāvaṃ prāptavantaste gopāstāṃ līlāṃ saṃprāpnuvanti |
analyzed: atyantam surata ānandam prāptāḥ ye saṃyokṣyamāṇāḥ vraja maṇḍalam madhya sthānam bhajanti te mahā līlām prāpya saṃbhoga sukham saṃprāpnuvanti saḥ āha lakṣmīm śruta para kāṣṭhāḥ ye sakhī bhāvam prāptavantaḥ te gopāḥ tām līlām saṃprāpnuvanti

original: yaḥ sarvadharmānparityajya tanmaṇḍalopāsako bhavati sa eva tāṃ līlāṃ prāpya sarvavratātirikto jñānātirikto vidhūtavidhiniṣedhakṛtyākṛtyaguṇāguṇamāvābhāvaḥ sadā saṅkṛṣyamāṇo līlāyāṃ pratipadyamānaḥ saṃyujyate'titarāṃ rase | aho lakṣmi ṣaḍvidheyaṃ rāsamāyā kathitā | sarvāṃ līlāṃ parityajya tatsthānaṃ prāptavanto bhavanti | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam |
analyzed: yaḥ sarva dharmān parityajya tad maṇḍala upāsakaḥ bhavati saḥ eva tām līlām prāpya sarva vrata atiriktaḥ jñāna atiriktaḥ vidhūta vidhi niṣedha kṛtya akṛtya guṇa aguṇa māva abhāvaḥ sadā saṅkṛṣyamāṇaḥ līlāyām pratipadyamānaḥ saṃyujyate ititarām rase aho lakṣmi ṣaṣ vidhā iyam rāsa māyā kathitā sarvām līlām parityajya tat sthānam prāptavantaḥ bhavanti sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam

original: kīdṛgvidhaṃ rāsasthānam? nirantaraṃ tatsthānasyopāsakā yadupāsanāmātrāttāṃ līlāṃ prāpnuvanti tadvarṇaya | sa hovāca nārāyaṇo'yam | ekaṃ sahasrādityasaṅkāśamatihlādamayam | ahaṃ brahmā rudro devā dikpālā yasmātsamutpadyamānāḥ yasya pratāpāttasmin sthāne saṃsiddhā sādhanasiddhā anekaśo bhaktāḥ | yatra maṇaya ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tejāṃsi dadati |
analyzed: kīdṛgvidham rāsa sthānam nirantaram tad sthānasya upāsakāḥ yat upāsanā mātrāt tām līlām prāpnuvanti tat varṇaya sa ha uvāca nārāyaṇaḥ yam ekam sahasra āditya saṅkāśam ati hlāda mayam aham brahmā rudraḥ devāḥ dikpālāḥ yasmāt samutpadyamānāḥ yasya pratāpāt tasmin sthāne saṃsiddhā sādhana siddhāḥ anekaśas bhaktāḥ yatra maṇayaḥ ādhidaivikena rūpeṇa tejāṃsi dadati

original: yatra saṃsiddhaḥ sūryaḥ sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāyopasevate | sūkṣmasūkṣmarūpaṃ vidhāya yatrātmanā candraḥ sevamāno bhavatitarām | yatrāgniḥ sakhīrūpaṃ vidhāyopasevamāna āste | devāstasmin sthāne sadā saṃsiddhā evopasevamānā āsate | pṛthivyāṃ sūryacandranakṣatrāṇi anye ye sādhanopakārakāste sarve upasevamānā evāsate |
analyzed: yatra saṃsiddhaḥ sūryaḥ sakhī rūpam vidhāya upasevate sūkṣma sūkṣma rūpam vidhāya yatra ātmanā candraḥ sevamānaḥ bhavatitarām yatra agniḥ sakhī rūpam vidhāya upasevamānaḥ āste devāḥ tasmin sthāne sadā saṃsiddhāḥ eva upasevamānāḥ āsate pṛthivyām sūrya candra nakṣatrāṇi anye ye sādhana upakārakāḥ te sarve upasevamānāḥ eva āsate

original: anyāstu yasmātsthānādimāḥ prajāḥ samutpadyamānā bhavanti tallokaṃ varṇayāmi | anekaśaḥ koṭibrahmāṇḍakānyatiśayāvirbhāvamāpadyamānāni santitarām |
analyzed: anyāḥ tu yasmāt sthānāt imāḥ prajāḥ samutpadyamānāḥ bhavanti tat lokam varṇayāmi anekaśas koṭi brahmāṇḍakāni atiśaya āvirbhāvam āpadyamānāni santitarām

original: tasmin sthāne madhye madhye āvaraṇajyotirāste | āvaraṇasya madhye sahasrayojanapariṇāhavati guṇagaṇanāya śrīrādhākṛṣṇasya guṇagaṇāḥ saṅgīyante | prathamapariṇāhe gavāṃ gaṇāḥ krīḍāparā eva bhavanti gopagopībhiḥ | etāni krīḍāsthānāni tṛṇajalauṣadhīlatāphalapuṣpapatrakomalānyāsate | madhughṛtadugdhadadhinavanītādyā rasāḥ saṃsiddhā bhavantitarām |
analyzed: tasmin sthāne madhye madhye āvaraṇa jyotiḥ āste āvaraṇasya madhye sahasra yojana pariṇāhavati guṇa gaṇanāya śrī rādhākṛṣṇasya guṇa gaṇāḥ saṅgīyante prathama pariṇāhe gavām gaṇāḥ krīḍā parāḥ eva bhavanti gopa gopībhiḥ etāni krīḍā sthānāni tṛṇa jala oṣadhī latā phala puṣpa patra komalāni āsate madhu ghṛta dugdha dadhi navanīta ādyāḥ rasāḥ saṃsiddhāḥ bhavantitarām

original: yatrānnāni khādyapeyacoṣya lehyavividhapakvarasānekasaṃvalitāni bhavanti | yatra vṛkṣā amṛtamadhudhārāḥ atitarāmāseduṣāṃ varṣanti | yatra puṣkariṇyo'mṛtapūrṇā bhavanti | tatrāmṛtaṃ pītvā jarāmaraṇagarbhotpattivināśā na bhavantitarām | amṛtodaṃ nāma saro devairupapīyamānaṃ bhavati | tayā nikuñjadevyā svadṛṣṭyamṛtena saṃpūryamāṇaṃ bhavati tarām |
analyzed: yatra annāni khādya peya coṣya lehya vividha pakva rasa aneka saṃvalitāni bhavanti yatra vṛkṣāḥ amṛta madhu dhārāḥ atitarām āseduṣām varṣanti yatra puṣkariṇyaḥ umṛta pūrṇāḥ bhavanti tatra amṛtam pītvā jarā maraṇa garbha utpatti vināśāḥ na bhavanti tarām amṛtodam nāma saraḥ devaiḥ upapīyamānam bhavati tayā nikuñja devyā sva dṛṣṭi amṛtena saṃpūryamāṇam bhavati tarām

original: tasmin sthāne gopagopīgaṇāḥ pulinanilīnāḥ sadā krīḍāparāḥ bhavanti | dvitīyapariṇāhe vāṭikāḥ krīḍāsthānāni vṛkṣāḥ pakvaphalapuṣpanamrāḥ patrairnamrā dhārā āsīdanti | krīḍāparāṇāṃ gopīnāṃ gaṇā nikuñjadevyāḥ śrīrādhāyāḥ svāveśena krīḍāparāḥ suratānandena saṃbhokṣyamāṇā bhavanti | yatra bhaktāstatkrīḍāparāstaddhyānaparāstadrūpā āsate |
analyzed: tasmin sthāne gopa gopī gaṇāḥ pulina nilīnāḥ sadā krīḍā parāḥ bhavanti dvitīya pariṇāhe vāṭikāḥ krīḍā sthānāni vṛkṣāḥ pakva phala puṣpa namrāḥ patraiḥ namrāḥ dhārāḥ āsīdanti krīḍā parāṇām gopīnām gaṇāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ śrī rādhāyāḥ sva āveśena krīḍā parāḥ surata ānandena saṃbhokṣyamāṇāḥ bhavanti yatra bhaktāḥ tad krīḍā parāḥ tad dhyāna parāḥ tad rūpāḥ āsate

original: tasmiṃsthāne ye bhaktāḥ sadā rasamārgiṇasteṣāṃ saṅga āste | aho bhaktimārgarasasaṃvalito'nubhavan tasya saṅgaṃ rasikānandasvarūpo bhavati | dharmaḥ sa eva karmāṇi sa eva vidyā sa eva bhavati | ye dharmāste adharmāḥ | ye karmāṇi tānyevākarmāṇi | tṛtīyamāvaraṇaṃ mahākrīḍāsthānam | tasmin sthāne ekasaptatyadhikakoṭayo nikuñjāḥ śobhāyamānā āsate |
analyzed: tasmin sthāne ye bhaktāḥ sadā rasa mārgiṇaḥ teṣām saṅgaḥ āste aho bhakti mārga rasa saṃvalitaḥ anubhavan tasya saṅgam rasika ānanda sva rūpaḥ bhavati dharmaḥ saḥ eva karmāṇi saḥ eva vidyā saḥ eva bhavati ye dharmāḥ te adharmāḥ ye karmāṇi tāni eva akarmāṇi tṛtīyam āvaraṇam mahā krīḍā sthānam tasmin sthāne ekasaptati adhika koṭayaḥ nikuñjāḥ śobhāyamānāḥ āsate

original: yasminnāvaraṇamadhye ramaṇasthalāni koṭiśo rājamānāni | yasmin sthāne maṇīnāṃ valayā sugandhayutāḥ rājamānā bhavanti | padmarāgamaṇilatāgrathitā nīlamaṇipuṣpasaṃvalitā bhavantitarāṃ madhye madhye | vidrumakṛtā hāṭakakoṭayo latāgrathitā hāṭakabhūmiṣu ramaṇasthānaṃ śobhāḍhyaṃ kurvantitarām | ramaṇānando'yaṃ sadā bhaktānāṃ
analyzed: yasmin āvaraṇa madhye ramaṇa sthalāni koṭiśas rājamānāni yasmin sthāne maṇīnām valayā sugandha yutāḥ rājamānāḥ bhavanti padmarāga maṇi latā grathitāḥ nīla maṇi puṣpa saṃvalitāḥ bhavantitarām madhye madhye vidruma kṛtāḥ hāṭaka koṭayaḥ latā grathitāḥ hāṭaka bhūmiṣu ramaṇa sthānam śobha āḍhyam kurvantitarām ramaṇa ānandaḥ yam sadā bhaktānām

original: sukhakaro bhavati | yasya lokasya kathāśravaṇamātrāt sarve varṇāḥ sarve dharmāḥ vidharmāṇaḥ pratibhāntitarām | yasminnāvaraṇe svāminyāḥ śrīrādhāyāḥ śrīrasikānandasya ca sadā krīḍāsthalaṃ bhavati | maṇilatānāṃ sañcāre haṃsīnāṃ yūthānyatyantasollāsāni pītagrīvāṇi raktacañcupuṭāni rājamānāni bhavanti |
analyzed: sukha karaḥ bhavati yasya lokasya kathā śravaṇa mātrāt sarve varṇāḥ sarve dharmāḥ vidharmāṇaḥ pratibhāntitarām yasmin āvaraṇe svāminyāḥ śrīrādhāyāḥ śrī rasikānandasya ca sadā krīḍā sthalam bhavati maṇi latānām sañcāre haṃsīnām yūthāni atyanta sa ullāsāni pīta grīvāṇi rakta cañcu puṭāni rājamānāni bhavanti

original: te susvareṇa saṃjñitā iva sāmagānaṃ kalakaṇṭhaiḥ kurvanto bhavanti | tasmin āvaraṇe latāyāṃ śukayūthānyatyantaharitāni raktacañcupuṭāni pītapucchapakṣāṇi | yaiḥ pratiśākhaṃ gāndharvavedo gīyamāno bhavati | yasminnāvaraṇe śrīrādhikāyāḥ svāṅgāt saṃbhāvitāḥ sakhyaḥ krīḍāparā bhavanti |
analyzed: te su svareṇa saṃjñitāḥ iva sāma gānam kalakaṇṭhaiḥ kurvantaḥ bhavanti tasmin āvaraṇe latāyām śuka yūthāni atyanta haritāni rakta cañcu puṭāni pīta puccha pakṣāṇi yaiḥ pratiśākham gāndharvavedaḥ gīyamānaḥ bhavati yasmin āvaraṇe śrī rādhikāyāḥ sva aṅgāt saṃbhāvitāḥ sakhyaḥ krīḍā parāḥ bhavanti

original: sotsāhā sotkaṇṭhā premaprekṣaṇā hāsyavatī kaṭākṣaguṇavatī susnehā malinā śayyopakaraṇā puṣpavatī niḥśaṅkā nirlajjā suratotkaṇṭhā suratānandā mālāvatī sukhaśramā kalāvatī kalākovidā guṇajñā śṛṅgārarasā kāmabhāvitā bhāvotsāhā nidrājāgaritā sarasasukhetyādinānāsakhyo ratiśṛṅgāramanubhavantyo bhavanti |
analyzed: sa utsāhā sa utkaṇṭhā prema prekṣaṇā hāsyavatī kaṭākṣa guṇavatī su snehā malinā śayyā upakaraṇā puṣpavatī niḥśaṅkā nirlajjā surata utkaṇṭhā surata ānandā mālāvatī sukha śramā kalāvatī kalā kovidā guṇa jñā śṛṅgāra rasā kāma bhāvitā bhāva utsāhā nidrā jāgaritā sarasa sukhā ityādi nānā sakhyaḥ rati śṛṅgāram anubhavantyaḥ bhavanti

original: nirantaraṃ tāḥ sakhya krīḍāparāḥ kuñjāntare rasikānandaṃ sevamānā bhavanti | latāntare bhakṣyabhojyāni tāmbūlādyā bhogāḥ kāmakelirasāntare sukhabhogarasakrīḍāḥ kṛtavatyo bhavanti | etāṃ līlāṃ saṃsiddhāḥ sakhīnāṃ gaṇāḥ pakṣiṇāṃ gaṇāḥ prāptavanto bhavanti | sādhanasiddhāstasminnāvaraṇe krīḍāparāḥ bhavanti | sā lakṣmīruvācedam |
analyzed: nirantaram tāḥ sakhya krīḍā parāḥ kuñja antare rasika ānandam sevamānāḥ bhavanti latā antare bhakṣya bhojyāni tāmbūla ādyāḥ bhogāḥ kāma keli rasa antare sukha bhoga rasa krīḍāḥ kṛtavatyaḥ bhavanti etām līlām saṃsiddhāḥ sakhīnām gaṇāḥ pakṣiṇām gaṇāḥ prāptavantaḥ bhavanti sādhana siddhāḥ tasmin āvaraṇe krīḍā parāḥ bhavanti sā lakṣmīḥ uvāca idam

original: kena sādhanenedaṃ sthānaṃ dṛṣṭigocaraṃ bhavati | sa hovāca | sṛṣṭau trayo yogā bhavanti | jñānayogaḥ karmayogo bhaktiyogaśceti | teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ yogānāṃ madhye premayogo'tirikto bhavatitarām | yeṣāmeva premasaṃpattisteṣāmeva suratānandasukhaṃ bhavati |
analyzed: kena sādhanena idam sthānam dṛṣṭi gocaram bhavati sa ha uvāca sṛṣṭau trayaḥ yogāḥ bhavanti jñāna yogaḥ karma yogaḥ bhakti yogaḥ ca iti teṣām trayāṇām yogānām madhye prema yoga utiriktaḥ bhavatitarām yeṣām eva prema saṃpattiḥ teṣām eva surata ānanda sukham bhavati

original: na dharmeṇa neṣṭāpūrtena na varṇena nāśrameṇa na tīrthena na vratena na dehaśoṣaṇayogena na vedoditena karmaṇā na dharmādharmavicārasādhanena tatsthānaṃ bhavati | yo manasi nirantaraṃ taddhyānāpanno bhavati tasya bhavati | yatra yatra sthitaṃ
analyzed: na dharmeṇa na iṣṭāpūrtena na varṇena na āśrameṇa na tīrthena na vratena na deha śoṣaṇa yogena na veda uditena karmaṇā na dharma adharma vicāra sādhanena tat sthānam bhavati yaḥ manasi nirantaram tad dhyāna āpannaḥ bhavati tasya bhavati yatra yatra sthitam

original: tatra tatra tameva dharmaṃ jānīmahe | tameva sukhaṃ jānīmahe | taddhāniḥ tadantarāyaḥ | tadeva sukhaṃ yat tadbhaktai saha saṃbhāṣaṇāttasyāvaraṇalīlāvārtāyāṃ kālaniryāpaṇam | gṛhotsave yeṣāmupārjitavastumātraṃ tadarthe vinihitaṃ bhavati te tallokaṃ prāpnuvanti | aho lakṣmi iyaṃ sṛṣṭistu rasarūpiṇī bhavati |
analyzed: tatra tatra tam eva dharmam jānīmahe tam eva sukham jānīmahe tad hāniḥ tad antarāyaḥ tat eva sukham yat tad bhaktaiḥ saha saṃbhāṣaṇāt tasya āvaraṇa līlā vārtāyām kāla niryāpaṇam gṛha utsave yeṣām upārjita vastu mātram tad arthe vinihitam bhavati te tat lokam prāpnuvanti aho lakṣmi iyam sṛṣṭiḥ tu rasa rūpiṇī bhavati

original: teṣāṃ rasamārgavyatiriktā dharmā bādhakā eva bhavantitarām | manaḥsaṅgrahamānīya manasā bhāvenendriyāṇi manasi dhṛtvā manasā bhāvena ahorātraṃ layamāpadyante | yasminnāvaraṇe mano nimagnatāṃ prāpnoti | tayā nikuñjadevyānugṛhīto rātrau divā kāle'kāle tanmārgīyastallokaṃ sevamāno bhavati |
analyzed: teṣām rasa mārga vyatiriktāḥ dharmāḥ bādhakāḥ eva bhavantitarām manaḥ saṅgraham ānīya manasā bhāvena indriyāṇi manasi dhṛtvā manasā bhāvena ahorātram layam āpadyante yasmin āvaraṇe manaḥ nimagna tām prāpnoti tayā nikuñja devyā anugṛhītaḥ rātrau divā kāle kāle tad mārgīyaḥ tad lokam sevamānaḥ bhavati

original: aho manaso vṛttiratitarāṃ cañcalāpi te bhaktāḥ saṃsārāsaktirahitāḥ loke'neṣaṇātmānastanmayā anapekṣāścitte saṃpūrṇāḥ praśāntāḥ samadarśino nirmamā nirahaṅkārā nirdvandvā niṣparigrahā bhavanti | teṣu nityaṃ mahābhāgāḥ anyamārgarahitā hi ye ātmānaṃ tanmayaṃ paśyantasta evātmānaṃ sevante |
analyzed: aho manasaḥ vṛttiḥ atitarām cañcalā api te bhaktāḥ saṃsāra āsakti rahitāḥ lokena iṣaṇā ātmānaḥ tanmayāḥ anapekṣāḥ citte saṃpūrṇāḥ praśāntāḥ sama darśinaḥ nirmamāḥ nirahaṅkārāḥ nirdvandvāḥ niṣparigrahāḥ bhavanti teṣu nityam mahābhāgāḥ anya mārga rahitāḥ hi ye ātmānam tanmayam paśyantaḥ te eva ātmānam sevante

original: ye tanmārgīyā santaḥ sadopāsakāsteṣāṃ premalakṣaṇakāṣṭhāpratīkṣā bhavati | aho caturthāvaraṇaṃ mahāsthānam | yasminnāvaraṇe svāminyāḥ svayaṃ vihārasthalamasti | śatasahasrakuñjā nikuñjā latāvatī suvarṇavarṇā vidrumalatā amalā nirmalā vyaktamuktālatā bhrājamānā āsāṃ sakhīnāṃ sañcāro'tra sthāna āste | sūkṣmalatāntare śayyopakaraṇāni |
analyzed: ye tad mārgīyā santaḥ sadā upāsakāḥ teṣām prema lakṣaṇa kāṣṭhā pratīkṣā bhavati aho caturtha āvaraṇam mahā sthānam yasmin āvaraṇe svāminyāḥ svayam vihāra sthalam asti śata sahasra kuñjā nikuñjā latāvatī suvarṇa varṇā vidruma latāḥ amalā nirmalā vyakta muktā latāḥ bhrājamānā āsām sakhīnām sañcāraḥ utra sthāne āste sūkṣma latā antare śayyā upakaraṇāni

original: yatra rājamānāni hāṭakamaṇijaṭitāni bhūṣaṇāni yathāyogyāni vastrāṇi bhavantitarām | yatrāvaraṇe saṃbhogasthāne sakhīnāṃ samūhāḥ śṛṅgāravatyādayo rājamānāḥ bhavanti | ātmānaṃ śatadhā kṛtvā anekabhogarasaratisukhaṃ saṃbhokṣyamāṇāḥ bhavanti | saptamāvaraṇaṃ krīḍāsthānaṃ sahasrayojanāyatam |
analyzed: yatra rājamānāni hāṭaka maṇi jaṭitāni bhūṣaṇāni yathāyogyāni vastrāṇi bhavantitarām yatra āvaraṇe saṃbhoga sthāne sakhīnām samūhāḥ śṛṅgāravatī ādayaḥ rājamānāḥ bhavanti ātmānam śatadhā kṛtvā aneka bhoga rasa rati sukham saṃbhokṣyamāṇāḥ bhavanti saptama āvaraṇam krīḍā sthānam sahasra yojana āyatam

original: paritaḥ parito maṇistambhā atirasāḍhyāḥ sugandhāḍhyā bhavanti | atirasaguṇāḍhyā bhūḥ hāṭakasugandhakomalā āviṣṭasukhāḍhyā bhavatitarāṃ saṃbhokṣyamāṇaiva | yatra vallīnāṃ sañcārāḥ parāparasañcārā evāsate | hāṭakajaṭitamaṇijyotsnābhiḥ sarvaṃ pratibimbitaṃ vastumātram |
analyzed: paritas paritas maṇi stambhāḥ ati rasa āḍhyāḥ sugandha āḍhyāḥ bhavanti ati rasa guṇa āḍhyā bhūḥ hāṭaka sugandha komalā āviṣṭa sukha āḍhyā bhavatitarām saṃbhokṣyamāṇā eva yatra vallīnām sañcārāḥ para apara sañcārāḥ eva āsate hāṭaka jaṭita maṇi jyotsnābhiḥ sarvam pratibimbitam vastu mātram

original: tatra kalāvatī gānavatī sugandhā nṛtyaparā viśadā bhogaparā bhogavatī bhogābhijñā ratikalābhijñā kāmasukhā kāmāturā niḥśaṅkā sadānandā suratasukhā suratānandā suratamagnā āsanabhedābhijñā atirasadānābhijñā rasadā rasadātṛbhogābhijñā etāḥ sakhyaḥ saṃsiddhā anyāḥ sādhanasiddhā anekakalākovidā bhavanti |
analyzed: tatra kalāvatī gānavatī sugandhā nṛtya parā viśadā bhoga parā bhogavatī bhoga abhijñā rati kalā abhijñā kāma sukhā kāma āturā niḥśaṅkā sat ānandā surata sukhā surata ānandā surata magnā āsana bheda abhijñā ati rasa dāna abhijñā rasadā rasa dātṛ bhoga abhijñā etāḥ sakhyaḥ saṃsiddhāḥ anyāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ aneka kalā kovidāḥ bhavanti

original: tatra maṇḍalāvaraṇe mahāsthānaṃ saśayyopakaraṇam | kalāvatī śayyokaraṇāni karoti | suratotsāhā suratotkaṇṭhāṃ dadāti | nirlajjā niśśaṅkaṃ sukhaṃ dadāti | suratodgamā āliṅganacumbananamitapremabhararasasukhaṃ dadāti | rativatī ratisukhaṃ dadāti | ratikallolā ratibhararasālasyamukulitanayanā kelisukhaṃ dadāti |
analyzed: tatra maṇḍala āvaraṇe mahā sthānam sa śayyā upakaraṇam kalāvatī śayyokaraṇāni karoti surata utsāhā surata utkaṇṭhām dadāti nirlajjā niśśaṅkam sukham dadāti surata udgamā āliṅgana cumbana namita prema bhara rasa sukham dadāti rativatī rati sukham dadāti rati kallolā rati bhara rasa ālasya mukulita nayanā keli sukham dadāti

original: nibhṛtanikuñjagṛhaṃ gatayā tayā devyā saha rasikānandaḥ sukhamanubhavannāste | tasminnikuñje suracitā sakhī pratikuñjaṃ śayyāsukhaṃ karoti |
analyzed: nibhṛta nikuñja gṛham gatayā tayā devyā saha rasika ānandaḥ sukham anubhavan āste tasmin nikuñje su racitā sakhī pratikuñjam śayyā sukham karoti

original: ekā kalahaṃsī nirantaraṃ tasminnāvaraṇe sakhīnāṃ maṇḍale madhyasthā sadā krīḍāparā kalaśabdena tāṃ śrīrādhāṃ rasikānandaṃ ca krīḍamānā'bhyeti | tasminsamaye susvarakaṇṭhena sūkṣmasvaraṃ yathā bhavati tathā taṃ gāyamānā bhavati | mānalīlāyāṃ rasikānandavacanāttāṃ vrajeśvarī prasādayati nirantaramatimanotsāhaṃ ca dadāti |
analyzed: ekā kalahaṃsī nirantaram tasmin āvaraṇe sakhīnām maṇḍale madhya sthā sadā krīḍā parā kala śabdena tām śrī rādhām rasika ānandam ca krīḍamānā abhyeti tasmin samaye su svara kaṇṭhena sūkṣma svaram yathā bhavati tathā tam gāyamānā bhavati māna līlāyām rasika ānanda vacanāt tām vrajeśvarī prasādayati nirantaram ati manaḥ utsāham ca dadāti

original: sā vrajeśvarī kalahaṃsīṃ pratyāpadyamānaiva bhavatitarām | sā kalahaṃsī rasikānandasyātitarāṃ vallabhatayā sukhamanubhavantī saṃrocate | sā sadā jāgaritā sā sadā guṇajñā sā sadā rasasuratabhogajñā bhavatitarām | sā kalahaṃsī sarvāsāṃ sakhīnāṃ manāṃsi pratiharati svakrīḍayā | sā kalahaṃsī rasikānandasyātivallabhā bhavatitarām ||
analyzed: sā vrajeśvarī kalahaṃsīm pratyāpadyamānā eva bhavatitarām sā kalahaṃsī rasika ānandasya atitarām vallabha tayā sukham anubhavantī saṃrocate sā sadā jāgaritā sā sadā guṇa jñā sā sadā rasa surata bhoga jñā bhavatitarām sā kalahaṃsī sarvāsām sakhīnām manāṃsi pratiharati sva krīḍayā sā kalahaṃsī rasika ānandasya ati vallabhā bhavatitarām

original: sā kalahaṃsī sādhanasiddhaiveti | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | aho! kalahaṃsī pūrvaṃ kena sādhanenedaṃ sthānaṃ prāptavatī | mahāsthānaṃ prāptavatī | atyāścaryam! nirantaraṃ kena sādhanena śrīrādhāyā krīḍāsakhī bhavatitarām | sa hovāca nārāyaṇo'yam | sā kalahaṃsī sṛṣṭyādau brahmaṇaḥ putrī sarasvatī | sarvavidhāḥ prabhavā yasyāḥ sakāśādutpadyante |
analyzed: sā kalahaṃsī sādhana siddhā eva iti sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam aho kalahaṃsī pūrvam kena sādhanena idam sthānam prāptavatī mahā sthānam prāptavatī ati āścaryam nirantaram kena sādhanena śrī rādhāyāḥ krīḍā sakhī bhavatitarām sa ha uvāca nārāyaṇaḥ yam sā kalahaṃsī sṛṣṭi ādau brahmaṇaḥ putrī sarasvatī sarvavidhāḥ prabhavāḥ yasyāḥ sakāśāt utpadyante

original: catvāro vedā upavedāḥ purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi pṛthivyāṃ yāni vartiṣyamāṇāni tāni tasyā utpadyamānāni bhavanti | sā brahmaṇa putrī āptayauvanaivāsta | sā ekasmin samaye mama lokaṃ prāptā mamopāsanāṃ cakre | svasukhārthaṃ mama dhyānāpannā'bhavat | bahukālaṃ māmupasevamānā'bhavat | tasyā bhajanena prasanno'haṃ mama līlāsthānaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ darśitavān |
analyzed: catvāraḥ vedāḥ upavedāḥ purāṇāni dharma śāstrāṇi pṛthivyām yāni vartiṣyamāṇāni tāni tasyāḥ utpadyamānāni bhavanti sā brahmaṇa putrī āpta yauvanā eva āsta sā ekasmin samaye mama lokam prāptā mama upāsanām cakre sva sukha artham mama dhyāna āpannā bhavat bahukālam mām upasevamānā bhavat tasyāḥ bhajanena prasannā uham mama līlā sthānam vaikuṇṭham darśitavān

original: tasmin tvayā mayā krīḍitāni sthānāni saṃrājante | yatra vaikuṇṭhe anekaśo bhaktā jayantakumudajayavijayagaruḍādyāḥ śataśaḥ pārṣadā rājamānā bhavanti | yatra caturdhā muktayaḥ sevyamānā āsate | yatra vanāni koṭiśo'titarāṃ santi | sā vāgdevyatitarāmutkaṇṭhamanā atyantaṃ sukhasamāviṣṭamanā mama kṛpādṛṣṭyā sukhaṃ prāptā mahālīlāṃ prārthayāmāsa |

original: niśi dine sā vrajeśvarī rasikānandena saha darśanadṛṣṭigocaro bhavatitarām | atyānandarūpe sakhīnāṃ samūhamadhyasthe mahākrīḍāpare'timahāmohanarūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā indriyaśuddhipremṇā bhāvāpannā'bhavat | praseduṣyatisukomalalāvaṇyā sā varaṃ varayetyāha | sovācedam | yadi deyo varastarhi mahālīlāyāṃ sadāhaṃ sahacāriṇī bhavāmi | kimanyena vareṇa |

original: ayaṃ tāvanmanobhilāṣo yallīlā dṛśyate | tathetyuktā sā tābhyāṃ svasthānaṃ yayau | yā sā taddinamārabhya krīḍāparā bhavatitarām | kuñje nikuñje tenaiva kalahaṃsīrūpeṇa pratiśākhaṃ līyamānā sāmagānena manobhāvena stauti nānākautukakrīḍāmakarot | sā mahāramaṇasthānaṃ prāptā | mahālīlāyāṃ magnā ratisukhamanubhavantyāsta |
analyzed: ayam tāvat manaḥ abhilāṣaḥ yat līlā dṛśyate tathā iti uktā sā tābhyām sva sthānam yayau yā sā tat dinam ārabhya krīḍā parā bhavatitarām kuñje nikuñje tena eva kalahaṃsī rūpeṇa pratiśākham līyamānā sāma gānena manobhāvena stauti nānā kautuka krīḍām akarot sā mahā ramaṇa sthānam prāptā mahā līlāyām magnā rati sukham anubhavantī āsta

original: sā kalahaṃsī svayūthaṃ vidhāya kadācitsamaye rātriparabhāge suratotthitāṃ līlāmagāyat | kadācinmajjanalīlāmāgāyamānā bhavati | śṛṅgāralīlāyāṃ śṛṅgāraṃ prati pratikṣaṇaṃ nūtanasvāvirbhāvaratodbhavā bhavatitarām | līlāmāgāyamānā saṃbhokṣyamāṇā bhavati |

original: tatraikā puṣkariṇī miṣṭāmṛtarasapūritā bhavati caturyojanāyatā | tatra padmaṣaṇḍāni suvarṇasugandhasukomalāni manoharāṇi bhavanti | tasmin padmavane vihārakrīḍāparā kalahaṃsī surocamānā bhavati | aho lakṣmi tasmin kena bhāgyodayena tasyā nikuñjadevyā anugraheṇa ananyāśrayadharmotpattiryadā bhavatitarāṃ tadā ratirāvirbhavati |
analyzed: tatra ekā puṣkariṇī miṣṭa amṛta rasa pūritā bhavati catur yojana āyatā tatra padma ṣaṇḍāni suvarṇa sugandha su komalāni manoharāṇi bhavanti tasmin padma vane vihāra krīḍā parā kalahaṃsī su rocamānā bhavati aho lakṣmi tasmin kena bhāgya udayena tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ anugraheṇa ananya āśraya dharma utpattiḥ yadā bhavatitarām tadā ratiḥ āvirbhavati

original: tāvaddehopādhikarmakṣuttṛṭpipāsāmohabhayaduḥkhaṃ tathā sukhāni tathā na bhavanti yathā devādīnām | vratopavāsadharmādharmāḥ pitṛkāryākāryāṇi yatkiñciddharmāḥ śobhamānā dharmāḥ anyānyupavāsamayāni pāpapuṇyāni jñātvā yaḥ sarvadharmātirikto bhavet sa eva tanmaṇḍalaṃ prāpnotītyāha | aho ramyaṃ puṇyamācaret | atitarāṃ bhāvo bhavet |
analyzed: tāvat deha upādhi karma kṣudh tṛṣ pipāsā moha bhaya duḥkham tathā sukhāni tathā na bhavanti yathā deva ādīnām vrata upavāsa dharma adharmāḥ pitṛ kārya akāryāṇi yat kiñcid dharmāḥ śobhamānāḥ dharmāḥ anyāni upavāsa mayāni pāpa puṇyāni jñātvā yaḥ sarva dharma atiriktaḥ bhavet saḥ eva tat maṇḍalam prāpnoti iti āha aho ramyam puṇyam ācaret atitarām bhāvaḥ bhavet

original: saṃbhogalīlāyāṃ suratānando'yaṃ lokaḥ so'vaśiṣyate | suratānandasukhamanubhavanto bhaktā ātmānaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayanti | dharmādharmau tyaktvā samāḥ sahajabhāvā bhavanti | atirasamagnā vidyātapodhyānamaitrīkalāguṇasaṃyuktāśca bhavanti | anyapratipattisahito nāstiko na labhate tallokaprāptim |
analyzed: saṃbhoga līlāyām surata ānandaḥ yam lokaḥ saḥ uvaśiṣyate surata ānanda sukham anubhavantaḥ bhaktāḥ ātmānam tad maya tām nayanti dharma adharmau tyaktvā samāḥ sahaja bhāvāḥ bhavanti ati rasa magnāḥ vidyā tapaḥ dhyāna maitrī kalā guṇa saṃyuktāḥ ca bhavanti anya pratipatti sahitaḥ nāstikaḥ na labhate tad loka prāptim

original: aho lakṣmi kadācinmahābhāgyodayena asminnāvaraṇe prītirāste | yatra vṛkṣāḥ phalairnamrāḥ puṣpamiṣṭāmṛtamayarasamagnā bhavanti | yatra śākhāḥ puṣpanamrā bhavanti | pañcame
analyzed: aho lakṣmi kadācid mahābhāgya udayena asmin āvaraṇe prītiḥ āste yatra vṛkṣāḥ phalaiḥ namrāḥ puṣpam iṣṭa amṛta maya rasa magnāḥ bhavanti yatra śākhāḥ puṣpa namrāḥ bhavanti pañcame

original: āvaraṇe saṃsiddhāni śukapikayūthāni saṃrājamānānyāsate | kecidāmravṛkṣāḥ pakvaphalāḥ sadā saṃbhokṣyamāṇā āsate | atirasamagnaḥ sādhanasiddha ekaḥ śuko'tyantavallabho'sti | yasya pakṣacañcukāḥ sā vrajeśvarī svahastena mārjayati | rasikānando'pi svahastena bhakṣaṃ dadāti | tasya sahacāriṇyekā śārikā āste | sā sādhanasiddhā bhavatitarām |
analyzed: āvaraṇe saṃsiddhāni śukapika yūthāni saṃrājamānāni āsate kecid āmra vṛkṣāḥ pakva phalāḥ sadā saṃbhokṣyamāṇāḥ āsate ati rasa magnaḥ sādhana siddhaḥ ekaḥ yasya pakṣa cañcukāḥ sā vrajeśvarī sva hastena mārjayati rasika ānandaḥ upi sva hastena bhakṣam dadāti tasya sahacāriṇī ekā śārikā āste sā sādhana siddhā bhavatitarām

original: tacchukaśārikāmithunaṃ rasikānandakrīḍāyāṃ sahacāryeva bhavatitarām | tatra rasikā sā śārikā nirantarakrīḍāparā bhavati | suvarṇavarṇāsu bhūmiṣu ratnaparidhiṣu saśayyopakaraṇaṃ vihārasthalam | tatra vṛkṣasañcārāḥ suśobhāḍhyā bhavantitarām | tatra śukaśārikāḥ sādhanasiddhāḥ krīḍāparā bhavanti | atyāsaktā mahākrīḍāyāṃ saṃbhavanti |
analyzed: tat śuka śārikā mithunam rasika ānanda krīḍāyām sahacārī eva bhavatitarām tatra rasikā sā śārikā nirantara krīḍā parā bhavati suvarṇa varṇāsu bhūmiṣu ratna paridhiṣu sa śayyā upakaraṇam vihāra sthalam tatra vṛkṣa sañcārāḥ su śobhā āḍhyāḥ bhavantitarām tatra śuka śārikāḥ sādhana siddhāḥ krīḍā parāḥ bhavanti ati āsaktāḥ mahā krīḍāyām saṃbhavanti

original: aho rasamārgo'yaṃ durlabhataro'pyāsīt | aho mahābhāgyavaśāttasyā nikuñjadevyā anugrahādatyantapriyatamo bhavati | prītiḥ prītyā bhavati bhaktirbhaktyā bhavati snehaḥ snehena bhavati tasmādbhāgyodayādatitarāmāseduṣaḥ | aho bhāgyavantaḥ kṛtakṛtyavantaḥ sarve tīrthavanto bhavanti | atirasamagnāḥ atibhuñjānā atyantasukhamanubhavanti |
analyzed: aho rasa mārgaḥ yam durlabhataraḥ api āsīt aho mahā bhāgya vaśāt tasyāḥ nikuñja devyāḥ anugrahāt atyanta priyatamaḥ bhavati prītiḥ prītyā bhavati bhaktiḥ bhaktyā bhavati snehaḥ snehena bhavati tasmāt bhāgya udayāt atitarām āseduṣaḥ aho bhāgyavantaḥ kṛtakṛtyavantaḥ sarve tīrthavantaḥ bhavanti ati rasa magnāḥ ati bhuñjānāḥ atyanta sukham anubhavanti

original: ya imāṃ līlāṃ saṃbhuñjamānāḥ bhavanti ya imāṃ līlāmupāsamānā eva bhavanti te bhaktā bhavanti | yadā mahābhāgyodayo bhavatitarāṃ tadāsyā līlāyāṃ pratyayo bhavet | te dharmakāriṇaḥ, te vratakāriṇaḥ | yeṣāṃ līlāyāmupāsanārucirāste te vratakāriṇo bhavanti | yasya mahālīlāyāṃ mano'bhyeti |
analyzed: ye imām līlām saṃbhuñjamānāḥ bhavanti ye imām līlām upāsamānāḥ eva bhavanti te bhaktāḥ bhavanti yadā mahābhāgya udayaḥ bhavatitarām tadā asyāḥ līlāyām pratyayaḥ bhavet te dharma kāriṇaḥ te vrata kāriṇaḥ yeṣām līlāyām upāsanā rucirāḥ te te vrata kāriṇaḥ bhavanti yasya mahā līlāyām manaḥ abhyeti

original: yo vidhau ca pratiṣedhe ca nirvidya asyāṃ līlāyāṃ manobhāvāpanno bhavet sa eva līlopayogyo bhavet | ye pratyayakāriṇaḥ teṣāmanugrahaḥ | sā lakṣmīḥ punaruvācedam | rahasyalīlāyāṃ mano bhāvāpannaṃ bhavati | atyantaratyāviṣṭacittā bhāvāpannā bhavāmi |
analyzed: yaḥ vidhau ca pratiṣedhe ca nirvidya asyām līlāyām manaḥ bhāva āpannaḥ bhavet saḥ eva līlā upayogyaḥ bhavet ye pratyaya kāriṇaḥ teṣām anugrahaḥ sā lakṣmīḥ punar uvāca idam rahasya līlāyām manaḥ bhāva āpannam bhavati atyantar ati āviṣṭa cittā bhāva āpannā bhavāmi

original: kaḥ śukaḥ? kā śārikā bhāvāpannā? yasyāṃ rasikānando'tyantasnehāviṣṭamanā bhavati sā vrajeśvarī atyantaṃ snehaṃ cakāra | atidurlabhataraṃ sthānaṃ prāptam | avicchinnā ratigati
analyzed: kaḥ śukaḥ kā śārikā bhāva āpannā yasyām rasika ānanda utyanta sneha āviṣṭa manāḥ bhavati sā vrajeśvarī atyantam sneham cakāra ati durlabhataram sthānam prāptam avicchinnā rati gatiḥ

original: yogyatā saṃyokṣyamāṇā bhavatitarām | sa hovāca nārāyaṇo'yam | śṛṇu lakṣmi ādau sṛṣṭeḥ sumanto nāma brāhmaṇaḥ kauśikagotrātsamudbhūto bhavati | sa kānyakubjadeśe samudbhūta āsīt | atitarāṃ bhāvāpanno'bhavat | tasya manoramā bhavatyatiśayabhaktimārgaratā | tau dampatī atisubhagāvatitarasnehasaṃpannau nirantarasevāyāṃ saṃyokṣyamāṇaratī āsātām |
analyzed: yogyatā saṃyokṣyamāṇā bhavatitarām sa ha uvāca nārāyaṇaḥ yam śṛṇu lakṣmi ādau sṛṣṭeḥ sumantaḥ nāma brāhmaṇaḥ kauśika gotrāt samudbhūtaḥ bhavati sa kānyakubja deśe samudbhūtaḥ āsīt atitarām bhāva āpannaḥ bhavat tasya manoramā bhavati atiśaya bhakti mārga ratā tau dampatī ati subhagau atitara sneha saṃpannau nirantara sevāyām saṃyokṣyamāṇa ratī āsātām

original: tau dampatī atisnehenāviṣṭacittau kāle kāle tāṃ vrajeśvarīṃ rasikānandena saha upasevamānāvāsātām | tāvativanalīlāyāmatyāsaktau bhavataḥ | kasmin kiyadbhāgyodayena bhaktānāṃ saṅgena vanaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ prāptau? tatra vṛndāvane kāmavane kadambaṣaṇḍe vṛṣabhānupure nandagrāme pāvanasarasi pratipadyamānāvabhavatām |
analyzed: tau dampatī atisnehena āviṣṭa cittau kāle kāle tām vrajeśvarīm rasikānandena saha upasevamānau āsātām tau ati vana līlāyām atyāsaktau bhavataḥ kasmin kiyat bhāgya udayena bhaktānām saṅgena vanam vṛndāvanam prāptau tatra vṛndāvane kāma vane kadamba ṣaṇḍe vṛṣabhānu pure nandagrāme pāvana sarasi pratipadyamānau abhavatām

original: evaṃvidhe rahasi krīḍāvihāre kiyatkālaṃ vāsamālambya tiṣṭhantāvabhavatām? dampatī sābhilāṣau vane atyāsaktāvabhavatām | manorathena saha vrajeśvarī rasikānandena saha dṛṣṭipathamāpede | mahālīlāyāṃ krīḍāparau saṃbhāṣamāṇau saṃyuñjātām | taddinamārabhya tau dampatī mahālīlāyāṃ krīḍāparāvabhavatām | sā lakṣmīruvācedaṃ rahasyam |
analyzed: evaṃvidhe rahasi krīḍā vihāre kiyatkālam vāsam ālambya tiṣṭhantau abhavatām dampatī sa abhilāṣau vane ati āsaktau abhavatām manorathena saha vrajeśvarī rasika ānandena saha dṛṣṭi patham āpede mahā līlāyām krīḍā parau saṃbhāṣamāṇau saṃyuñjātām tat dinam ārabhya tau dampatī mahā līlāyām krīḍā parau abhavatām sā lakṣmīḥ uvāca idam rahasyam

original: vrajavāsinīsṛṣṭiḥ kīdṛgvidhā? ye saṃsiddhāste kīdṛgvidhāḥ? anye ke jīvāḥ sṛṣṭyādau prakaṭitā? jīvasya kīdṛgvidhaṃ rūpam? bandhamokṣau kīdṛgvidhau bhavataḥ? punaḥ sa hovāca nārāyaṇo'yam | aho! prapañco'yamanādisaṃsiddho bhavati | yathā brahma trividhātmakam | saccidānandātmakam | sattu vyāpakatayāsti | tejomayaṃ cidasti |
analyzed: vrajavāsinī sṛṣṭiḥ kīdṛgvidhā ye saṃsiddhāḥ te kīdṛgvidhāḥ anye ke jīvāḥ sṛṣṭi ādau prakaṭitāḥ jīvasya kīdṛgvidham rūpam bandha mokṣau kīdṛgvidhau bhavataḥ punar sa ha uvāca nārāyaṇaḥ yam aho prapañcaḥ yam anādi saṃsiddhaḥ bhavati yathā brahma trividha ātmakam saccidānanda ātmakam sattu vyāpaka tayā asti tejaḥ mayam cit asti

original: ānandamayastu puruṣottamo'tiricyate | yathā brahmānando'yaṃ lokaḥ saccidānando bhavati tathā jīvasaṅghastrividho bhavati | sovācedam | kimayaṃ jīvasaṅgho bhavet? teṣāṃ kā dṛṣṭiḥ? kāvasthā bhavati? sa hovācedam | śṛṇu | anādisaṃsiddho'yaṃ jīvaścidaṃśo bhavati | sovācedam | yadi cidaṃśo jīvaḥ kathamajñānena jaḍatāṃ prapadyate | sa hovāca |
analyzed: ānanda mayaḥ tu puruṣottama utiricyate yathā brahma ānandaḥ ayam lokaḥ saccidānandaḥ bhavati tathā jīva saṅghaḥ trividhaḥ bhavati saḥ uvāca idam kim ayam jīva saṅghaḥ bhavet teṣām kā dṛṣṭiḥ kā avasthā bhavati sa ha uvāca idam śṛṇu anādi saṃsiddhaḥ yam jīvaḥ cit aṃśaḥ bhavati saḥ uvāca idam yadi cit aṃśaḥ jīvaḥ katham ajñānena jaḍatām prapadyate sa ha uvāca

original: yathā anādisaṃsiddho'yaṃ
analyzed: yathā an ādi saṃsiddhaḥ yam

original: jīvasaṅghastathā māyāpyanādisiddhā bhavati | sā trividhā vyāpya tiṣṭhati | sa evaṃ jīvastrividho bhavati | sovācedam | jīvasaṅghastrividhastiṣṭhati | varṇaya | sa hovāca | sadrūpaḥ saṃsārātmako bhavati | nānākarmāṇi karoti | varṇāścāśramāśca, dharmāśca sādhanāni saṃyujyante | teṣāmutpattiḥ sthitiḥ | cidrūpo jīvo jñānī bhavati |
analyzed: jīva saṅghaḥ tathā māyā api anādisiddhā bhavati sā trividhā vyāpya tiṣṭhati saḥ evam jīvaḥ trividhaḥ bhavati sā uvāca idam jīva saṅghaḥ trividhaḥ tiṣṭhati varṇaya sa ha uvāca sat rūpaḥ saṃsāra ātmakaḥ bhavati nānā karmāṇi karoti varṇāḥ ca āśramāḥ ca dharmāḥ ca sādhanāni saṃyujyante teṣām utpattiḥ sthitiḥ cit rūpaḥ jīvaḥ jñānī bhavati

original: sa niṣkarmamārgīyo bhavati | ye jīvāḥ ānandarūpāsteṣāṃ sarvadharmatyāgāt rasānandasvarūpā mahālīlopasevyamānāḥ āsate | tān dharmādharmau na bādhete tasyāṃ mahālīlāyām | sovācedam | kayā māyayā saṃyujyamāno jīvaḥ karmamārgarato bhavati? sa hovāca | māyārūpaṃ trividham | yadrūpaṃ sadrūpaṃ tanmāyāsaṃvalito'yaṃ jīvasaṅghaḥ karmakāṇḍarato bhavati |
analyzed: sa niṣkarma mārgīyaḥ bhavati ye jīvāḥ ānanda rūpāḥ teṣām sarva dharma tyāgāt rasa ānanda sva rūpāḥ mahā līlā upasevyamānāḥ āsate tān dharma adharmau na bādhete tasyām mahā līlāyām sā uvāca idam kayā māyayā saṃyujyamānaḥ jīvaḥ karma mārga rataḥ bhavati sa ha uvāca māyā rūpam trividham yat rūpam sat rūpam tat māyā saṃvali tā uyam jīva saṅghaḥ karmakāṇḍa rataḥ bhavati

original: cidrūpayā māyayā saṃvalito jīvasaṅghaḥ saṃnyāsī bhavati | ānandasaṃvalitayā māyayānandātmaka eva bhavati | ānandarasastu mahālīlāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavatitarām | teṣāṃ karmāṇi yāthātathyena vadāmi | teṣāṃ ye karmamārgīyāḥ karmapratipādakā mahāvanalīlāyāmapratyayakāriṇo'surāḥ karmajaḍā anyopāsakāstadupādhitayānyamārgaṃ na vindante |
analyzed: cit rūpayā māyayā saṃvalitaḥ jīva saṅghaḥ saṃnyāsī bhavati ānanda saṃvalitayā māyayā ānanda ātmakaḥ eva bhavati ānanda rasaḥ tu mahā līlāyāḥ kāraṇam bhavatitarām teṣām karmāṇi yāthātathyena vadāmi teṣām ye karma mārgīyāḥ karma pratipādakāḥ mahā vana līlāyām apratyaya kāriṇaḥ usurāḥ karma jaḍāḥ anya upāsakāḥ tad upādhi tayā anya mārgam na vindante

original: agnerupāsakāste yajñakarmavāsanātmakaliṅgaśarīreṣūtpattiṃ bhajante | tena vāsanātmakena liṅgenotpattisthitilayānāpadyante | tasmālliṅgaśarīrātmako'yaṃ jīvasya svabhāvaḥ |

original: śarīraṃ kīdṛgvidham tasmin śarīre ke guṇā ke avaguṇāḥ? kena bandhaḥ śarīre? kenaiva muktiḥ tasmin śarīre? ko nirupādhiḥ? tasmin kiṃ jñānaṃ bhavati? kīdṛśena śarīreṇa bandhaḥ? kīdṛśena mokṣo bhavati? sa hovāca | śarīrabhedāḥ dvividhāḥ | śarīrameva karmopajanitaṃ yadṛcchayā cotpannaṃ tasyā nikuñjadevyāḥ anugrahādbhavati |

analyzed: karma jaḍānām karma saṃbhūta vāsanā jaḍa ātmakam bhavati yeṣām anugrahāt saṃbhavaḥ bhavati teṣām sneha mārge rucirāḥ te yeṣām nirvāṇa mārge ruciḥ bhavati te saṃnyāsinaḥ bhavanti śarīram tu ekādaśa indriya ātmakam pañca jñāna indriyāṇi pañca karmendriyāṇi ubhaya ātmakam manaḥ jāyate pañca mahābhūtāni pañca tanmātrāṇi trayaḥ guṇāḥ pañcaviṃśattamaḥ jīvaḥ

original: ṣaḍviṃśako mahāviṣṇuḥ sadā draṣṭā bhavati | ime jīvāḥ śarīropādhiṃ bhuñjānāḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ prāpnuvanto bhavanti | sarveṣāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ samānaguṇā bhavanti | rāgādayaḥ kāmakrodhalobhamohajarāmaraṇasukhaduḥ khānyanubhavanta āpadyante | idaṃ śarīraṃ jarayā grastaṃ gandharvanagaropamaṃ manorathamayaṃ
analyzed: ṣaḍviṃśakaḥ mahāviṣṇuḥ sadā draṣṭā bhavati ime jīvāḥ śarīra upādhim bhuñjānāḥ sukham duḥkham prāpnuvantaḥ bhavanti sarveṣām śarīrāṇām samāna guṇāḥ bhavanti rāga ādayaḥ kāma krodha lobha moha jarā maraṇa sukha duḥ khāni anubhavantaḥ āpadyante idam śarīram jarayā grastam gandharvanagara upamam manoratha mayam

original: bhavati | te sarve guṇā liṅgaśarīrodayādapetā liṅgaṃ vidhūyātmānaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayanti | te rāgādayo doṣāḥ śarīrasaṃvalitāḥ | te kābhakrodhādayastadarthe prayujyamānāḥ sādhanarūpā bhavanti | sovācedam | kathaṃ rāgādayaḥ sādhanarūpā bhavanti? yeṣāṃ saṃsargāt vikalatāṃ prapedire |
analyzed: bhavati te sarve guṇāḥ liṅga śarīra udayāt apetāḥ liṅgam vidhūya ātmānam tad maya tām nayanti te rāga ādayaḥ doṣāḥ śarīra saṃvalitāḥ te kā ābha krodha ādayaḥ tad arthe prayujyamānāḥ sādhana rūpāḥ bhavanti sā uvāca idam katham rāga ādayaḥ sādhana rūpāḥ bhavanti yeṣām saṃsargāt vikala tām prapedire

original: bhagavadarthe prayujyamānāḥ rāgādayaḥ kathaṃ niṣkarmatāṃ prāpnuvanti? eṣa kāma eṣa krodha eṣa lobha eṣaḥ moha ityātmalīlārthe jīvaṃ prayojayati | sa hovāca | māyā trividhā bhavati | sadrūpayā māyayotpāditāḥ kāmakrodhādayo guṇāḥ saṃsārotpattiprayojakāḥ bhavanti | cidrūpe āśritā jīvāste tān guṇān prapadya jaḍatāṃ prapedire |
analyzed: bhagavat arthe prayujyamānāḥ rāga ādayaḥ katham niṣkarmatām prāpnuvanti eṣa kāmaḥ eṣa krodhaḥ eṣa lobhaḥ eṣaḥ mohaḥ iti ātma līlā arthe jīvam prayojayati sa ha uvāca māyā trividhā bhavati sat rūpayā māyayā utpāditāḥ kāma krodha ādayaḥ guṇāḥ saṃsāra utpatti prayojakāḥ bhavanti cit rūpe āśritāḥ jīvāḥ te tān guṇān prapadya jaḍatām prapedire
